chapters.title: Chapter 401 - 294: Flourishing Blossoms, Xingyu City Booming
paragraphs: Hearing these words, the survivors on several streets lifted their heads and gazed with fervent eyes at the city center.
To this day, most survivors are already aware of the key features of Xingyu City.
One could say, these are Xingyu City’s core competencies.
The first is the Star River Weapon Shop.
In the weapon shop, advanced weapons for all professions are sold, ranging from purple armor, golden armor, and even to orange armor, all available.
There are even some powerful sets.
The second is the Star River Equipment Shop.
Similar to the weapon shop, it also features various high-level, high-attribute armor and jewelry.
Every day, numerous survivors wander around these two shops.
Even if they can’t afford it, just a glance at the powerful attributes and the luxurious appearance of those high-level equipment is enough to satisfy them.
And these weapons and items.
Were all obtained by Han Xing in the Abyssal Rift or found in treasure chests.
All were handed over to Lanlan and Luo Chan for consignment in Xingyu City.
On the one hand, they could be exchanged for resources.
On the other hand, they could increase the popularity of Xingyu City.
Besides these two features.
For the survivors, there’s an even more popular shop.
That is the Star River Rune Shop.
In this shop, a vast number of high-attribute runes are for sale.
Not only are the attributes stronger than those in the transaction channel, but the prices also follow market trends.
Moreover, survivors who sign contracts receive certain discounts on rune purchases.
This particular condition has invisibly attracted many contract-signing survivors to Xingyu City.
And most crucially.
The Star River Rune Shop recently introduced a powerful and unique precious rune!
Destruction Rune (Gold)
Its formidable attributes stunned countless survivors as soon as it hit the market.
They all knew how terrifying the attributes of this rune were.
For most survivors who are still only above level thirty.
Enchanting a full set of equipment with the Destruction Rune could increase damage by at least 30%.
The appearance of this rune completely obliterated the competitiveness of Huayi Alliance and Kunlun’s territories.
Looking at the bustling scenes on the streets, a smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
"Xingyu City has truly come into its own, thanks to Lanlan’s management and construction efforts during this time."
"Oh no, credit also goes to Luo Chan."
"After all, these shops are managed and operated by Luo Chan."
"In the future, if an opportunity arises, I’ll see if I can give them some compensation."
Thinking of this, Han Xing continued to leisurely stroll through this city that was entirely his own.
It’s nearly been a year since entering this world.
Time really flies.
Similarly, Han Xing’s goals have been realized one by one.
While pondering these things,
his steps had unconsciously taken him to the central area of Xingyu City.
Here was his Lord’s Mansion, one of the few places in Xingyu City not open to other survivors.
Now, the area surrounding the Lord’s Mansion was guarded by a group of wolf cavalry wielding silver swords.
On the nearby streets, he also saw many Thunderbolt Towers and a few towering Goddess Statues.
The place where those statues stood was formerly the Town Square.
Now it attracts many survivors who stop to admire it, occasionally exclaiming in awe.
It’s now become a distinctive check-in point in Xingyu City as well.
Han Xing shook his head and then turned his gaze toward the main gate of the Lord’s Mansion.
Slowly walking forward.
At this moment.
A few tourists wandering nearby saw Han Xing’s back and the direction he was heading, and immediately looked startled.
"Look, another fool trying to challenge the rules set by the Star God!"
"We’ve told him, the Lord’s Mansion in Xingyu City’s center is not open to the public, yet some people just can’t accept it."
"Watch, he’ll soon be chased away by those wolf cavalry!"
A human knight declared with certainty.
Beside him, a female assassin clinging to his arm asked, "Are those wolf cavalry really strong?"
The two appeared to be a couple.
Upon hearing, the human knight snorted coldly, "More than strong!"
"Each wolf cavalry is above the fourth transformation in power, and their individual combat ability is enough to crush the vast majority of us survivors."
"Moreover, they always operate in groups, displaying strength far beyond ordinary creatures!"
The female assassin nodded in realization.
She seemed to think of something and asked curiously, "What if we forcibly break into the Lord’s Mansion?"
The human knight responded with an inexplicable smile.
"Forcefully break in?"
He sneered, "There was a group of clueless fools who tried that, but they were all slain by the wolf cavalry, one sword for each, before they could even attack!"
Upon hearing this, the female assassin’s pupils narrowed instantly.
"Then what about him..."
She pointed at Han Xing’s back, worry evident in her eyes.
"Him?"
"If this kid doesn’t return soon, he will certainly face expulsion by the wolf cavalry, and if he resists, there will be only one outcome for him."
The human knight stood with arms crossed, clearly awaiting the spectacle.
Other tourists who overheard the knight’s words also paused what they were doing, slightly nervous yet expectant, watching this young man walking toward the Lord’s Mansion.
After all, everyone has a bit of a curious streak.
They wanted to see this young man being driven away by the wolf cavalry in disgrace.
Or perhaps witness him being cut down by random swords in a bloody scene.
In any case, under the gaze of a group of tourists, Han Xing gradually approached the gate of the Lord’s Mansion.
Yet what happened next left these onlooking tourists dumbfounded.
They saw with their own eyes the young man reached the side of the wolf cavalry.
According to past events, the wolf cavalry would draw their longswords at this time to stop the young man.
However, this time, not only did the wolf cavalry not unsheathe their swords.
They even bowed respectfully in front of everyone’s eyes.
All the wolf cavalry performed a standard knight salute, looking at this young man with fervent eyes.
At this moment, the group of tourists was utterly stunned.
"What the hell happened?"
"These wolf cavalry, usually so arrogant, practically looking down their noses at everyone, are actually saluting a human today?"
"Am I seeing things?" the human knight exclaimed.
The other tourists also wore expressions of disbelief.
"I’m baffled too, normally, I’ve never seen these wolf cavalry salute anyone, not even the management personnel of Xingyu City,"
"Could it be that this person has a status higher than those management personnel?"
This question seemed to awaken others.
"Hold on, did anyone notice that this man’s back looks somewhat familiar? I feel like I’ve seen it somewhere."
Upon hearing this, everyone focused on Han Xing’s back and noticed the great bow on his back.
Hunter profession?
The next moment, everyone’s pupils contracted sharply.
Could it be him?!
That legendary figure, who, though silent for months, never faded from discussion among survivors.
Star River!
This speculation was very likely to be correct.
At this moment, an excited human warrior said, "Hunter profession, high position in Xingyu City, it must be him!"
Other survivors exclaimed in surprise, "Oh my, we actually saw a living legend! Brothers, hurry and take a picture."
"I’ll take a couple of shots too."
"I want to take a picture with the Star God!"
However, at this time, Han Xing had already entered the Lord’s Mansion and didn’t hear the tourists’ discussions about him.
As the gates of the Lord’s Mansion closed again.
The tourists who wanted to take pictures with him showed a trace of disappointment in their eyes.
Inside the Lord’s Mansion, Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up.
He found that inside the Lord’s Mansion had undergone a dramatic transformation since he last left!

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - 295: Wait Until I’m Invincible Worldwide!
paragraphs: Not only were many pieces of furniture added, but the decor style has also been completely transformed.
From the original Western medieval castle style, it has morphed into an Oriental classic style.
This is the safest place in Xingyu City.
Han Xing knows that Lanlan and the others usually handle various matters here.
Changing it to a style they like is perfectly normal.
Through the corridors lined with ink-wash screens.
Soon, Han Xing found where Lanlan was.
In an inconspicuous small room at the corner of the Lord’s Mansion.
He pushed open the door and saw a woman in casual uniform, leaning over a huge desk, handling letters and documents.
She heard the door being pushed open.
Her face showed a hint of confusion.
But when she recognized who had come in, she exclaimed in surprise.
"Ah! It’s the Lord!"
Lanlan immediately stood up from her chair and ran over to Han Xing.
"Lord, when did you return?"
She was very excited.
Han Xing replied with a smile, "Just now, not long ago."
After some conversation.
Han Xing then said, "By the way, where’s Luo Chan? Have her come over."
"And also gather your friends and the current management of Xingyu City, I have something to announce."
Lanlan quickly agreed upon hearing this.
A dozen minutes later.
Han Xing arrived at the council hall of the Lord’s Mansion.
As the current management personnel of Xingyu City gradually came in.
Han Xing saw many unfamiliar faces among them.
Both men and women.
After a while.
The council hall was filled with fifty or sixty people.
Han Xing had heard from Lanlan that these unfamiliar faces were later promoted.
These people were either outstanding in ability or brought certain benefits to Xingyu City.
In short.
They were selected through multiple layers of filtering and were considered trustworthy.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly noticed an ethereal silhouette entering at the hall entrance.
She wore a green dress, and her walking resembled a fairy descending to the mortal world.
As the most popular presence in District Five, Luo Chan was recognized by global survivors as a goddess-level figure.
Seeing Han Xing at this moment, Luo Chan’s eyes carried a gentle smile.
Han Xing noticed Luo Chan’s gaze and nodded, "You’re here, find a seat to sit."
Although he said find a seat, in reality, Luo Chan naturally sat on Han Xing’s left.
To his right sat Lanlan.
These two women were the two visible decision-makers in Xingyu City.
Therefore, no one questioned them sitting in these two seats.
At this point, Han Xing looked at the people below and said directly.
"So many unfamiliar faces, I don’t know many of you."
"But I believe you are all trustworthy people, so there’s no need for individual introductions."
Upon hearing this, relaxed smiles appeared on the faces below.
Although they had assumed positions in the management of Xingyu City, they were only promoted by Luo Chan or Lanlan.
They all knew that Star River was actually the true boss of Xingyu City.
But this legendary figure had not returned, so they were also a bit anxious.
Everyone meticulously focused on doing their part.
Worried that if Star River returned dissatisfied, he might dismiss them all.
Now it seemed that Star River appeared to be quite satisfied with them.
However, it was actually Han Xing being lazy.
He had no patience to listen to each of them introduce themselves and their work scope.
In Xingyu City, he was just the hands-off manager.
"Cough, cough...
Han Xing cleared his throat and continued.
"Gathering you here is to introduce some matters about the new map, the Witch Race Territory."
This statement immediately drew everyone’s attention.
They all looked at Han Xing with surprise and focus.
Since Han Xing previously slew the Legend and unlocked the Human Race milestone.
Everyone knew that a new map, the Witch Race Territory, had been unlocked.
But so far, besides Zhou Huang and Boundless and them.
Not many people globally have crossed the Path of the Giant Dragon.
They were all blocked by the harsh environment.
After sacrificing tens of thousands in deaths and the destruction of several Sky Islands.
Everyone realized that reaching the new map wasn’t an easy task.
But they also knew the new map must represent new opportunities.
Whoever could be the first to reach the new map would seize these opportunities ahead of others.
Any bit of news on the forums would cause significant attention and discussion.
Some large teams even offered high prices seeking ways to cross the Path of the Giant Dragon.
However——
As management at Xingyu City, they naturally had access to some inside information.
The one who slew the Legend was Star River.
In other words, Star River had long left the Land of the Abandoned Gods and developed in the new map, the Witch Race Territory, for a while.
So, when hearing Han Xing say he wanted to introduce the new map.
They immediately realized this might be a rare opportunity!
Han Xing also noticed those dozens of eager eyes.
Though unsure why they reacted so strongly, he didn’t mind.
Thus, Han Xing narrated his experiences in the Witch Race and some powers leisurely.
After hearing Han Xing’s narrative, it was as if everyone had witnessed the vast territory of the Witch Race and its culturally rich cities.
For a moment, these people sighed in amazement.
"So that’s how it is, the resources in the Witch Race Territory are so abundant..."

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - 295: Wait Until I’m Invincible Worldwide!
paragraphs: "Moreover, the population is astonishingly large."
"There’s also something like a battle merit store; as long as you join the camp, you can benefit from it."
"However, it’s very dangerous. The war has become so brutal, with the casualties of tens of billions of civilians. It’s truly horrifying."
Beside him, a male swordsman sighed, "Yes, and there are so many legendary powerhouses!"
"According to the Star God, any legendary powerhouse could easily annihilate all of humanity."
"But even such a powerful race is not a match for the Shadow Legion."
Luo Chan, with her keen mind, quickly understood the implication of Han Xing’s words.
"Does the Star God mean to gather a large number of survivors to go to the Witch Race territory this time?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
Upon hearing this, not only Luo Chan but the other survivors’ faces changed.
After all, this is not exactly a favorable task.
Initially, they thought the Witch Race territory was full of opportunities, and whoever went first could seize them.
But unexpectedly, it’s currently a time of war.
The Witch Race territory is so dangerous that with their little power, they would likely only become frontline soldiers or cannon fodder.
Han Xing seemed to sense the worries of the crowd.
He then explained with a smile, "For other survivors, the current Witch Race territory might be a dragon’s lair or a tiger’s den."
"But for us, it’s quite the opposite."
"If we can seize the opportunity to leverage the war, those who venture out will experience a substantial leap in strength!"
Upon hearing this, the entire management team was taken aback.
They looked at Han Xing in confusion.
Han Xing said at this time, "Do you think I would have left so many days in advance without making any preparations?"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Of course, this person is the Star God.
The legendary figure!
Even the Blood Tide that could have wiped out all of humanity back then was resolved by him.
Having left so long in advance, equivalent to being ahead of all survivors worldwide, it’s impossible that he didn’t leave behind some tricks.
At this moment, Han Xing chuckled lightly, "Now, there’s an entire Witch Race main city that has already established a cooperative relationship with me."
"As long as they are willing to go to the Witch Race territory, I will first arrange for them to join the Witch Race military."
"Then they will follow these Witch Race soldiers to fight against the scattered Shadow Legion, significantly reducing the risk factor and reaping a wealth of experience."
After these words fell, the entire council hall fell silent.
From Han Xing’s introduction, they had already learned about the immense strength of a Witch Race main city.
Among them are more than a hundred million Witch Race soldiers with Third and Fourth Transformations.
And there are also legendary powerhouses.
Even if they wish to annihilate all humanity, it would be easy.
But now, Han Xing says he has established a cooperative relationship with such a giant.
Luo Chan said excitedly, "Does the Star God mean? You’ve already gained a firm foothold over there and can arrange for us to join the army?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"However, don’t misunderstand."
"Although we are in a cooperative relationship, these Witch Race soldiers also have to follow my orders,"
"With me there, the scenario where you’re treated as cannon fodder will not occur."
"Moreover, besides these Witch Race soldiers, I will also dispatch the troops from my territory to assist you in battle."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s added words, everyone was even more astounded.
They even doubted their hearing.
It’s not just cooperation, but these Witch Race soldiers must obey him!
That changes the meaning entirely!
Han Xing’s words completely dispelled everyone’s worries.
It even turned the previously dangerous battlefield into an opportunity for rapid advancement and acquiring various benefits.
For a moment, everyone’s gaze became more fervent.
They were even beginning to discuss the quota for going to the Witch Race territory!
Luo Chan took the lead, saying, "In that case, only trustworthy people must be allowed to go to the Witch Race territory."
"After all, the Star God has given so much help; with just a bit of effort, one can rapidly become stronger!"
"Naturally, these resources shouldn’t end up in the hands of outsiders!"
These words garnered unanimous approval from everyone.
However, Han Xing didn’t immediately agree.
Because until now, with the high-level teleportation array not yet constructed, he didn’t know how effective the teleportation array would be.
How many people it can transport at once, or its cooldown time.
These are things he still doesn’t know.
They can only decide on the number of people who can go to the Witch Race territory after the teleportation array is built and based on its frequency.
Then, Han Xing mentioned a few more matters.
And thus, the meeting formally concluded.
Seeing this, the others also gradually dispersed.
In the council hall, only he, Lanlan, and Luo Chan were left.
At this time, Han Xing looked at Lanlan and said, "Are you sure you don’t want to come with us to the Witch Race territory this time?"
Currently, Lanlan has just completed her Third Transformation and is not a particularly powerful presence among the survivors.
He planned to take Lanlan to the Abyssal Rift to grind for a few days and first boost her level.
However, Lanlan shook her head, "Lord, you know my temperament; I don’t quite like fighting."
"I prefer managing everything behind the scenes rather than fighting those monsters upfront."
"At such times, you shouldn’t spend resources or time taking care of us."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was silent for a moment, and his gaze seemed slightly hesitant.
After all, Lanlan truly has helped him a lot.
Beyond aiding her in enhancing her power, Han Xing couldn’t think of any other way to repay her.
Lanlan appeared to sense Han Xing’s dilemma.
She smiled gently.
"Lord, I understand your thoughts; you absolutely don’t need to consider how to repay me."
"Understand that my life was rescued by you."
"Being able to support you from behind is already fulfilling enough."
Upon hearing these words, Han Xing didn’t quite know how to respond.
Lanlan continued to soothe him, "Come now, Lord~"
"Didn’t you say there are still many strong contenders outside, even ones you can’t contend with?"
"What you need to do, Lord, is seize the time to boost your strength, then gradually surpass each of these individuals!"
"Once you become invincible worldwide, then taking me to level up wouldn’t it be quicker?"
Listening to Lanlan’s innocent words, Han Xing laughed.
Achieving such a feat isn’t that simple...
After all, the more he understands now, the more he realizes the world’s dreadful nature.
Surpassing them is practically an impossibility.
However, Han Xing resolutely replied, "Alright, once I’m invincible globally, I’ll bring you along to become invincible too!"
"Yes, yes!" Lanlan nodded fervently in agreement.
After hearing Han Xing’s promise, Lanlan’s eyes became slightly moist.
In order not to let Han Xing notice, she hurriedly stood up.
"Lord, you and Luo Chan can continue your discussion slowly; I’ll head off to handle some matters first."
Han Xing nodded, "Go ahead."
After Lanlan left.
In the council hall, only Han Xing and Luo Chan remained.
At this moment, Luo Chan looked towards the direction Lanlan had gone, chuckling, "Star God, having a woman who will wait for you to become invincible is rather romantic..."
Han Xing nodded, not denying it.
Luo Chan continued with a smile, "However, for a powerhouse such as the Star God, having admirers around is quite normal."
"Every successful powerhouse has a large group of faithful supporters."
"I am also one of the Star God’s supporters."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing turned his head to look at Luo Chan.
Then, staring at the ethereal temperament and the exquisitely features that are not of this world, the stunningly beautiful face.
Facing Han Xing’s gaze, Luo Chan didn’t shy away.
Moreover, she revealed a gentle smile.
If it was an ordinary person, being so close to the Cyan Robed Goddess, coupled with her smile as a killing skill, they might be infatuated on the spot...

sentences.text: "Moreover, the population is astonishingly large."
"There’s also something like a battle merit store; as long as you join the camp, you can benefit from it."
"However, it’s very dangerous.
The war has become so brutal, with the casualties of tens of billions of civilians.
It’s truly horrifying."
Beside him, a male swordsman sighed, "Yes, and there are so many legendary powerhouses!"

"But even such a powerful race is not a match for the Shadow Legion."

Han Xing’s words completely dispelled everyone’s worries.

Luo Chan took the lead, saying, "In that case, only trustworthy people must be allowed to go to the Witch Race territory."

"Naturally, these resources shouldn’t end up in the hands of outsiders!"
These words garnered unanimous approval from everyone.
However, Han Xing didn’t immediately agree.

These are things he still doesn’t know.
They can only decide on the number of people who can go to the Witch Race territory after the teleportation array is built and based on its frequency.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - 296: Sensation, New Map Intelligence!
paragraphs: Facing Luo Chan’s gaze, Han Xing did not react much.
He nodded, "During this period, Xingyu City has greatly benefited from your help."
"Look at what you need, or if you have any requests, feel free to tell me."
Han Xing regards Luo Chan as a very intelligent woman.
The world knows of the unparalleled beauty of the Cyan Robed Goddess, yet few realize that Luo Chan’s wisdom is equally unmatched.
Judging by how she managed to develop Xingyu City’s commerce to this scale in just a few months.
Facing Han Xing’s gratitude, Luo Chan appeared neither overbearing nor self-effacing.
When she heard Han Xing say she could make requests, her eyes lit up.
However, she didn’t show it and instead changed the topic, "Let’s discuss the matter of quotas first."
Han Xing nodded.
"Currently, it is still unknown how many people can be teleported in the first batch."
"But regardless, the personnel in the first batch heading to the Witch Race Territory must be trustworthy."
"Therefore, selection must be made from your Immortal Mansion."
Upon hearing this, Luo Chan lightly nodded again.
Showing neither excitement at being chosen, nor any other emotion, she appeared very calm.
Han Xing didn’t mind and continued explaining.
"However, you still need to inform your subordinates clearly regarding this expedition to the Witch Race Territory. Although I have minimized their risks,"
"There is still a risk of death."
"If they are unwilling to take on this risk, they do not need to be forced."
Luo Chan nodded again, "I understand, Star God."
"Hmm." Han Xing responded.
Then for a moment, Han Xing didn’t know what to say.
Because he had already said everything he needed to.
He thought Luo Chan might make some requests or conditions based on his instructions.
But the other party made no representations, complying one hundred percent with Han Xing’s decisions.
Such obedience left Han Xing a little unaccustomed.
After all, Han Xing knew little about Luo Chan and didn’t know what kind of personality she had.
As if seeing through Han Xing’s thoughts, Luo Chan softly said, "Star God, do you think you don’t understand me well enough now and aren’t sure you can fully trust me?
Hearing this, Han Xing shook his head, saying, "Not at all."
"When employing someone, do not doubt them; if doubting, do not employ. When I allowed you into Xingyu City, it meant that I already trusted you."
"Though, it’s true that I don’t know much about you."
Luo Chan showed a slight smile, and pondered, "I see..."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, Luo Chan suddenly said, "Then may I ask, does Star God have time to take a walk with me now?"
Hearing this request, Han Xing was startled.
Luo Chan continued, "What’s wrong, Star God? Didn’t you say I could make a request to you?"
Looking at her alluring smile mixed with a hint of playfulness.
Han Xing thought he might have fallen into this woman’s scheme.
But it didn’t affect Han Xing much.
He checked the time.
Anyway, there are still ten plus hours to go before the High-Level Teleportation Array is completed.
During this time, he has basically nothing to do.
A little time spent walking with Luo Chan wouldn’t be much of an issue.
Han Xing nodded.
Luo Chan’s smile grew brighter, like a blooming snow lotus on a high mountain.
And then.
Han Xing and Luo Chan stepped out of the Lord’s Mansion together.
By the time they came out, it was already night.
All sorts of lights illuminated the streets.
The entire Xingyu City also arrived at its most beautiful moment.
Especially the central district.
Centered around the Lord’s Mansion, buildings within several kilometers began to emit different lights.
Various warm red light stones and lightstone ribbons, and hidden Flash Stones, Aurora Aggregators.
Making the entire central district feel like it’s held in the palm like stars surrounding the moon.
At this time, many Survivors would specially climb nearby mountains or other tall buildings to take pictures with the central district.
The area near the Lord’s Mansion is also becoming a famous spot for selfies.
Under the night sky.
A pair of handsome men and beautiful women walked side by side down the streets of Xingyu City, attracting countless tourists’ attention.
After all, Luo Chan’s aura was so outstanding.
Standing amidst the crowd, she was like a crane among chickens.
Likewise, her name is equally famous.
Now most Survivors know that Luo Chan is part of Xingyu City’s management.
Also a focus of those patrolling Wolf Cavalry and buildings like Thunderbolt Tower.
If anyone who doesn’t know any better causes trouble, they would quickly be taken away by the Wolf Cavalry.
After several past incidents, not many dared to approach when Luo Chan occasionally appeared in public.
Thus, Han Xing and Luo Chan were not stopped by those tourists.
As they walked, Luo Chan continuously introduced the shops along the street to Han Xing.
Occasionally, she added her own insights and shared recent little tidbits.
Han Xing listened quietly.
Time slowly passed.
The two continued to walk side by side.
From afar, some admirers of the Cyan Robed Goddess noticed her close contact with a man for so long.
This scene immediately crushed their spirits.
Fearful that after tonight, many admirers of the Cyan Robed Goddess would see their dreams shattered.
As they walked, Han Xing surprisingly found out that they had returned in front of the Lord’s Mansion.
At this point, Luo Chan’s voice came, "Alright, Star God, we’ve finished the stroll~"
This surprised Han Xing too.
Unconsciously, the two had strolled throughout the central district.

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - 296: Sensation, New Map Intelligence!
paragraphs: He and Luo Chan had been almost alone together for over two hours.
At this moment, Luo Chan asked, "So now, does the Star God understand this little woman a bit more?"
At this time, Han Xing silently gazed at the fairy-like beautiful woman before him.
Through these two hours, Han Xing had a preliminary understanding of Luo Chan as well.
He found that she wasn’t as aloof and reticent as she appeared.
She exuded a quality that could only be admired from afar.
In reality, Luo Chan was far more talkative than imagined.
Han Xing nodded.
At this moment, Luo Chan suddenly turned around lightly, her legs together.
She tilted her head slightly to one side and smiled sweetly at Han Xing.
"Thank you, Star God."
"I am very happy today."
Han Xing nodded, "You’re welcome."
"If there’s nothing else, let’s call it a day."
"When you get back, discuss it well with your team members."
"Mmm." Luo Chan replied with a light laugh.
Just when they were about to part, suddenly they saw a group of survivors exclaiming in the distance.
"Brothers, look at the chat channel!"
"Kunlun and Huayi Alliance seem to be planning some major action. They’re hyping it up in the chat channel!"
The other survivors were suddenly taken aback.
"Major action? What major action?"
The survivors replied, "Not sure, they say it’s very important. Zhou Huang will announce it personally in the chat channel later!"
Other visitors, hearing this, also quickly opened the chat channel.
Han Xing and Luo Chan exchanged a glance.
"Zhou Huang... what’s he about to do at this time?" Luo Chan murmured.
Han Xing shrugged and said, "I don’t know, let’s go check it out."
"Mmm." Luo Chan murmured a response.
Then, Han Xing clicked open the chat channel.
Those people weren’t wrong.
Now, Zhou Huang had already enabled the mute function in the chat channel.
Aside from a few people who could speak, other survivors could only watch.
Above, Zhou Huang spoke again.
"Fellow human race compatriots, I’m very sorry to disturb you in the middle of the night."
"The fact is, I do have something important, or rather intelligence, to share with you all."
At this moment, the survivor ’Dragon Abyss’, who was granted special permissions.
The leader of Kyushu spoke up, "Director Zhou, we don’t mind this disturbance at this time."
"We just want to know what the intelligence you want to share is?"
Several other large team leaders also chimed in, "Yes, Director Zhou, stop keeping us in suspense, what is this important information?"
"Yeah, yeah.
Seeing everyone’s excited looks.
Zhou Huang replied with a smile, "Everyone, please be patient."
"Next, what I am going to announce—"
"is intelligence regarding the new map, the Witch Race Territory!"
Upon hearing this, the survivors were momentarily silent.
Then, explosive discussions erupted!
"Damn? A new map? Witch Race Territory?"
"My God, it hasn’t been long since the last new map opened, where did Director Zhou get this intelligence?"
This was a question on many people’s minds.
At this time, another survivor nearby said, "Could it be that Director Zhou has already left the Land of the Abandoned Gods and reached the new map?"
This statement made other survivors find it hard to believe as well.
They said somewhat anxiously, "It should... be impossible, right? Didn’t the system say you can only reach the new map, the Witch Race Territory, through the Path of the Giant Dragon?"
"But until now, we still don’t know how to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"Indeed, and I’ve heard the Path of the Giant Dragon is fraught with danger, many people have died halfway through."
"So far, no one has been known to successfully pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon."

At this moment, Zhou Huang seemed to notice the doubt in everyone’s hearts, and with a smile, he said, "You guessed right, I have indeed passed through the Path of the Giant Dragon and reached the Witch Race Territory."
Hearing Zhou Huang’s personal confirmation, the eyes of the billions of survivors chatting in the channel were filled with disbelief.
Dragon Abyss was the first to impatiently ask, "Director Zhou! Have you truly left the Land of the Abandoned Gods?"
Other survivors stared intently at the chat channel, waiting for Zhou Huang’s response.
"Yes." Zhou Huang replied.
"And, it wasn’t just me."
"This time, I ventured into the Witch Race Territory along with Leader Cheng from Kunlun and Brother of the Boundaryless."
A moment later, the Leader of the Boundaryless said faintly, "Indeed."
Hearing their statements.
The survivors were truly convinced at this moment that they had already left the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
And it wasn’t just Zhou Huang!
He had also led another top existence of the human race, the Leader of the Boundaryless, out together.
Dragon Abyss excitedly asked again, "So, Director Zhou, have you mastered the method to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon?"
Even before Zhou Huang could answer.
Several other large team leaders, who were granted permissions, pressed further, "Director Zhou, what kind of place is the Witch Race Territory?"
"Director Zhou, have you had any adventures in the Witch Race Territory?"
"Director Zhou..."
Everyone began asking questions, one after another.
Facing these questions.
Zhou Huang replied with a smile, "I know you’re all very curious, and you have many questions."
"But please be patient, I will address these questions one by one."
"Next, I will start a live broadcast with the Leader of the Boundaryless."
"In this broadcast, I will let everyone witness the wonders of the Witch Race Territory and those precious resources firsthand!"
Upon hearing this, a violent wave arose again among the tens of billions of survivors!
Immediately, countless people flooded into forums and found the ’Huayi Alliance’ live broadcast post.
Once they clicked in, they saw: the live broadcast would start in 30 seconds.
For survivors eager to learn about the Witch Race Territory, thirty seconds felt like an eternity.
But they could only wait in silence.
Meanwhile, as the event quickly escalated.
The news that Zhou Huang was going to broadcast the new map, Witch Race Territory, quickly spread among tens of billions of survivors.
In a short time, the number of viewers in the live broadcast room had surpassed one billion!
And it continued to increase by millions every second.
Seeing that the number of viewers was about right.
Zhou Huang directly clicked to start the broadcast.
At the same time, the live broadcast screen appeared.
On it was Zhou Huang, with his gentle smile.
"Fellow human race, hello, I am Zhou Huang."
"And next to me, someone you are presumably familiar with."
"Is the Leader of Kunlun, the Boundaryless."
Beside Zhou Huang stood a man with a completely different aura.
Through the screen, one could feel the faint killing intent emanating from him.
The Boundaryless gave a slight nod.
Immediately, the live broadcast room was flooded with barrage comments.
"Director Zhou is so handsome!"
"Leader of the Boundaryless is so cool, love it!"
"Quickly, show us what the Witch Race Territory looks like."
At this moment, Zhou Huang, getting straight to the point, said, "You all must want to know what distinguishes the Witch Race Territory from the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"I won’t beat around the bush."
"So, everyone, please have a look."
As soon as Zhou Huang finished speaking.
The camera began to switch.
At this time, the survivors saw a massive sky island in the distance.
On it, there were many towering buildings with diverse styles.
Surrounding this sky island and in the air above, people also saw many Witch Race battleships, as well as various transport ships.
Although they didn’t know the exact strength of these battleships.
However, from the terrifying gun muzzles on the hulls, one could imagine how powerful they were.
These were things that had never appeared in the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
For a moment, all survivors were convinced that Zhou Huang had indeed left the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
In the live broadcast room, the barrage exploded once again.
Zhou Huang smoothly switched the live broadcast view back.
He chuckled lightly and said, "So then, everyone must surely believe that I have left the Land of the Abandoned Gods."

Zhou Huang will announce it personally in the chat channel later!"
Other visitors, hearing this, also quickly opened the chat channel.
Han Xing and Luo Chan exchanged a glance.
"Zhou Huang... what’s he about to do at this time?" Luo Chan murmured.
Han Xing shrugged and said, "I don’t know, let’s go check it out."
"Mmm." Luo Chan murmured a response.
Then, Han Xing clicked open the chat channel.
Those people weren’t wrong.
Now, Zhou Huang had already enabled the mute function in the chat channel.
Aside from a few people who could speak, other survivors could only watch.
Above, Zhou Huang spoke again.
"Fellow human race compatriots, I’m very sorry to disturb you in the middle of the night."
"The fact is, I do have something important, or rather intelligence, to share with you all."
At this moment, the survivor ’Dragon Abyss’, who was granted special permissions.
The leader of Kyushu spoke up, "Director Zhou, we don’t mind this disturbance at this time."
"We just want to know what the intelligence you want to share is?"
Several other large team leaders also chimed in, "Yes, Director Zhou, stop keeping us in suspense, what is this important information?"
"Yeah, yeah.
Seeing everyone’s excited looks.
Zhou Huang replied with a smile, "Everyone, please be patient."
"Next, what I am going to announce—"
"is intelligence regarding the new map, the Witch Race Territory!"
Upon hearing this, the survivors were momentarily silent.
Then, explosive discussions erupted!
"Damn?
A new map?
Witch Race Territory?"
"My God, it hasn’t been long since the last new map opened, where did Director Zhou get this intelligence?"
This was a question on many people’s minds.
At this time, another survivor nearby said, "Could it be that Director Zhou has already left the Land of the Abandoned Gods and reached the new map?"
This statement made other survivors find it hard to believe as well.
They said somewhat anxiously, "It should... be impossible, right?
Didn’t the system say you can only reach the new map, the Witch Race Territory, through the Path of the Giant Dragon?"
"But until now, we still don’t know how to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"Indeed, and I’ve heard the Path of the Giant Dragon is fraught with danger, many people have died halfway through."
"So far, no one has been known to successfully pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon."

At this moment, Zhou Huang seemed to notice the doubt in everyone’s hearts, and with a smile, he said, "You guessed right, I have indeed passed through the Path of the Giant Dragon and reached the Witch Race Territory."
Hearing Zhou Huang’s personal confirmation, the eyes of the billions of survivors chatting in the channel were filled with disbelief.
Dragon Abyss was the first to impatiently ask, "Director Zhou!
Have you truly left the Land of the Abandoned Gods?"
Other survivors stared intently at the chat channel, waiting for Zhou Huang’s response.
"Yes." Zhou Huang replied.
"And, it wasn’t just me."
"This time, I ventured into the Witch Race Territory along with Leader Cheng from Kunlun and Brother of the Boundaryless."
A moment later, the Leader of the Boundaryless said faintly, "Indeed."
Hearing their statements.
The survivors were truly convinced at this moment that they had already left the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
And it wasn’t just Zhou Huang!
He had also led another top existence of the human race, the Leader of the Boundaryless, out together.
Dragon Abyss excitedly asked again, "So, Director Zhou, have you mastered the method to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon?"
Even before Zhou Huang could answer.
Several other large team leaders, who were granted permissions, pressed further, "Director Zhou, what kind of place is the Witch Race Territory?"
"Director Zhou, have you had any adventures in the Witch Race Territory?"
"Director Zhou..."
Everyone began asking questions, one after another.
Facing these questions.
Zhou Huang replied with a smile, "I know you’re all very curious, and you have many questions."
"But please be patient, I will address these questions one by one."
"Next, I will start a live broadcast with the Leader of the Boundaryless."
"In this broadcast, I will let everyone witness the wonders of the Witch Race Territory and those precious resources firsthand!"
Upon hearing this, a violent wave arose again among the tens of billions of survivors!
Immediately, countless people flooded into forums and found the ’Huayi Alliance’ live broadcast post.
Once they clicked in, they saw: the live broadcast would start in 30 seconds.
For survivors eager to learn about the Witch Race Territory, thirty seconds felt like an eternity.
But they could only wait in silence.
Meanwhile, as the event quickly escalated.
The news that Zhou Huang was going to broadcast the new map, Witch Race Territory, quickly spread among tens of billions of survivors.
In a short time, the number of viewers in the live broadcast room had surpassed one billion!
And it continued to increase by millions every second.
Seeing that the number of viewers was about right.
Zhou Huang directly clicked to start the broadcast.
At the same time, the live broadcast screen appeared.
On it was Zhou Huang, with his gentle smile.
"Fellow human race, hello, I am Zhou Huang."
"And next to me, someone you are presumably familiar with."
"Is the Leader of Kunlun, the Boundaryless."
Beside Zhou Huang stood a man with a completely different aura.
Through the screen, one could feel the faint killing intent emanating from him.
The Boundaryless gave a slight nod.
Immediately, the live broadcast room was flooded with barrage comments.
"Director Zhou is so handsome!"
"Leader of the Boundaryless is so cool, love it!"
"Quickly, show us what the Witch Race Territory looks like."
At this moment, Zhou Huang, getting straight to the point, said, "You all must want to know what distinguishes the Witch Race Territory from the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"I won’t beat around the bush."
"So, everyone, please have a look."
As soon as Zhou Huang finished speaking.
The camera began to switch.
At this time, the survivors saw a massive sky island in the distance.
On it, there were many towering buildings with diverse styles.
Surrounding this sky island and in the air above, people also saw many Witch Race battleships, as well as various transport ships.
Although they didn’t know the exact strength of these battleships.
However, from the terrifying gun muzzles on the hulls, one could imagine how powerful they were.
These were things that had never appeared in the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
For a moment, all survivors were convinced that Zhou Huang had indeed left the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
In the live broadcast room, the barrage exploded once again.
Zhou Huang smoothly switched the live broadcast view back.
He chuckled lightly and said, "So then, everyone must surely believe that I have left the Land of the Abandoned Gods."

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - 297: When the Plot Unfolds, Xingyu City Makes a Major Move
paragraphs: "Next, I’ll answer a few questions that you most want to know."
"First, the one you all are most curious about—what exactly is in the new map."
"Or rather, whether it’s worth risking coming out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Zhou Huang asked and answered himself.
"I can tell you all that the Witch Race Territory is definitely worth coming to."
"Firstly, the resources on the Sky Islands here are far richer than those in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"You can see the Sky Island beneath my feet."
"It contains all kinds of precious metal veins and some rare resources, which, if fully extracted, are worth at least a hundred million in Spirit Core value."
"And this is just what the Leader of the Boundaryless and I have gathered in a week."
Everyone looked at the Sky Island beneath Zhou Huang’s feet, eyes filled with shock.
Zhou Huang continued, "And this is just one of the benefits."
"The Witch Race Territory currently holds an even greater opportunity, one much more valuable than those resources on the Sky Islands."
Hearing Zhou Huang’s exaggerated tone, the Survivors couldn’t contain their curiosity and frantically asked in the chat.
"Director Zhou, what exactly is this opportunity?"
"Director Zhou, please tell us quickly."
"Yes, yes..."
Zhou Huang watched as the number of viewers in the livestream continued to grow, a smile appearing on his face.
He said directly, "This opportunity is the ongoing war in the Witch Race Territory!"
"War?"
The Survivors were confused.
At this moment, Han Xing and another person, who were standing together watching Zhou Huang’s livestream, exchanged glances.
They both knew what war Zhou Huang was talking about.
"That’s right!"
Zhou Huang exclaimed, "This war is between the Witch Race and the Shadow Legion!
"Maybe some of you don’t know much about the Witch Race."
"Let me give you a brief introduction to their strength."
"The Witch Race has a total population of several trillion, with over a hundred billion Witch Race soldiers possessing Third and Fourth Transformation combat power."
"Besides these regular soldiers, there are countless elites, leaders, and lords!"
"Of course, this isn’t the most powerful aspect of the Witch Race."
"The strongest part of the Witch Race lies in their high-end combat strength!"
"They have at least twenty Legendary Powerhouses!"
"And this is just my preliminary estimate; in reality, the Witch Race’s powerhouses will only be more numerous."
"I think everyone got a taste of how terrifying a Legend is from the last Blood Tide calamity!"
"A single Legendary Powerhouse is enough to destroy all of humanity on a global scale!"
"And what’s even more terrifying is, according to these Witch Race soldiers, aside from the Legendary Powerhouses, the Witch Race has an even more frightening existence."
"That entity seems to be the Saint Master of the Witch Race!"
Zhou Huang’s series of statements caused the chat, previously scrolling rapidly, to suddenly pause for a moment.
Everyone was overwhelmed by the shocking information Zhou Huang revealed.
Then, the chat exploded once more.
"What the hell! What is Director Zhou saying?"
"The Witch Race has more than twenty Legends? And an even more terrifying Saint Master?"
"So scary! Compared to the Witch Race, our human strength might be wiped out in an instant, right?"
At the same time, Zhou Huang’s words and the intelligence about the Witch Race quickly spread among tens of billions of Survivors.
Everyone was stunned by this information and the Witch Race’s strength.
Before this, they only had a vague understanding of the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
They knew there were indigenous races surviving outside.
But which races they were and how strong they were, these were complete unknowns.
But now, they finally understood.
The Human Race is vastly inferior compared to this world’s indigenous races.
For the other side to annihilate us would be as easy as crushing a bug.
At this moment, Luo Chan suddenly walked to within half a meter of Han Xing and softly asked, "Star God, is what Zhou Huang said true?"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s true."
"This guy does have some skills."
"It’s been only a few days, and he’s almost figured out the overall strength of the Witch Race."
At this moment, Luo Chan suddenly held his breath.
He only told everyone that he had established a cooperative relationship with a Witch Race Main City.
But he did not say that the Witch Race’s overall strength was this terrifying.
So how terrifying is the Shadow Legion, the more powerful enemy of the Witch Race that Han Xing mentioned previously?
In the livestream, Zhou Huang spoke again, "Having said this, all of you should have an initial understanding of the Witch Race’s strength."
"You must think that the Witch Race is already extremely formidable."
"But what I need to tell you all is that the Witch Race’s enemy, the Shadow Legion, is even more terrifying!"
"Not long ago, a war broke out in the Witch Race Territory."
"Under the war, hundreds of billions of civilians died, along with billions of elite soldiers and various war equipment. It’s safe to say that the Witch Race suffered tremendously."
"Even two Legendary Powerhouses fell."
Hearing this, the other Survivors gasped.
"Hiss... so terrifying?"
"What the heck! Is the Witch Race Territory that chaotic?"
"A single death toll in the tens of billions, how does it feel like our Human Race’s numbers aren’t even enough for them to lose in a war?"
"Yeah, even Legendary Powerhouses have fallen; if we go there, we might not even qualify as cannon fodder."
For a time, everyone’s morale seemed a bit low.
At this moment, a message floated through the chat.
"But what’s the connection between this and the opportunity Director Zhou mentioned?"

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - 297: When the Plot Unfolds, Xingyu City Makes a Major Move
paragraphs: This person asked a crucial question.
Over a billion survivors waited eagerly, anticipating Zhou Huang’s answer.
Zhou Huang said at this moment, "Of course, there is a connection."
"You should know that the greater the danger, the greater the opportunity."
"This time, I and the Leader of the Boundaryless were inadvertently caught in a small-scale war. After killing a few shadow monsters, we received a system prompt."
"I have joined the Witch Race camp and have also opened an advanced battle merit store."
"As for the items in the battle merit store, please take a look."
With that said, Zhou Huang posted the rewards from the Witch Race’s exclusive battle merit store.
Over a billion survivors, after reading the attributes of those items, were once again in an uproar.
"Damn! Shadow Rune, Sun Treasure Chest!"
"And what is that high-tier ancient weapon? Just hearing its name is terrifying!"
The survivors were astounded.
The hesitation caused by the enemy’s strength was now reignited with fighting spirit.
They were even eager to head to the Witch Race Territory to participate in the war and exchange for store rewards.
However, there was a question that stood before them, which was how to reach the Witch Race Territory?
Or rather, how to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon?
The live broadcast room’s comments started flooding the screen again.
Faced with the crowd’s inquiries.
Zhou Huang said, "To pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon, a crucial item is needed."
"As for what the item is, I am not at liberty to disclose it at the moment."
"If any survivors wish to come to the Witch Race Territory, they can head to the Huayi Alliance’s territory for detailed discussions."
"As long as you pass our screening and meet the conditions, I will personally give you this crucial item for free and bring you out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Upon hearing this, many survivors felt a stir in their hearts.
Zhou Huang, indeed, was not as selfless as he appeared.
He had his own motives.
This time, he was building momentum for this very situation.
Using the information he had to reap benefits!
For a moment, emotions were heated.
The ordinary survivors were very displeased, but the leaders of large groups expressed understanding.
They asked directly.
"Director Zhou, just tell us, what are the conditions?"
"Do you want resources or blueprints? Name a price, and we’ll see if we can meet it."
"That’s right, Director Zhou, just name your price."
Zhou Huang listened and shook his head with a smile, "You misunderstood. What I want is not resources."
Those people frowned slightly.
Zhou Huang explained at this moment, "Considering that the Witch Race Territory is a high-tier map."
"The minimum condition for this screening is survivors who have completed the Fourth Transformation.
"Also, you need to sign at least a one-year lord contract with our Huayi Alliance."
At this moment, Zhou Huang finally revealed his true purpose.
It turned out that he didn’t want those resources.
What he wanted was people!
Zhou Huang wanted to use this information and the opportunity to enter the Witch Race Territory to recruit another batch of survivors for the Huayi Alliance.
Moreover, since he limited it to those with a strength of Fourth Transformation and above.
At this current stage, those who reach the Fourth Transformation are elites among elites.
Even some are leaders of large groups.
Zhou Huang’s move could be said to be a straightforward approach, directly targeting those large group leaders.
After saying this, without caring about the frantic comments, Zhou Huang directly closed the live broadcast room.
As for how they will choose, it’s up to those elites themselves.
Witch Race Territory, on a small sky island.
Zhou Huang stood at the edge of the sky island, taking a deep breath, smiling as he looked ahead.
Beside him, Mian, with a puzzled expression, asked, "Zhou Huang, are you sure this is okay?"
"If too many Fourth Transformation powerhouses sign the contract this time, where will you get so many Ancient Fires?"
Zhou Huang shook his head with a smile, "Don’t worry, I’ve already looked into it."
"Currently, there are less than a hundred people in all of humanity who have successfully reached Fourth Transformation strength, including you and me."
"Those with this strength are leaders of large groups."
"If they are willing to sign a contract with us to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"Then I wouldn’t hesitate to pay the price to obtain a batch of Ancient Fires."
Mian seemed to understand Zhou Huang’s plan, giving him a deep look.
Zhou Huang continued, "Moreover, we are indeed very short-handed now."
"Relying on just a few of us, it’s difficult to achieve much in this war."
"We might not even be able to exchange for a Bright Moon Treasure Chest."
Mian listened and didn’t argue against Zhou Huang’s decision.
At the same time, those large group leaders also knew that Zhou Huang had set his sights on them.
And he wasn’t too harsh.
He only needed them to sign a one-year lord contract.
This condition is just within their limit of acceptance.
However, if signed, it means they have to follow Zhou Huang’s command for a year.
Their hearts were in a deep entanglement.
On one hand, torn between the opportunities and rewards in the new map.
On the other hand, not wanting to be led by Zhou Huang.
But they also knew it was a rare opportunity.
If they could be among the first few batches to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods,
they would hold all kinds of advantages in the new map.
And all of this is based on agreeing to Zhou Huang’s conditions.
At this moment, large group leaders on several large sky islands were discussing.
A human mage asked, "Everyone, what do you think about pioneering in the new map?"

Beside him, another muscular berserker replied helplessly, "What else is there to think? Zhou Huang, that guy, deliberately started a broadcast to introduce the opportunities in the new map without telling us how to pass the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"This time, he really has us by the throat!"
The others agreed, supporting the berserker’s opinion.
Beside him, a female knight relented, "Do we really have to accept Zhou Huang’s condition and be under his control for a year?"
"Can’t we negotiate for different conditions?"
Beside her, the berserker said again, "It’s no use. Even if we don’t want to, there will be other survivors who completed the Fourth Transformation who will agree."
"By now, many are probably already heading to the Huayi Alliance’s territory."
"Let’s not think about bargaining, didn’t Zhou Huang say the spots are limited?"
"If we’re late, even if we agree, there might be no spots left."
After this berserker spoke, the others’ faces changed.
A sense of urgency suddenly emerged in their hearts.
At the same time, many sky islands began rushing overnight to the Huayi Alliance’s territory.
Late at night.
Xingyu City.
Around this huge city, many small sky islands returned overnight.
The former Immortal Mansion group, a large number of survivors returned.
They all received a message from Luo Chan, saying there was important news to announce, urging nearby combat personnel to return to Xingyu City quickly.
Initially, they didn’t know what important matter Luo Chan was referring to.
Until she repeated Han Xing’s words.
The next moment.
The entire Immortal Mansion and tens of thousands of survivors were in a massive uproar!
If it were before Zhou Huang’s live broadcast.
They wouldn’t know what it meant to go to the Witch Race Territory.
But now, they understood completely.
It is a frightening place filled with endless opportunities!
Didn’t you see how hundreds of millions of survivors in the chat channels were going crazy for those few spots?
Even leaders who have tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands under them were willing to give up their power for those spots.
And now, what have they heard?
The Star God has a way to mass transfer them out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods!
Note, it’s a mass transfer!
When this news gets out, imagine the commotion it will cause?
It’s simply unimaginable!

The others agreed, supporting the berserker’s opinion.
Beside him, a female knight relented, "Do we really have to accept Zhou Huang’s condition and be under his control for a year?"
"Can’t we negotiate for different conditions?"
Beside her, the berserker said again, "It’s no use.
Even if we don’t want to, there will be other survivors who completed the Fourth Transformation who will agree."
"By now, many are probably already heading to the Huayi Alliance’s territory."
"Let’s not think about bargaining, didn’t Zhou Huang say the spots are limited?"
"If we’re late, even if we agree, there might be no spots left."
After this berserker spoke, the others’ faces changed.
A sense of urgency suddenly emerged in their hearts.
At the same time, many sky islands began rushing overnight to the Huayi Alliance’s territory.
Late at night.
Xingyu City.
Around this huge city, many small sky islands returned overnight.
The former Immortal Mansion group, a large number of survivors returned.
They all received a message from Luo Chan, saying there was important news to announce, urging nearby combat personnel to return to Xingyu City quickly.
Initially, they didn’t know what important matter Luo Chan was referring to.
Until she repeated Han Xing’s words.
The next moment.
The entire Immortal Mansion and tens of thousands of survivors were in a massive uproar!
If it were before Zhou Huang’s live broadcast.
They wouldn’t know what it meant to go to the Witch Race Territory.
But now, they understood completely.
It is a frightening place filled with endless opportunities!
Didn’t you see how hundreds of millions of survivors in the chat channels were going crazy for those few spots?
Even leaders who have tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands under them were willing to give up their power for those spots.
And now, what have they heard?
The Star God has a way to mass transfer them out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods!
Note, it’s a mass transfer!
When this news gets out, imagine the commotion it will cause?
It’s simply unimaginable!

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - 298: Assemble and Head to the Witch Race Territory
paragraphs: At the same time, a post quietly climbed to the top of the hot search in the middle of the night.
The title was striking: "Xingyu City Is Taking Major Action, Planning to Mass Transfer Survivors to the Witch Race Territory for Exploration Activities!"
As soon as the post was published, the eye-catching title almost captured the attention of all survivors browsing the forum at this late hour.
Within three minutes, the click count directly broke through the million mark.
They clicked into the post, but found no critical information.
Aside from a title, there was no content in the post.
Moreover, even the poster remained anonymous.
Nevertheless, just the title alone was enough to cause a sensation.
Because it involved Xingyu City.
In the entire Land of the Abandoned Gods, or the largest faction among global humans!
Everything about Xingyu City can draw widespread attention.
Meanwhile.
Those high-level warriors about to head for the Huayi Alliance territory to sign contracts suddenly saw their private messages explode.
Their friends and family were frantically messaging them, recounting the forum post word for word.
At that moment, a muscle-bound Berserker frowned and asked, "Is the source of the information reliable?"
The other party quickly responded, "I don’t know, but everyone is discussing it now, so we’re not sure if it’s true."
"What about the Star God? Has there been any direct response?"
The person replied again, "No, the Star God has kept private chats with strangers closed, we can’t reach him."
Upon hearing this, the Berserker’s brows furrowed even tighter.
"Then get in touch with other people from Xingyu City. Their management should know some inside information."
"By the way, I remember the Cyan Robed Goddess has moved her entire Immortal Mansion into Xingyu City, right?"
"With her status, she should know some insider news, right?"
The others also showed thoughtful expressions.
For a moment, a large group of high-level warriors preparing to head to the Huayi Alliance territory halted at this point.
Moreover, as the post continued to ferment.
In just half an hour, it soared to the top of the hot search.
At this moment, Zhou Huang, who initially thought he could assuredly absorb a large number of elite members this time, was dumbfounded.
He stood dazed on the spot with Boundless, eyes full of shock.
Boundless looked at Zhou Huang, asking, "Do you think the content of this post is true?"
Zhou Huang’s face instantly became very grim.
"It’s probably not baseless. Since someone posted it, it probably means it’s true."
"Moreover, no one from Xingyu City has come forward to refute it."
Upon hearing this, Boundless furrowed his brows even deeper.
The sudden post completely disrupted the duo’s plans.
Boundless asked, "Regarding the method for mass transmission, what do you think it is?"
Zhou Huang’s mind was busy deducing, combining various information.
After a moment, he slowly said, "If I’m not mistaken, it should be the high-level teleportation array blueprint rewarded on the last Blood Tide battle merit list."
"Star River may very likely have constructed it at this time."
Both showed a bitter smile.
"Star River..."
"Alas... Star River."
They sighed helplessly.
At this moment, Han Xing was unaware of what had happened later.
Even if he knew, he wouldn’t care.
The next day.
Han Xing had just awakened from his slumber when he received a system alert.
"Your territory building, the High-Level Teleportation Array, has been successfully constructed..."
At the moment he heard the alert, Han Xing’s figure flashed and appeared at the site where he had built the high-level teleportation array the day before.
Originally, on that vacant ground.
There appeared six large teleportation arrays each occupying more than one hundred square meters.
In front of Han Xing appeared the attributes of the teleportation array.
[High-Level Teleportation Array]
[Defense Value]: 10000
[Building Effect]: Can transfer 100 people across spaces to the area of the high-level teleportation array, with a teleportation cooldown of 300 seconds.
"Notice: For cross-space teleportation, 10,000 spirit cores are required to replenish the array’s energy."
Upon seeing the attributes of the teleportation array, Han Xing instantly clenched his fist.
"Excellent! Only five minutes of cooldown!"
"This is far shorter than I expected!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but feel excited.
Based on the currently constructed six high-level teleportation arrays.
One array can transfer nearly 30,000 people a day.
Six of them can transfer more than 170,000 people!
This far exceeded Han Xing’s expectations.
Initially, he thought that transferring 10,000 people a day would be quite good.
But now, it surpassed by more than tenfold.
In this way, Han Xing no longer needed to hold back.
He could directly transfer the survivors of Xingyu City to the Witch Race Territory.
Although each teleport requires 10,000 spirit cores.
For Han Xing, it is a mere trifle.
At this time, Han Xing sent a message to Luo Chan.
"It can start now."
"However, the plan has changed; the number of people that can be transferred far exceeds the previously estimated number."
"Call everyone who wants to go to the new map over."
Upon hearing this, Luo Chan’s expression immediately brightened.
Last night, ever since Luo Chan conveyed Han Xing’s intention, the survivors of the Immortal Mansion were ecstatic.
But when Luo Chan said that this time the quota might not be much.
The survivors became somewhat nervous.
They began relentlessly messaging Luo Chan to try to be selected for the first batch of the transfer list.
Moreover, as the post’s popularity remained high.
Not only the survivors within the Immortal Mansion but countless survivors from outside were also frantically messaging Luo Chan.

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - 298: Assemble and Head to the Witch Race Territory
paragraphs: They had long known that the Immortal Mansion had been annexed into Xingyu City.
And previously, the leader of the Immortal Mansion, Luo Chan, also held considerable authority within Xingyu City.
Luo Chan was overwhelmed by these private messages.
In the end, she could only uniformly respond, saying the quotas were limited and priority needed to be given to their own people.
Now, hearing Han Xing say that the number of people who could be teleported far exceeded the previous estimation, Luo Chan was overjoyed.
Because in this way, even if they couldn’t take into account those outsiders.
At least, most of the survivors within the Immortal Mansion could be teleported out.
Luo Chan excitedly said, "Alright, Star God, I’ll notify them to come over immediately!"
At the same time.
A large number of Immortal Mansion survivors received the news and began crazily flocking to Han Xing’s location.
Rumble!
The whole of Xingyu City seemed to feel a slight tremor.
Hundreds of thousands of survivors were running wildly through the streets.
The other tourists, seeing their excited expressions, asked curiously, "Brother, what’s happening? Why are you running?"
"Yeah, where are you going?"
The Immortal Mansion survivor who was grabbed quickly broke free, "Damn, don’t hold me back!"
"The Star God is taking us to the Witch Race Territory!"
"If we’re late, there won’t be any spots left in the first batch, let go of me now!"
Hearing this, the tourists’ expressions changed dramatically.
Although the post last night had made many aware of the mass teleportation method in Xingyu City,
due to the lack of definite evidence, they remained skeptical.
But now, hearing it confirmed by members of the Immortal Mansion.
This effectively confirmed their suspicions.
The Star God, who had disappeared for months, had returned!
Moreover, he was taking a large group to the new map.
Many began to follow the maddened crowd, converging on a certain area of Xingyu City.
It wasn’t just the tourists inside Xingyu City.
Since last night.
Various large Sky Islands had been rushing towards Xingyu City.
Now, the sky around Xingyu City was almost filled with various Sky Islands.
Countless survivors were scrambling, fearing they’d be a step behind.
When the crowd arrived at their destination, they saw tens of thousands of towering Minotaurs forming a circle, sealing off the entire open space.
However, the surging crowd was too frantic.
They saw the crowd ahead blocking their view and couldn’t see what was happening in front.
Each person pushed, seemingly trying to break through the Minotaurs’ defense.
However, just at this moment.
The Minotaurs suddenly snorted hotly from their noses and grunted coldly.
"Hmph..."
They lowered the totems on their shoulders in unison and slammed them heavily onto the ground.
Rumble!
A strong tremor spread out for dozens of miles like rippling water.
With over ten thousand Fourth-Turn Elite Level Minotaurs, they could easily wipe out a survivor army of hundreds of thousands!
Terror descended suddenly.
Instantly, all the survivors felt a chill.
At this time, one Minotaur, towering twenty meters like a muscular giant, coldly said, "Take another step forward, and you’ll be killed without mercy!"
All the survivors froze, then looked in fear at the tall figure.
This was the first time they’d seen these Minotaurs on Xingyu City in action.
They had only known their strength before but didn’t know the specifics of their power.
Now, seeing that Minotaur, like a mountain of muscle, revealing a trace of its aura.
"Lord! A Lord-level monster above the Fourth Transformation!"
The survivors exclaimed in shock!
"Holy shit, there are Lord-level creatures in Xingyu City!"
"It’s terrifying, how did the Star God manage this? With a Fourth-Turn Lord like this, they could run rampant in the Land of the Abandoned Gods!"
"Look closely, it’s not just one Lord, but many, my god!"
With this reminder, they also noticed that among the Minotaurs, there were a dozen creatures whose size was not weaker than that Lord!
At this moment, the survivors had a more profound understanding of Xingyu City’s strength.
It was unfathomable!
This was the first public appearance of Lord-Level Minotaurs. Previously, whenever Xingyu City encountered trouble, those were dealt with by the Wolf Cavalry.
But now, they discovered that Xingyu City had even more terrifying units.
Besides Minotaurs, who knows what other powerful forces Xingyu City might be hiding?
The survivors gulped with difficulty, none dared to take another step forward.
They looked at the backs of the Minotaurs and saw those gigantic teleportation arrays glowing with a faint light.
A few survivors tentatively said, "Look, behind those Minotaurs, are those Teleportation Arrays?"
Following the gaze of the speaker, the crowd focused their eyes, their pupils shrinking.
"Whoa, they really are Teleportation Arrays!"
"These teleportation arrays look extraordinary, much larger than basic and intermediate ones!"
"Do you think these might be the legendary High-Level Teleportation Arrays?"
On hearing this, the others seemed to remember something.
"It’s very likely!"
"I remember, during the Blood Tide period, the first-place reward on the Battle Merit list included a blueprint for a High-Level Teleportation Array."
"I didn’t expect the Star God to have built it so quickly!"
Meanwhile, the news of six High-Level Teleportation Arrays at the corners of Xingyu City traveled spontaneously.
Thirty thousand teleportation arrays throughout Xingyu City lit up simultaneously.
More and more survivors crazily surged into Xingyu City.
The grand spectacle even surpassed the first day Xingyu City opened!
The terrifying crowd started converging towards a single place.
Very quickly, the surrounding area of the open space was packed tight.
In less than five minutes, at least tens of millions gathered in the same place.
Dozens of nearby streets were teeming with people.
Many shops were so scared by the surging crowd that they simply closed up.
Despite this.
Every moment.
A large number of survivors were still constantly pouring into Xingyu City.
But those survivors who arrived later couldn’t squeeze in.
Moreover, with Xingyu City prohibiting flight.
No survivor was allowed to use flying equipment to fly over the city.
So they could only stare blankly at the back of others’ heads.
Those survivors were filled with curiosity and longing!
Eager to push to the front for a closer look.
However, no matter how impulsive they were, none dared to challenge the Minotaur’s defense line to forcefully enter the teleportation arrays.
To maintain order, Han Xing not only brought over a large number of Minotaurs.
The Wolf Cavalry Guard also began to mobilize.
A group of Wolf Cavalry, holding silver swords and standing two meters tall, marched in unison, quickly dispersing the crowd.
With such a large number of troops, the chaotic scene finally saw some relief.
At this moment.
On the roof of a building near this street.
Han Xing and Luo Chan stood side by side.
Seeing the crowded scene below, Luo Chan opened her mouth, then looked at Han Xing.
"Star... Star God, I didn’t expect this to happen."
"I’m sorry..."
At that moment, she looked like a little girl who had done something wrong, apologizing to Han Xing.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "It’s okay, it doesn’t matter if they know, after all, the teleportation array’s authority is with me."
"Without my permission, they can’t teleport over."
Luo Chan sighed in relief upon hearing this.
At this time, Han Xing said, "I’ll head out first."
Luo Chan nodded.
In the next moment, Han Xing summoned the Oracle Throne, and in a flash, he vanished from his spot.
Meanwhile.
A group of survivors seemed to sense something and looked up together.
In mid-air.
A luxurious throne, encrusted with gems, floated.
That throne emitted an extremely powerful and majestic aura, inspiring awe at a glance.
Sitting on it was a young man with a longbow, exuding extraordinary charisma.
Seeing that familiar figure.
Below, someone immediately exclaimed.
"Star God!"

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - 299: Han Xing’s Terms
paragraphs: Everyone immediately recognized that the man was the renowned Star River!
At the same time, other survivors gasped in amazement.
"Wow, should I say as expected of a Star God? This entrance, is just too cool!"
"Guys, what is that throne, equipment or an item? It’s just too awesome!"
"If I had such a cool throne, I’d gladly be a servant to the Star God!"
"Don’t even think about it, even if you wanted to be a servant, they might not even consider you..."
To be honest, if possible, Han Xing wouldn’t want to make such a flashy entrance.
But there were simply too many people below; walking in was out of the question.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced at the crowd below, immediately stirring cheers from them.
"Star God, look at me! I’m your little fanboy!"
"Star God, take me with you to the new map, I’m willing to sign a Lord Contract with you!"
"And me, our whole group is willing to merge into Xingyu City!"
Han Xing didn’t answer right away, but slowly said, "Please calm down, I understand your feelings."
"And I know you’re all eager to seek various opportunities on the new map."
Below, a group of survivors lifted their heads, watching Han Xing intently.
Han Xing continued, "What I need to tell you is that going to the Witch Race Territory is not like picking up money."
"I think you all should know; the Witch Race Territory is currently in a state of war."
"And going to the Witch Race Territory means you have to participate in the war!"
"In such a war between large factions, we may not even be considered cannon fodder."
"You should think carefully."
Han Xing’s serious tone instantly silenced the noisy crowd below.
Indeed, they were only thinking about the opportunities on the new map.
But they hadn’t considered the potential crises on the new map.
And now, Han Xing’s words woke them up.
At this time, a survivor cautiously asked, "Star God, does going to the Witch Race Territory mean we have to fight?"
This question was also on the minds of many others.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "No, but if you want to use my Teleportation Array to go to the Witch Race Territory, you have to fight."
"Of course, you can also use other methods, such as the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"But I can tell you, once the war fully erupts, it won’t matter where you hide; you’ll still be affected."
These words immediately caused a difficult expression on many survivors’ faces.
They hadn’t expected this.
Zhou Huang hadn’t told them this.
Ignoring the conflicted faces of the survivors.
Han Xing looked at another group, those who had already signed a Lord Contract with Xingyu City.
"And you, all the survivors who have signed a contract with Xingyu City."
"Taking you to the Witch Race Territory is not for relaxation, but to truly engage in war."
"Death is also inevitable."
"I give you ten seconds to consider."
"If you don’t want to go, turn around and leave now."
This sentence wasn’t directed at the ordinary survivors, but at those who had already signed contracts with Xingyu City.
This time, Han Xing would give them a lot of help.
Not only would they join the Witch Race army, but they would also receive support of various troops.
Just as Luo Chan had said before, since they’ve enjoyed Han Xing’s resources, they should contribute in return.
If these people could survive the war, it would be a transformative rebirth.
In the future, they might become the backbone of Xingyu City.
And Han Xing would invest more resources to cultivate them.
Of course, these were his own thoughts and not spoken out loud.
Han Xing silently counted down.
Suddenly, a large group of people turned around and left.
Among them, most were ordinary survivors, but some were from Xingyu City.
Although it seemed like a lot, compared to the number of survivors staying, it was insignificant.
Han Xing glanced around; the ones who left numbered about tens of thousands.
But the contracted survivors were less than a thousand.
Han Xing showed a satisfied smile, "Very well, the first batch on the list of survivors step forward!"
With those words.
Tens of thousands of survivors stepped out of the crowd.
They wore expressions of pride and arrogance.
As the earliest batch to sign a Lord Contract, they had consistently performed well even in the Immortal Mansion.
After coming to Xingyu City, they also brought significant benefits to Han Xing.
And Luo Chan hadn’t forgotten them either.
When Han Xing asked Luo Chan to put together a list, they were naturally the first ones selected.
Looking at the envious gazes of the other survivors, they felt a surge of pride about joining Xingyu City!
The gaze they cast toward the man in the sky was filled with admiration and respect.
Han Xing nodded, "Very well, begin queueing now for the first teleportation."
"Each batch consists of six hundred people, with a teleportation occurring every five minutes."
Now, the survivors almost instinctively heeded Han Xing’s words.
They quickly formed into orderly lines.
At this time, other survivors couldn’t help asking, "Star God, what about us?"
Others echoed, "Yeah, Star God, we also want to go to the Witch Race Territory. If it’s war, so be it, we’re willing!"
"Yeah, yeah!"
Han Xing replied then, "According to the previous rules, if you want to use the High-Level Teleportation Array, you must first sign a Lord Contract with me."
