chapters.title: Chapter 411 - 299: Han Xing’s Terms_2
paragraphs: "However, your teleportation sequence will be pushed to the back."
Han Xing finished speaking.
The Survivors all responded, "We have no problem, Star God, waiting a few more days is fine."
"That’s right, I’m willing too!"
Han Xing nodded.
Since these people agreed, he said nothing more.
"Alright, those interested, go to the Lord’s Mansion now and find the administrators of Xingyu City to sign the Lord Contract."
"Your names will be recorded there."
"Once the people ahead of you are teleported, then it’s your turn."
"In the meantime, everyone please wait temporarily in Xingyu City."
With that, Han Xing no longer looked at their reactions and directly stepped into one of the Teleportation Arrays.
He was going to lead this first group to Ten Thousand Stars City.
As sixty thousand Spirit Cores were cast in, the light from the six Teleportation Arrays shone brightly.
It enveloped Han Xing, Luo Chan, and six hundred others altogether.
A system prompt appeared in everyone’s ears.
"Cross-space teleportation in progress..."
The faces of these Survivors lit up with joy.
Then, all at once, everything went black before their eyes.
In the midst of Chaos, they had no idea how long they experienced.
It felt like mere seconds, yet also like a century...
When their vision returned, they found themselves in an unfamiliar city.
Here, it also seemed to be a Sky Island, with an impressive size.
However, its style contrasted sharply with that of Xingyu City.
If every corner of Xingyu City was filled with a living atmosphere,
then this Sky Island was permeated with a deadly air.
Everywhere stood massive structures and Defense Towers emitting a dangerous aura.
In the sky, massive creatures with lion heads and snake bodies occasionally swept overhead.
Meanwhile, in the streets, Minotaurs carrying Totems walked in groups.
In the distance, squads of Wolf Cavalry, accompanied by peculiar golden chariots, were conducting training.
Not only were the Survivors from the Immortal Mansion stunned,
even Luo Chan felt somewhat shocked.
With a slightly trembling voice, she asked, "Star... Star God, is this Sky Island also yours?"
Han Xing nodded, "Mm, a newly developed Sky Island after coming to the Witch Race Territory."
"Is there a problem?" Han Xing asked.
Luo Chan shook her head, "No."
"I just thought that the defense capabilities of Xingyu City were already strong enough..."
"Now, I realize that compared to this new Sky Island of the Star God’s, it’s nothing at all."
"Since leaving the Land of the Abandoned Gods, Star God has rarely paid attention to Xingyu City over there."
Her tone carried a hint of resentment.
Han Xing was taken aback.
After a moment, he shook his head and said, "It’s not that I haven’t been paying attention to Xingyu City."
"It’s just that I believed at this stage Xingyu City’s defenses were adequate."
"And besides, wasn’t it true that I couldn’t go back then?"
Han Xing didn’t know why he explained so much to Luo Chan.
It was like a husband who hasn’t returned home for a long time, getting discovered by the mistress.
Luo Chan chuckled softly, "I see."
Han Xing nodded, then turned to look at the first batch of Survivors who had been teleported over.
"Wait here for a while first."
"When the numbers are sufficient tomorrow, I will take you to contact the Witch Race."
Then, Han Xing said to Luo Chan, "Come with me."
Luo Chan softly agreed.
Then she followed Han Xing gracefully as they walked away.
At that moment, a voice filled with tension and excitement reached Han Xing’s ears from behind.
"Star... Star God!"
Hearing the call, Han Xing turned around to see a knight, aged twenty-five or twenty-six, dressed in Silver Heavy Armor.
"Is there something you need?" Han Xing asked.
The Heavy Armor Knight said, "Star God, I wanted to ask, what are those things that the Wolf Cavalry are controlling?"
Following his pointing direction, the group saw a troop of Wolf Cavalry gathered around more than a dozen golden chariots, taking turns to control them.
Han Xing replied, "Demon Elephant War Chariots, a powerful war weapon."
"If controlled well, they can be on par with a Four-star Lord."
Hearing this, the pupils of the Survivors instantly contracted.
This was the first time they heard of such a terrifying thing.
By controlling these chariots, one could even directly possess the power to rival a Fourth-turn Lord!
For a moment, their eyes burned as they looked at the Wolf Cavalry.
At this point, the Heavy Armor Knight tentatively asked, "Star... Star God, may I control such a weapon?"
Upon hearing this, the nearby Survivors looked at the man with an expression as if they had seen a ghost.
It must be said, he had quite the courage to ask the Star God this question.
Even Han Xing was somewhat surprised as he gazed at him.
The male knight hastily explained, "Star God, please don’t misunderstand, before crossing into this world, I was in a special flight unit, although I was in reserve, I do have flying experience."
"So I thought, since this thing can fly, it’s probably similar to controlling a fighter jet."
Han Xing was intrigued, and he asked, "What’s your name?"
This young knight quickly replied, "Shu, Shu Jun!"
Han Xing nodded, "Alright, once you hit Fourth Transformation, I’ll permit you to control a Demon Elephant War Chariot."
"Perform well, and I’ll give you a special chariot task force in the future!"
This young knight named Shu Jun was overjoyed!
Other Survivors looking at him bore expressions of envy.
"Thank you, Star God!" Shu Jun exclaimed with excitement.
Han Xing nodded, then, accompanied by Luo Chan, arrived at the Lord’s Mansion in Ten Thousand Stars City.
Cheng Jianyong and others had been waiting there.
When they saw the celestial figure behind Han Xing, they were momentarily stunned.
Although they already knew that Luo Chan, along with the entire Immortal Mansion, had merged into Xingyu City,
they didn’t expect Han Xing to bring her along this time upon his return.
After Han Xing introduced everyone to one another, he explained his plan.
"Next, Luo Chan will manage all the Survivors from the Land of the Abandoned Gods in Ten Thousand Stars City."
"During this time, let’s spare some time to help her level up, get her Level up first."
Upon hearing this, everyone exchanged smiles.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong took the lead, volunteering, "No problem, we’ll make sure Fairy Luo Chan levels up like a rocket."
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng also said, "Fairy Luo Chan is so beautiful, join us in fighting monsters in the future!"
Su Xiaoyang also nodded excitedly.
Faced with everyone’s enthusiasm, Luo Chan wore a gentle smile on her face.
"Thank you all."
However, she shook her head and declined, "Star God, it’s not necessary to go to such trouble."
"I came to Ten Thousand Stars City with you, not to have you help me level up."
"Hm?" Han Xing looked at her, puzzled.
Luo Chan then said, "This time, my purpose is to lead the Survivors of Xingyu City and join the war together."
Now, it was Han Xing’s turn to be stunned.
Joining the war meant going to the frontlines.
At that time, Han Xing couldn’t take care of her.
Han Xing asked in confusion, "Are you sure this is the result of your consideration?"
"You must know that the battlefield is very dangerous, and a single misstep could lead to a life-threatening crisis."
"At that point, even I wouldn’t be able to rescue you in time."
Listening to these words, Luo Chan’s eyes did not show any fear.
Instead, she replied firmly, "I’ve thought it over, Star God."
"I am not afraid of danger, nor am I the vase they think I am."
"Before I met the Star God, I single-handedly built up the Immortal Mansion power."
Han Xing said nothing further.
For indeed, as Luo Chan mentioned,
she was not just some vase.
On the contrary, Luo Chan was also a very strong-willed woman.
To have her do nothing and sponge off experience by following Han Xing would probably be unacceptable to Luo Chan.
Han Xing nodded, "Alright."
Luo Chan displayed a serene smile.
"Then I won’t disturb you any longer, Star God."
Finishing her words, Luo Chan quietly exited the Lord’s Mansion and went to join the Survivors of Xingyu City.
The five exchanged a glance but said nothing more.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - 300: The Lunatics from Blue Star
paragraphs: This day.
The six teleportation arrays between Ten Thousand Stars City and Xingyu City were continuously operational.
Every five minutes, they transported six hundred survivors.
They remained quite honest, not moving around recklessly.
As the number of people increased.
Han Xing instructed them to set up camps on the spot and rest.
Unlike Xingyu City, Ten Thousand Stars City did not have many houses available for living.
However, no one complained.
Soon, the batch of survivors transported over began to set up their camps, start fires, and chatted together.
The five of Han Xing seized the time to continue swiftly clearing the Abyssal Rifts.
As each monster fell at their feet.
Their experience bars steadily increased.
With the aid of the Spiritual Absorption Secret Elixir, along with the milestone bonus from the Human Race.
Originally estimated to take three to four months to reach level 50.
Now, it only takes two to three months.
Time quickly advanced to two days later.
After two days of teleportation.
Over 300,000 survivors had already gathered in Ten Thousand Stars City.
And this was nearly half of the combat personnel from the Immortal Mansion.
Han Xing looked at the number of people, feeling the time was right.
Thus, he began to manipulate Ten Thousand Stars City to slowly descend.
When Ten Thousand Stars City descended from the high sky, passing through layers of clouds, the view suddenly opened up.
At this moment, the survivors finally saw the massive Witch Race Main City, almost comparable to land in size.
They couldn’t help but marvel at the diverse styles and shapes of the buildings.
As Ten Thousand Stars City continued to descend, it covered the land like a dark cloud.
However, even as this massive Sky Island was about to approach the Witch Race Main City, it did not trigger any defense tower mechanisms.
Han Xing’s current authority was equivalent to Wu Ling’Er’s personal presence.
Even if he bombarded the Witch Race Sky Island, it wouldn’t provoke retaliation from its defense towers.
Ten Thousand Stars City had a vast territory.
Fortunately, the Witch Race Main City was even larger.
He quickly found a place to land.
A relatively intact plain.
A few kilometers away, there was a dense crowd gathered on that plain.
Below.
Personally led by the main city’s commander, Kathy.
A million elite Witch Race soldiers had already lined up.
Beside Kathy, a Witch Race male officer in his early forties quietly asked, "Commander Kathy, this time Lord Han Xing said he wants to embed tens of thousands of humans into my Eighth Legion."
"These tens of thousands of people lack battlefield experience, can this work?"
Kathy glanced at him and said, "No need to worry about that."
"You just need to remember, when war comes, it doesn’t matter whose people they are, just follow the military rules."
After speaking, Kathy added, "This is also Lord Han Xing’s order."
Hearing this, the male officer sighed with relief.
He was quite worried that the group Han Xing brought over would be a bunch of naive rookies.
If a war really broke out.
He would have to worry about taking care of them, which would be troublesome.
But now, with Kathy’s reply, the officer felt a little more at ease.
While he was pondering over these things.
Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City had already landed.
Kathy and the Witch Race officer came up first, respectfully saying, "Greetings, Lord Han Xing."
At the same time.
Seeing their commander salute, the million Witch Race soldiers behind them all performed a standard Witch Race military salute.
A million pairs of eyes simultaneously looked at Han Xing, filled with gratitude and fervor!
This scene left the thirty-plus thousand survivors behind Han Xing with puzzled expressions.
Even Luo Chan seemed a bit confused about the situation.
They initially thought that Han Xing and the Witch Race Main City were merely in a cooperative relationship.
Perhaps Han Xing was dependent on this behemoth of a power.
Some even said that Han Xing must have used significant resources to merge them into the Witch Race’s army.
But now, it seemed that the situation was somewhat reversed?
These two figures, who clearly held high status within the Witch Race, were now respectfully saluting Han Xing.
This scene directly overturned everyone’s understanding.
The survivors from Xingyu City had gained a deeper appreciation of Han Xing’s abilities.
Han Xing nodded and said, "These people behind me are now in your hands."
"As we discussed before, no need for special treatment; their abilities are not weak."
Commander Kathy and the other Witch Race officer nodded in agreement.
Then.
At Han Xing’s signal.
The more than 300,000 survivors joined the Witch Race’s army grandly.
At this time, Han Xing said to Kathy, "Right, besides them, I will provide you with an aerial unit consisting of 100,000 Wolf Cavalry and Big-beaked Birds."
"Also, 5,000 Chimeras, 100,000 Minotaurs, and 200,000 ground-based Wolf Cavalry."
Han Xing provided them with over 400,000 troops in total.
These 400,000 troops were not ordinary units.
All of them were Fourth Transformation, with many elites and leaders among them, and even several lords.
If a real battle were to occur, they could match the million Witch Race soldiers of the Eighth Legion evenly.
Although Han Xing mentioned not to give special treatment to these survivors.
There was no need to pressure them excessively either.
Some things, if overdone, could have counterproductive effects.
If casualties were too high, it would contradict Han Xing’s original intention.
After dealing with these matters.
Han Xing no longer intervened in the affairs of the army.
He trusted that Kathy would handle it well.
Then.
He manipulated Ten Thousand Stars City to move back into the high sky above the Witch Race Main City.
Next, he continued to lead the group to swiftly tackle the Abyssal Rifts.

sentences.text: This day.
The six teleportation arrays between Ten Thousand Stars City and Xingyu City were continuously operational.
Every five minutes, they transported six hundred survivors.
They remained quite honest, not moving around recklessly.
As the number of people increased.
Han Xing instructed them to set up camps on the spot and rest.
Unlike Xingyu City, Ten Thousand Stars City did not have many houses available for living.
However, no one complained.
Soon, the batch of survivors transported over began to set up their camps, start fires, and chatted together.
The five of Han Xing seized the time to continue swiftly clearing the Abyssal Rifts.
As each monster fell at their feet.
Their experience bars steadily increased.
With the aid of the Spiritual Absorption Secret Elixir, along with the milestone bonus from the Human Race.
Originally estimated to take three to four months to reach level 50.
Now, it only takes two to three months.
Time quickly advanced to two days later.
After two days of teleportation.
Over 300,000 survivors had already gathered in Ten Thousand Stars City.
And this was nearly half of the combat personnel from the Immortal Mansion.
Han Xing looked at the number of people, feeling the time was right.
Thus, he began to manipulate Ten Thousand Stars City to slowly descend.
When Ten Thousand Stars City descended from the high sky, passing through layers of clouds, the view suddenly opened up.
At this moment, the survivors finally saw the massive Witch Race Main City, almost comparable to land in size.
They couldn’t help but marvel at the diverse styles and shapes of the buildings.
As Ten Thousand Stars City continued to descend, it covered the land like a dark cloud.
However, even as this massive Sky Island was about to approach the Witch Race Main City, it did not trigger any defense tower mechanisms.
Han Xing’s current authority was equivalent to Wu Ling’Er’s personal presence.
Even if he bombarded the Witch Race Sky Island, it wouldn’t provoke retaliation from its defense towers.
Ten Thousand Stars City had a vast territory.
Fortunately, the Witch Race Main City was even larger.
He quickly found a place to land.
A relatively intact plain.
A few kilometers away, there was a dense crowd gathered on that plain.
Below.
Personally led by the main city’s commander, Kathy.
A million elite Witch Race soldiers had already lined up.
Beside Kathy, a Witch Race male officer in his early forties quietly asked, "Commander Kathy, this time Lord Han Xing said he wants to embed tens of thousands of humans into my Eighth Legion."
"These tens of thousands of people lack battlefield experience, can this work?"
Kathy glanced at him and said, "No need to worry about that."
"You just need to remember, when war comes, it doesn’t matter whose people they are, just follow the military rules."
After speaking, Kathy added, "This is also Lord Han Xing’s order."
Hearing this, the male officer sighed with relief.
He was quite worried that the group Han Xing brought over would be a bunch of naive rookies.
If a war really broke out.
He would have to worry about taking care of them, which would be troublesome.
But now, with Kathy’s reply, the officer felt a little more at ease.
While he was pondering over these things.
Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City had already landed.
Kathy and the Witch Race officer came up first, respectfully saying, "Greetings, Lord Han Xing."
At the same time.
Seeing their commander salute, the million Witch Race soldiers behind them all performed a standard Witch Race military salute.
A million pairs of eyes simultaneously looked at Han Xing, filled with gratitude and fervor!
This scene left the thirty-plus thousand survivors behind Han Xing with puzzled expressions.
Even Luo Chan seemed a bit confused about the situation.
They initially thought that Han Xing and the Witch Race Main City were merely in a cooperative relationship.
Perhaps Han Xing was dependent on this behemoth of a power.
Some even said that Han Xing must have used significant resources to merge them into the Witch Race’s army.
But now, it seemed that the situation was somewhat reversed?
These two figures, who clearly held high status within the Witch Race, were now respectfully saluting Han Xing.
This scene directly overturned everyone’s understanding.
The survivors from Xingyu City had gained a deeper appreciation of Han Xing’s abilities.
Han Xing nodded and said, "These people behind me are now in your hands."
"As we discussed before, no need for special treatment; their abilities are not weak."
Commander Kathy and the other Witch Race officer nodded in agreement.
Then.
At Han Xing’s signal.
The more than 300,000 survivors joined the Witch Race’s army grandly.
At this time, Han Xing said to Kathy, "Right, besides them, I will provide you with an aerial unit consisting of 100,000 Wolf Cavalry and Big-beaked Birds."
"Also, 5,000 Chimeras, 100,000 Minotaurs, and 200,000 ground-based Wolf Cavalry."
Han Xing provided them with over 400,000 troops in total.
These 400,000 troops were not ordinary units.
All of them were Fourth Transformation, with many elites and leaders among them, and even several lords.
If a real battle were to occur, they could match the million Witch Race soldiers of the Eighth Legion evenly.
Although Han Xing mentioned not to give special treatment to these survivors.
There was no need to pressure them excessively either.
Some things, if overdone, could have counterproductive effects.
If casualties were too high, it would contradict Han Xing’s original intention.
After dealing with these matters.
Han Xing no longer intervened in the affairs of the army.
He trusted that Kathy would handle it well.
Then.
He manipulated Ten Thousand Stars City to move back into the high sky above the Witch Race Main City.
Next, he continued to lead the group to swiftly tackle the Abyssal Rifts.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - 300: Lunatics from Blue Star (Part 2)
paragraphs: The survivors who joined the Witch Race Legion were quickly dispatched to the battlefield under various arrangements.
However, according to the contract.
Their gains, 30% must be handed over to Han Xing.
Among these gains is the Shadow Crystal.
With these hundreds of thousands of survivors, each war brings them many Shadow Crystals.
Next, the six teleportation arrays in Ten Thousand Stars City never stopped for a moment.
They have been operating at high speed 24 hours a day.
Every moment, a large number of survivors are teleported to the new map.
Time quickly passed by a month.
In one month, the number of humans coming to the Witch Race Territory has reached five million.
This is a terrifying number.
As expected, Xingyu City’s combat personnel were not so many.
But now, due to controlling the only teleportation route.
Countless survivors arrive at Xingyu City every day to sign the Lord Contract.
The teleportation quota is scheduled up to half a year in advance.
Nonetheless, the enthusiasm of those survivors to go to the Witch Race Territory has not diminished in the slightest.
Because, the first batch of survivors who arrived in the Witch Race Territory.
After adapting to the new life, they boast about their glorious battle achievements and their level-up speed every day on the forums.
These survivors follow the Witch Race Legion to fight everywhere.
Each day they battle with numerous shadow monsters, gaining substantial experience.
In just one month.
The number of survivors who reached Fourth Transformation strength has grown from over a hundred worldwide to over ten thousand.
It has exploded nearly a hundredfold more.
Even the Witch Race officials were stunned.
They never imagined that the survivors brought by Han Xing would grow stronger so quickly and fiercely!
In the Holy Spirit Realm, everyone here is a rare talent!
And now, so many have appeared all at once.
At this moment, several officers came to find Kathy.
"Officer Kathy, the people brought by Lord Han Xing are truly bizarre!"
Upon hearing this, Kathy puzzled, "Oh? How are they bizarre?"
A certain officer exclaimed, "Since they adapted to the rhythm of the battlefield, they charge forward like madmen in every fight."
"When encountering those injured, wounded shadow monsters, they won’t let us intervene; all shadow monsters must be killed by them personally!"
"Moreover, each of them is terrifyingly energetic! It’s as if they never get tired!"
Kathy’s eyes also showed a hint of surprise.
Then, Kathy chuckled, "Isn’t this a good thing?
"Although their behavior is a bit strange, they have indeed brought our Witch Race tremendous help."
"I hear you’ve been fighting in other main city territories recently?"
Upon hearing Kathy’s question, the group of Witch Race officers also smiled bitterly, "Yes, yes..."
"Now in our main city nearby area, as soon as there’s a sign of the Shadow Legion, this group of mad human race instantly rushes over to eliminate them."
"And because they exterminate so quickly, many of them can’t get there in time, so they’re always clamoring to go to other battlefields."
"With Lord Han Xing’s approval, I’ve taken them to provide support in other areas."
Kathy also shook her head and said, "It’s okay, since Lord Han Xing agreed, you all..."
"Oh yes, don’t treat them differently."
"Since these people are performing so well, you need to give them corresponding rewards."
"Promote the ones who deserve it, reward those who deserve it, understood?"
The Witch Race officers were suddenly stunned upon hearing this.
"Uh... the commander’s meaning is to give ranks to these humans?"
Kathy nodded.
"This isn’t appropriate..." the officers hesitated.
Kathy asked, "Why not?"
"They... they aren’t our Witch Race people after all!"
The Witch Race officers looked troubled, "If these humans gain power within our Witch Race, they might eventually take root and grow within us."
"In the past, this would be regarded as racial invasion."
Upon hearing this, Kathy burst into laughter, "Racial invasion? To be blunt, the Witch Race is barely holding on. We might not even make it through this crisis!"
"Lord Saint Master hasn’t appeared for decades, and while we all know he’s confronting the Shadow Monarch."
"The Witch Race’s situation is increasingly difficult, a fact recognized by all."
"At this time, Lord Han Xing’s willingness to mobilize so many humans to help us is practically a lifesaver!"
"If we can’t survive the current crisis, the Witch Race’s future itself is uncertain. I hope you understand these important relationships!"
Kathy’s tone was very serious.
Compared to other members of the Witch Race, Kathy saw things much more clearly.
From when Han Xing mobilized millions of humans to participate in the Witch Race’s war, they were already in an alliance relationship.
Kathy continued, "In the future, the alliance between the Human Race and our Witch Race is an inevitable matter."
"Can’t you see the relationship between the Saintess and Lord Han Xing?"
The Witch Race officers were all silent.
This was a topic they dared not touch!
Although everyone with a keen eye could see that the relationship between the Saintess and Han Xing was not ordinary,
no one dared to speak out about it openly.
However, Kathy nonchalantly said, "Everyone should know the Saintess’s character by now.
"Once she set her mind on someone, not even the Saint Master coming personally could change her mind."
"Moreover, our Witch Race doesn’t have those outdated rules prohibiting our people from interacting with other races."
"If those humans can integrate with our Witch Race, why wouldn’t that be a good thing?"
One officer questioned, "That’s true, but Commander Kathy, those humans are really too weak and a bit mentally peculiar."
"Right now, the only one they can rely upon is Lord Han Xing, a powerful figure."
He then added, "And a few of Lord Han Xing’s companions."
"Wouldn’t it be a little..."
Kathy shook her head, "You’re mistaken. Through this period of observation, you should see it clearly."
"Although these humans are weak now, their speed of getting stronger is terrifying!"
"In such a short time, so many humans have broken through from Third Transformation to Fourth Transformation!"
"If it was just a coincidence, that’s explainable, but now, it’s an entire race that’s terrifyingly strong!"
"Moreover, there’s the infinitely potential Lord Han Xing..."
"Merging with the Human Race is not them taking advantage of us."
"On the contrary, perhaps it’s the Witch Race who is reaching up to this Human Race."
"This union could bring hope for the Witch Race to rise again!"
If Han Xing were here at this moment, he would certainly be impressed by this Commander Kathy.
Her insight is indeed far beyond ordinary people, able to see the unusual nature of these survivors in an instant.
The other Witch Race officers were also alerted.
Indeed! Although those humans are odd, their speed of growth is truly terrifying!
Every day, they can feel the aura of these humans under their command continuously growing.
At this rate,
in a few months, the millions of humans brought by Han Xing could all break through to Fourth Transformation!
And the Human Race is certainly far more numerous than just these numbers.
If every Human Race individual truly has this ability, as Commander Kathy suggests, that would be overwhelmingly terrifying...
The Witch Race officers stopped speaking, one by one taking their leave.
They needed to make time to reward those Human Race survivors who contributed!
After all the officers left,
Kathy sat alone in her chair, deep in thought.
She sighed and said, "Ever since Lord Saint Master hasn’t appeared for decades, the Witch Race major Sky Islands have lacked a certain cohesion."
"Although the integration of the Witch Race and the Human Race is something the Saintess is pushing for behind the scenes."
"I’m sure the other Witch Race priests won’t be able to oppose it."
"However, I should still report recent events to Lady Saintess."

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - 301: Rewards and Honors, Witch Race Saint Master and Shadow Monarch
paragraphs: Kathy felt that she should inform Wu Ling’Er about some recent events in the Third Main City.
So, she quickly communicated with Wu Ling’Er.
After listening to Kathy’s report.
Wu Ling’Er, who was at the border, continually showed a look of surprise in her eyes.
At this moment, Kathy said somewhat uneasily, "Lady Saintess, I made the decision myself to grant military ranks to these Human Race people. What do you think?"
Compared to her strong demeanor when communicating with those officers, Kathy seemed like a different person now.
Wu Ling’Er shook her head and said, "It’s okay, you did very well."
"Even if you hadn’t said so, I would have done the same."
Upon hearing this, Kathy nodded in relief.
The two continued to exchange discussions and reported the actions of this group of Human Race people to Wu Ling’Er over the past few days.
When Wu Ling’Er heard that Han Xing had brought several hundred thousand Human Race people, who were fighting everywhere in the Witch Race with outstanding performance.
She felt waves of warmth and contentment in her heart.
There was a look of admiration in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes as she whispered, "Han Xing..."
"Is it you quietly helping me again?"
At that moment, Wu Ling’Er suddenly whispered softly, "Over a month has passed, I wonder if he misses me."
"Should I take some time to go back to the Main City?"
"I miss Brother Xing’s embrace so much..."
Thinking of this, Wu Ling’Er’s face instantly flushed with shyness.
Her breathing became somewhat rapid, and her legs pressed tightly together.
Wu Ling’Er shyly said, "Ah! What nonsense am I thinking about?"
Just as she was pondering these things, the voice of the High Priest suddenly came to her ears.
"Wu Ling’Er, a large number of Shadow Legends have appeared on the front line, including two High-tier Legends. Quickly come to support!"
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er’s expression instantly became stern.
The chaotic thoughts in her mind were completely cleared.
Her aura burst forth, and her figure suddenly vanished from the spot.
At the same time.
On the Survivor forum.
Numerous posts about the Witch Race Territory appeared.
They were loudly proclaiming the benefits of joining Xingyu City.
Not only can one directly join the Witch Race Legion, but they will also receive Star God’s troop support.
It can be called a babysitter-level service.
Furthermore, Star God has rewarded those well-performing survivors.
For instance, a while ago, a survivor who was the first to break through the Fourth Transformation received an Orange Weapon as a reward.
Also, a survivor named Shu Jun received a bizarre war chariot from Star God upon completing the Fourth Transformation.
That chariot is incredibly terrifying; with just him alone, he can kill a ten-thousand-person squad.
Even the Four-star Lords are no match for him.
His terrifying combat strength has made many survivors envious.
Only then did they realize the benefits of joining Xingyu City.
Compared to Zhou Huang’s side, who still haven’t brought many people over until now.
The comparison with Star God’s side is impossible.
All at once, countless survivors gathered in Xingyu City, lining up to sign lifetime Lord Contracts.
Including those large group leaders who had already completed the Fourth Transformation.
Before this, the strength of those large group leaders was in the first tier among global humanity.
But now, with more and more survivors gaining opportunities in the Witch Race Territory and breaking through the Fourth Transformation.
They are quickly being pushed out of the first tier.
If they do not hurry to the Witch Race Territory,
A strong sense of urgency has arisen in their hearts.
They immediately decided to quickly go to Xingyu City, sign a Lord Contract with Han Xing, and then head to the Witch Race Territory.
For a time, Xingyu City once again welcomed an unprecedented period of development.
At this time on the forum, some survivors continued to post bragging.
"Guys, today I officially took down ten thousand Shadow Monsters. Our group leader commended my outstanding performance and gave me the position of Squad Leader!"
"Now, I’m someone with status in the Witch Race! Hahaha!"
As soon as this post came out, it incited envy among the survivors.
They all asked, "What is a Squad Leader? What’s the benefit?"
The person replied below, "Although the title ’Squad Leader’ has the word ’small,’ the power is vast."
"Under my command, there are fifty Witch Race Soldiers that I manage; these Witch Race Soldiers all have a Level of no less than 30 and are strong!"
"With this status, entering all major Witch Race Main Cities, those Witch Race people look at you differently."
"In the past few days, I’ve been confessed by at least a dozen Witch Race beauties; it’s truly being thrown into warm embraces!"
Other survivors were shocked.
"Wow, there’s even such a good thing?"
"I’m so envious!"
"I also want to be confessed by Witch Race beauties, sob sob..."
The Witch Race has a simple folk culture and respects the strong.
As seen from past experiences, they do not care about the identities of Han Xing and others as Human Race people.
Especially after receiving Kathy’s orders, these Witch Race officers began granting military ranks to the survivors.
Now, more and more Human Race people have identities in the Witch Race Territory.
At this time, below the survivors continued to ask, "Anything else? Anything else interesting?"
The person quickly replied, "Of course there is!"
"Let me tell you, besides those girls in the Witch Race being exceptionally pretty, they have another special feature!"
"And that is various Secret Elixirs!"
"Secret Elixirs?" a group of survivors asked puzzled.
"Exactly! The Witch Race has various Secret Elixirs with powerful attributes. Not only do they have elixirs that increase damage, but there are also many that can permanently increase attributes."
"Now, when I go to those shops to buy various secret elixirs, there’s even discounts!"
Upon hearing this, all survivors were immediately elated.

Especially after receiving Kathy’s orders, these Witch Race officers began granting military ranks to the survivors.
Now, more and more Human Race people have identities in the Witch Race Territory.
At this time, below the survivors continued to ask, "Anything else?
Anything else interesting?"
The person quickly replied, "Of course there is!"
"Let me tell you, besides those girls in the Witch Race being exceptionally pretty, they have another special feature!"
"And that is various Secret Elixirs!"
"Secret Elixirs?" a group of survivors asked puzzled.
"Exactly!
The Witch Race has various Secret Elixirs with powerful attributes.
Not only do they have elixirs that increase damage, but there are also many that can permanently increase attributes."
"Now, when I go to those shops to buy various secret elixirs, there’s even discounts!"
Upon hearing this, all survivors were immediately elated.

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - 301: Rewards and Honors, Witch Race Saint Master and Shadow Monarch
paragraphs: "Damn!"
"Quick, quick, quick! I want to join Xingyu City!"
"If I’m late, I’ll have to wait until next year!"
Meanwhile.
Han Xing and the others had been grinding the Abyssal Rift for a whole month, and everyone was about to get sick of it!
Now, when they saw those Abyssal Monsters, they would instinctively raise their hands to attack.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong killed an Elite Demon with a single shot, his face grim as he said, "Damn it, this repetitive monster grinding is really testing our endurance."
Just then, Han Xing gritted his teeth and said, "Hang in there a bit longer."
"Once we hit Level 50, we won’t have to come here for a long time."
Shen Yun also chimed in, "Exactly, just imagine how much stronger we’ll be after reaching Level 50!"
"Not only can you equip that Level 50 Divine Artifact, but you can even switch to a full set of Orange equipment!"
"Then, maybe you can have Legendary level powers like Brother Xing."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes immediately lit up, "Are you saying I’ll be able to kill Legendary Creatures across ranks?"
Shen Yun nodded, "You can do it!"
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "Damn, by then, will I also be considered the kind of talent that Holy Spirit Realm hasn’t seen in millennia!"
Shen Yun continued affirmatively, "Exactly, you are a genius!"
"What you need to do now is hang in there a bit longer."
"Level up secretly, and then shock everyone!"
Cheng Jianyong was almost convinced, feeling full of energy at the moment.
Compared to the three males.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang didn’t feel much pressure.
On the contrary, as their combat skills improved, their stress decreased significantly.
During battles, the two women would gather together to chat.
They showed none of the exhaustion from grinding that the others did.
The grinding process was tedious.
But they also knew that this was a process that other Survivors couldn’t even dream of.
In just a month.
All five of them reached Level 48.
Even Coal Ball, led by Han Xing, reached Level 46.
If this speed was known, it might shock Survivors worldwide into disbelief!
Even the old monsters of the Holy Spirit Realm would have their worldviews overturned.
After all, even the talented Wu Ling’Er took over ten years to go from the Fourth Transformation to Legendary status.
But them?
Just a few months!
And in just another month, they could all reach Level 50.
Then they would prepare to break through to Legendary status.
Thinking of this filled them with motivation.
Bang! Bang bang!
After taking down the Abyss Knight on the 60th floor,
the group teleported back to Ten Thousand Stars City.
At this time, the teleportation arrays in Ten Thousand Stars City gathered quite a number of Survivors.
However, Han Xing no longer needed to lead these Survivors to report to the army.
The Witch Race would send people to meet them.
Even the legion commanders fought fiercely to recruit more members of the Human Race!
After all, where else could you find soldiers who could become stronger at such a fast pace?
More and more Humans transferred from Xingyu City to Witch Race Territory.
They then gradually adapted to life on the new map through the army.
Time passed by like this.
Half a month later.
In the Chaotic Void, within a fragment of space.
A man covered in blue Secret Patterns, even with azure blue eyes, stood in the void.
Opposite him was a humanoid creature dressed in Shadow Armor, holding a black Broken Blade.
The humanoid creature’s body constantly emitted black smoke, making its appearance indiscernible and its voice inaudible.
Its eyes also emitted a ghostly green flame, indistinguishable from ordinary Shadow Monsters.
However.
The man covered in Secret Patterns dared not underestimate it in the slightest.
Because this seemingly ordinary Dark Creature with no visible energy fluctuations
was actually the leader of the Shadow Legion.
Known as the Shadow Monarch.
A confirmed being of Demigod Level strength.
And the man covered in Secret Patterns opposite it, his identity was self-evident.
The current Witch Race Saint Master: Helas.
At this moment, the Witch Race Saint Master spoke in a hoarse voice, "Shadow, how long do you plan to stall me here?"
The other didn’t answer; the ghostly green flame in its eyes flickered.
The next moment, it raised the Broken Sword in its hand.
And swung a slash.
The Witch Race Saint Master immediately felt tearing sensations across his body.
"You!" The Witch Race Saint Master exclaimed in shock and anger, seemingly not expecting the other to attack without warning.
Moreover, as the Longsword slashed down.
The Witch Race Saint Master saw the space before him begin to fracture.
In this moment of crisis, countless Secret Patterns appeared on the Witch Race Saint Master’s body simultaneously.
"Hah!"
With a shouted command,
the chaotic space was filled with endless blue Secret Patterns.
These Secret Patterns appeared to be of the same source as Wu Ling’Er’s power.
Every blue Secret Pattern contained terrifying destruction energy; any ordinary Legendary Powerhouse would perish upon contact!
However.
What shook the Witch Race Saint Master was.
Even after unleashing so many Witch Clan Secret Patterns.
Against the light swing of that man’s sword.
It seemed everything was effortlessly cut through.
He watched helplessly as the sword fell from the void, severing countless Secret Patterns.
Then—
It landed directly on his head.
Splat!
The sound of flesh tearing, and droplets of blue blood scattered.
The commotion in the entire space came to a halt.
By this time, the figure of the Witch Race Saint Master had somehow appeared behind the Shadow Monarch.
He was watching intently, with a grim expression, at the distant standing black shadow.
It was then that the Witch Race Saint Master noticed a black line from his forehead down to his abdomen.
Caused by the slash of the Shadow Monarch’s sword.
As if he was nearly split in half by the opponent.
The Witch Race Saint Master said with difficulty, "Shadow, you madman, you tried to cut my destiny line directly, don’t you know if you fail, you’ll face severe backlash too?"
On the opposite side, a line also appeared on the Shadow Monarch’s black Armor.
As the Witch Race Saint Master said, the slash did not succeed in killing him.
He was also gravely injured.
Yet, the Shadow Monarch was indifferent.
He continued to swing his sword, again and again.
Pop pop pop!
Sword Qi flew everywhere!
Each slash inflicted severe wounds on the Witch Race Saint Master, as well as on himself.
After hundreds of continuous slashes,
even the Witch Race Saint Master’s azure pupils showed a hint of fear.
"You’re crazy! You’ve gone completely crazy!"
"It’s impossible for you to kill me!"
"You’ll end up being consumed by your own Sword Qi and die first!"
At this moment, the other side finally spoke.
A voice hoarse to the extreme, like chewing glass: "He...las..."
"The time is almost..."
"The destruction of the Witch Race is...an inevitable... fate."
The Witch Race Saint Master, upon hearing this, immediately roared in anger, "You’re talking nonsense!"
"The Witch Race has thrived in the Holy Spirit Realm for over ten thousand years, surviving countless calamities, and still endures."
"What makes you say the Witch Race will inevitably be destroyed?"
On the opposite side, the Shadow Monarch shook his head, "Helas..."
"You don’t understand... the Witch Race blocks the path of some beings..."
Hearing this, Helas frowned and asked, "Blocked the path? Blocked whose path?"
"Shadow, who are you following the orders of?"
On the opposite side, the Shadow Monarch shook his head again.
"Those beings are... extremely terrifying..."
"They are... about to emerge... "
Hearing this, Helas frowned deeply.
Having confronted the Shadow Monarch for over a decade, he was very familiar with the opponent’s combat methods.
He also knew that the Shadow Monarch was an extremely proud individual with immensely powerful strength.
Even acknowledging extremely terrifying beings.
Their power must far surpass the imagination of the Witch Race Saint Master!
And from the Shadow Monarch’s words, he deduced that these beings might not be just a single entity.
At this thought, the Witch Race Saint Master suddenly took a sharp breath!

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - 302: Terrifying Woman, Saint Master’s Warning!
paragraphs: The Witch Race Saint Master couldn’t help but be utterly shocked by the Shadow Monarch’s words.
"Dark..." The Witch Race Saint Master was about to continue speaking.
However, the Shadow Monarch seemed no longer interested in talking to him.
The Shadow Monarch began to relentlessly unleash black sword qi.
Whish—
Whish—
The Witch Race Saint Master struggled to dodge.
But the opponent seemed indifferent, mechanically striking and retracting the sword.
Moreover, the Witch Race Saint Master discovered.
The Shadow Monarch’s sword qi not only involved fate but also the Element of space...
This Void, already chaotic beyond measure, had been sliced into pieces.
Crack! Crack, crack!
In the shattered Void, various terrifying phenomena continuously appeared.
Winds of annihilation...
Mists of devouring...
Rains of decay...
Ordinary Legendary Powerhouses faced instant destruction upon encountering these terrifying phenomena.
But the Witch Race Saint Master, relying solely on his Demigod Level Constitution, could barely sustain himself.
Yet, even so, this place had already formed a stream of Space Turbulence.
In other words, he could no longer even perform Instant Movement.
A sudden sense of unease filled the Witch Race Saint Master’s heart.
He had no idea what the Shadow Monarch intended with all this.
Though they had faced off here for decades.
He knew absolutely nothing about this mysterious powerhouse.
The Witch Race Saint Master hurriedly poured several bottles of ’Holy Tree Spirit Secret Elixir’ into his mouth.
These elixirs were clearly more advanced than those Wu Ling’Er gave to Han Xing.
The vast Life Force contained within, with just a whiff, could even heal a Legendary Powerhouse’s severe injuries.
After drinking the elixir, the Witch Race Saint Master’s wounds quickly healed at a visible pace.
And just at that moment.
The Shadow Monarch, who had been continuously releasing sword qi, suddenly stopped his sword-wielding motions.
It looked towards the sky with its pupils, flickering with ghostly green flames.
Then said, "Alright... come out..."
The Witch Race Saint Master’s expression changed, he hurriedly asked, "Shadow, what’s coming out now?"
"Did you call for reinforcements!?"
The next moment.
He suddenly heard a soft chuckle near his ear.
Hearing this familiar voice, the Witch Race Saint Master immediately felt his scalp tighten!
"Hee hee..."
The next moment, he suddenly saw, behind the Shadow Monarch, a seductive woman wearing a black robe with a hood appeared.
The Witch Race Saint Master’s pupils dilated, "It’s you!"
Opposite, the seductive woman in a hood snuggled against the Shadow Monarch, her body writhing.
"Ah la~ Do you recognize me?"
The Witch Race Saint Master frowned deeply, the sense of impending doom in his heart was rising frantically.
He took a deep breath and said gravely.
"Previously, while perusing my tribe’s records, I discovered something strange about that Otherworldly Evil God’s summoning ritual."
"According to the Saint Master of that era, he initially didn’t believe those voices were ancestors’ responses."
"But the reason he held that ritual was because he encountered a woman, a mysterious woman."
"He vaguely remembered that it seemed like that woman urged him to complete the ritual, but afterward, he couldn’t remember her existence at all."
"As if that woman never appeared."
"And the mysterious woman he described matches you perfectly!"
Opposite, the hooded woman didn’t seem to care.
"Oh dear! I didn’t expect the naive Witch Race Saint Master actually noticed my existence, that’s my oversight~"
"And that’s not all!" The Witch Race Saint Master interrupted.
"Since then, I’ve been investigating information about that mysterious woman."
"And what I found, truly uncovered some earth-shattering secrets!"
His voice even carried a slight tremor.
"Through investigation, I discovered that in several major events in the Holy Spirit Realm over thousands of years, there seems to have always been traces of a mysterious woman."
"Including the current war between the Giant Race and the Dwarf Race!"
"The defection of the Dark Elves from the Elf Race, and the Demons’ continuous assault on the seal!"
"All of this, you’ve been aiding and abetting!
The Witch Race Saint Master pointed at her, "Now, even the Shadow Legion has your involvement!"
"You terrifying woman!"
"Who are you really?"
"What are you trying to do?"
The Witch Race Saint Master ceaselessly questioned!
Despite revealing one incident after another, the other party remained completely unmoved.
Facing him, the hooded woman chuckled lightly, "What am I trying to do..."
"Didn’t the Shadow tell you already?"
"Helas, your Witch Race is in the way~"
"Including yourself, you’re an obstacle."
"And obstacles are meant to be removed!"
Her tone carried an invisible killing intent.
Then, the Shadow Monarch and the hooded woman began to close in on the Witch Race Saint Master from the left and right.
At this moment, the Witch Race Saint Master seemed to have understood something.
He looked at the two figures before him, revealing a look of realization.
"I see... although I still don’t understand your purpose..."
"However, I did learn a little about your origins."
"It’s truly terrifying... being able to survive from that era..."
The Witch Race Saint Master regained his composure.
He sat cross-legged in the Void.
"Kill him!" the hooded woman commanded.
The next moment, she and the Shadow Monarch attacked the Witch Race Saint Master in unison!
"It’s not so easy to kill me!"
"Secret Pattern Domain—Open!"
Buzz!
The endless Void was instantly covered by a blue Sea of Secret Patterns...
At the same time.
The Witch Race border defense line.
After nearly two months of fierce warfare, although the Witch Race suffered heavily, they barely managed to hold back the Shadow Legion’s assault.

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - 302: Terrifying Woman, Saint Master’s Warning!
paragraphs: Now, here is presided over by the High Priest of the Witch Race: Xiao, who is controlling the situation.
Xiao, with his dark hair casually hanging over his shoulders, is pondering the movements of the Shadow Legion.
At this moment, a strange sensation suddenly rises in his heart.
The next moment, the Power inside him seems out of control.
Red Secret Patterns instantly emerge from within him.
Those Secret Patterns gather together, vaguely forming a special Witch Race symbol.
This symbol seems to be a "person" character.
However, before the symbol fully forms, it dissipates directly.
Xiao furrows his brow.
He knows it’s a special communication method with the Lord Saint Master.
But it seems it didn’t fully form and was forced to dissipate.
At this moment, Xiao muses, "Lord Saint Master, what is the message you want to convey?"
"Person... what does this character represent?"
Xiao is puzzled.
And just then, he suddenly feels a stirring in his heart.
Xiao immediately raises his head.
At his Level, he has a keen perception of danger.
This stirring feeling is quite familiar to him.
Much like when the Shadow Legion invaded in the past, it’s the same feeling,
This time is no exception.
Xiao’s figure instantly disappears from the room.
And when he appears in midair, he suddenly sees.
A massive black cloud is drifting over from the border defense line ahead.
Its terrifying scale even obscures the sky.
Simultaneously, he also sees the dozens of Shadow Legends leading the cloudy mass ahead!
Their overwhelming aura is like the descent of Demon Gods!
Xiao’s pupils contract sharply.
He opens his communication equipment and urgently speaks.
"The Shadow Legion is invading fully, the Witch Race territory is on highest alert!"
"All Legendary Level powerhouses, come quickly!"
At this moment, including Wu Ling’Er, everyone immediately rushes into the sky.
They also see the massive shadow monsters and the leading dozens of Shadow Legends!
"Full invasion..."
"How can this be?"
"So many Shadow Legends... oh my!"
This day.
The terrifying number of shadow monsters breaks through the Witch Race border defense, starting a frenzied full invasion into the Witch Race territory.
War flames spread throughout every city in the Witch Race territory, intense battles erupting once again.
Including the main city where Han Xing is and Wu Ling’Er, which also suffers the impact.
At this moment, Han Xing, who just transmitted from the Abyssal Rift, suddenly receives Kathy’s urgent notification.
"Full-scale war?"
"So many monsters have breached the border defenses."
"It seems something occurred on Wu Ling’Er’s side?"
His heart feels a bit worried.
Han Xing just wants to contact Wu Ling’Er.

"Brother Han Xing... there’s a problem over at the border, the Shadow Legion has dispatched many legends."
"But don’t worry, for high-tier combat strength, we can still maintain it, although many monsters may fall through and invade the Witch Race territory."
"This period, it will be tough for Brother Han Xing to help take care of the citizens in the main city!"
"After the war ends, Ling’Er will compensate Brother Han Xing."
After reading Wu Ling’Er’s message, Han Xing finally exhales a bit.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong looks at Han Xing, asking, "Brother Xing, what’s the situation now?"
"With so many monsters invading the whole Witch Race territory, should we join the battle?"
Han Xing thinks for a moment, then checks his Experience bar again.
He shakes his head, saying, "Not yet joining the battle."
"Just now Wu Ling’Er sent me a message, they’re fighting the high-tier combat strength of the Shadow Legion, so many monsters fell through into the Witch Race territory."
"Currently, the greatest pressure lies with the Legendary Level powerhouses, including Wu Ling’Er."
"With the addition of numerous Survivors, the Witch Race territory can barely hold for now."
Han Xing continues, "If the source isn’t resolved, killing more shadow monsters isn’t useful."
"Now, what we need to do is continue speeding up Leveling up, strive to reach Level 50 soon!"
The crowd listens and nods together.
Then he checks his Experience bar again.
Final 90%...
Soon, at most, it’ll take just one week to reach Level 50.
Even if bringing everyone else to Level 50, it only takes ten days.
Once all five people reach Level 50, the combat power exerted under teamwork will surely rival Legend.
By then, it will be the combat Power of five legends!
Plus, with the firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, it can rival two legends.
This makes seven Legend-level combat powers.
Seven legends, no matter for which Race, are an unmistakable force.
Even, they can be the key to determining the outcome of a war battle!
"Then, when we all have Legendary Level power, we’ll head directly to the border to join the battle!"
"And then crush the Shadow Legion in one blow!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s plan.
Everyone’s expression changes.
Then, without a word, they all seize the time, starting to furiously charge into the Abyssal Rift.
Before this, only hoping Wu Ling’Er and the others can hold on!
In the Abyssal Rift.
The five people just enter, immediately pouring various Secret Elixirs into their mouths.
At the first second of monster appearance.
An icy rain storm falls from above with unstoppable force.
Swish, swish, swish!
Abyssal Monsters are pierced through by Ice Cones.
Splatter, splatter, splatter!
Within 1 minute and 20 seconds, all Ordinary Monsters are swiftly cleared.
At this moment.
The ground begins to tremble.
That massive Bone Dragon is about to rise.
However, before it can say its lines, it sees five pairs of cold eyes!
"Person..."
Crash!
A meteorite crashes down from above.
Simultaneously, Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang’s Arrow alongside Cheng Jianyong’s Spear Qi, all focus fire on it.
Splatter, splatter, splatter!
In an instant, the Bone Dragon’s head is blasted into pieces.
System prompt appears.
[Successfully clear Abyssal Rift Layer 50, this battle took 2 minutes 58 seconds, breaking the fastest clearance record...]
Everyone swiftly cleans up the battlefield, directly stepping into the next layer passage.
Abyssal Rift Layer 55...
Mist shrouded, familiar lines echo.
"I am the Abyssal Guardian..."
However, before he finishes his lines, Han Xing hears the direction the voice comes from, immediately says.
"Over there, all attacks, end him!"
Splatter, splatter, splatter!
Attacks penetrate into the mist.
The Abyssal Guardian, eyes bewildered, looks at the incoming Arrows and Meteorite smashing from above.
Crash!
It’s blasted out of the misty region.
In the next instant, it’s overwhelmed by everyone’s attacks.
Until death, the Abyssal Guardian remains filled with confusion.
What’s the situation with these few humans?
Didn’t they fight anyone in their past lives?
Damn it! I haven’t even finished my lines, and you’re already hitting me?
However, none pay attention to the Abyssal Guardian’s frustrated feelings.
With the Abyssal Guardian blown apart, system prompt appears,
"Successfully clear Abyssal Rift Layer 55, this battle took 3 minutes 14 seconds, breaking the fastest clearance record..."
[Abyssal Rift Layer 60.]
Cancirias, a Wandering Demon with exaggerated muscles.
Looks at the five people with a puzzled gaze.
It notices these five humans all look at it as if it’s prey.
As a noble Demon, this is absolutely intolerable!
However, before it can swing its Great Sword.
It realizes it’s already entangled by endless vines.
Then, it welcomes a storm-like assault from everyone!
Splatter!
The Wandering Demon is blown apart on the spot.
System prompt appears.
"Successfully clear Rift Layer 60, this battle took 4 minutes 41 seconds, breaking the fastest clearance record..."
In the shortest time, after collecting the loot dropped by Layer 60 monsters.
Everyone proceeds decisively, directly transmitting out!

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - 303: The Outbreak of War, Full-Scale Battle Begins
paragraphs: They just teleported out, without a moment’s pause.
Then, entered again!
Boom! Boom boom!
One powerful BOSS after another fell at their feet.
As the battle rhythm accelerated.
Their experience bars also began to rise at a visibly rapid speed!
For other survivors, it might take two to three months, or even three to four months, to level up.
But now, Han Xing and his team could level up in just one week!
While Han Xing and his team were crazily sweeping through the Abyssal Rift.
The Witch Race Territory outside also fell into a full-scale war.
Its scale was completely no less than that of two months ago.
Fires of war raged everywhere.
But fortunately, after going through that event, the major main cities all had coping experience.
Plus, the legendary powerhouses of the Shadow Legion were fighting against those Witch Clan Priests at the border.
Thus, there was no legendary level combat power in the Witch Race territory, which might be the second good news.
Another piece of good news is.
Nearly seven million survivors who had been teleported over were fighting everywhere along with the Witch Race Legion.
And they were achieving significant battle merits.
For the Witch Race, war might be an unfortunate affair.
But for these humans from Blue Star, war was their opportunity to rise quickly!
With each major battle, they could harvest a large amount of battle merit and massive experience value!
Those Shadow Crystals could also be bought back by Luo Chan at a great price.
The more monsters there were, the more excited they became!
At this moment, Kathy was sitting in the Witch Race command room, listening to battle reports coming in from various places.
Her tightly knit eyebrows gradually relaxed a bit.
She murmured, "It seems my previous speculation was correct, this Human Race’s speed of growing stronger is terrifying!"
"And every single one of them is insanely mad!"
"Only seven million Humans, yet the combat power they display is comparable to tens of millions of Witch Race elite soldiers.
"Moreover, Lord Han Xing’s teleportation array is continuously transporting Humans over every day."
"This way, the pressure across the entire Witch Race territory would be greatly reduced."
While she was pondering these, she suddenly saw her Communication Jade light up.
Then, it started flashing rapidly.
At this moment, she received over a hundred messages.
Upon opening them, they all contained the same content.
"A large volume of Shadow Mist is approaching the main city!"
"Preliminary estimates indicate that the number of Shadow Fangs within the mist exceeds ten billion!"
Kathy stood up in an instant, "What!?"
A look of horror appeared on her face immediately.
Ten billion Shadow Monsters!
This number even surpassed the war from two months ago.
That time, she tasted the bitterness of defeat.
And now, it’s even more terrifying than last time!
Moreover, to support the other Sky Islands within the Witch Race Territory, she had dispatched half of her forces!
At this moment, the main city was at its most vulnerable in terms of defense.
Thinking of this, Commander Kathy’s delicate face turned pale all of a sudden.
She quickly sent a message in the Witch Race’s internal communication channel.
"The main city is under attack, the scale of the monsters is extremely large, far beyond the main city’s firepower!"
"All officers outside, lead your soldiers and return quickly to defend!"
The Witch Race officers received the order and their expressions became serious.
Just as they were preparing to lead their troops back to support.
Suddenly, a man’s voice sounded in their ears.
"No need."
The tone of the voice was very calm.
Kathy’s pupils shrunk slightly, the main city was at its most dangerous moment now.
It could be said that if those officers could return even a few seconds earlier, countless casualties could be reduced!
But this person told the officers not to return.
Kathy was about to see who was so bold.
Only to find out it was Han Xing who spoke.
Only he could enter the Witch Race’s internal communication channel in the identity of a human.
At this moment, Kathy’s expression softened a bit.
She said with some uncertainty, "Lord Han Xing, are you sure you don’t want them to return for defense?"
"The scale of this monster attack is too large!"
"With just these defense tower firepowers in our main city, we can’t possibly withstand such a massive monster assault!"
Han Xing, having just emerged from the Abyssal Rift, immediately summoned the Oracle Throne and appeared above the main city.
Likewise, he saw the rapidly advancing black mist from all directions.
The black mist was enormous enough to completely cover the entire main city.
Within that black mist, an intimidating number of Shadow Monsters were hidden!
Han Xing replied, "I know."
"But who said only your main city has defense towers."
Before Kathy could react.
In the next moment, she saw a massive Sky Island slowly descending from the clouds.
This Sky Island, Kathy was naturally very familiar with.
It was Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City.
In the previous war with the Shadow Legion.
It was the firepower from this Sky Island that bombarded many Shadow Monsters, easing their pressure.
Yet, Kathy furrowed her eyebrows.
She knew the firepower on Ten Thousand Stars City was formidable.
But compared to the main city, it was not on the same level at all.
The firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City primarily relied on those numerous Thunderbolt Towers that emitted electric light.
However, although these Thunderbolt Towers were numerous and terrifying, they could not effectively damage some powerful creatures.
The key reason was the lack of sufficiently high-level defense towers.
Even with the aid of Ten Thousand Stars City, could they contend with this Shadow Legion numbering in the tens of billions?
Kathy inevitably had doubts in her heart.
However, what she didn’t know was.
Han Xing had long filled in this gap.
Now, his territory possessed defense towers that were more advanced than the Tower of Witch Soul and True Spirit Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - 303: The Outbreak of War, Full-Scale Battle Begins
paragraphs: Tower of Death Light!
Formidable attack power, and a cylindrical attack range, very suitable for this kind of war!
Meanwhile.
Over the Witch Race Main City, hundreds of the Tower of Witch Soul and the True Spirit Tower simultaneously erupted with terrifying energy waves.
On Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City, it was also continuously shaking.
The next moment!
At least a thousand beams imbued with the aura of destruction burst out simultaneously from the two Sky Islands!
That’s not all.
A thousand green flames also roared up into the sky at this time.
In Kathy’s shocked gaze.
The beams from the thousand Advanced Defense Towers instantly pierced into the Shadow Mist.
Sizzle... Sizzle...
Boom!
From afar, they could see bursts of blue or red light emitting from within the Shadow Mist.
In the next moment, it seemed as though a black rain was falling from the sky.
Countless shadow monsters fell from the mist, then dropped into the Endless Void below.
And these monsters capable of falling, were at least of Elite Level, their flesh bodies not yet destroyed.
As for the ordinary Shadow Fangs, they were instantly blasted into black powder the moment they contacted the defense tower beams.
At this moment, those shadow monsters were still several thousand kilometers away from the Witch Race Main City.
Yet already countless had been slaughtered.
By the time these monsters get close, they will no longer pose any threat.
Even if those Shadow Dominators used countermeasures, it would be useless.
In the sky, large swathes of shadow fangs died and then fell.
Including the Shadow Crystals on their bodies, naturally disappearing into the air.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing silently sighed at the loss.
But he quickly tossed this emotion aside.
Indeed, it would be more profitable if Han Xing let these shadow monsters land on the Witch Race Sky Island and then carry out attacks.
But there’s no need for that.
There are still billions of civilians on the main island.
In the face of such a massive war, these civilians have no ability to resist.
Coupled with the Witch Race Sky Island being as large as a country.
Even Han Xing cannot attend to every corner.
Wu Ling’Er left the Sky Island to Han Xing when she departed.
Han Xing, naturally, will return it to her, whole and intact.
Besides, he has millions of Survivors helping him collect Shadow Crystals, so there’s no shortage.
For the Shadow Crystals on the Witch Race Soldiers, he has ways of obtaining them after the war ends.
Watching the scale of the Shadow Mist shrinking.
This wave of the Shadow Legion’s invasion is already insignificant.
Han Xing opened the communication channel.
"Alright, there’s no problem here anymore."
"You guys continue to support the other Witch Race Sky Islands.
Those Witch Race officers had just heard Kathy’s call for help, and not even a minute had passed.
Suddenly hearing Han Xing say there’s no problem anymore.
For a moment, they seemed unable to process it.
"O-Okay, Lord Han Xing!" that group of Witch Race officers answered in confusion.
Han Xing nodded.
At this time, as if remembering something, he continued.
"Oh right, send some people over later, and I’ll support you with some troops."
With the combined firepower of the Witch Race Main City and Ten Thousand Stars City, there is no fear of large-scale Shadow Legion invasions.
And on Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City, there are terrifying numbers of troop types.
These troops have nothing to do when idle.
If they can be deployed on the battlefield, they will be able to play a powerful role.
Han Xing dispatched nearly half of the Demon Elephant War Chariots, Chimeras, and Minotaur troops from the Ten Thousand Stars City.
To support other battlefields.
With such formidable forces joining in.
It can be said that in the area governed by Wu Ling’Er, the so-called Shadow Legion no longer poses a threat.
They come as many as they die!
Seeing the situation under control.
Han Xing immediately led everyone back into the Abyssal Rift.
Meanwhile.
In an unknown area in the Witch Race Territory.
A small Sky Island measuring only a few thousand square meters.
Several humans were cautiously maneuvering the Sky Island.
Among them, two figures with long swords and contrasting auras.
Precisely Zhou Huang and Cheng.
However, compared to when they initially emerged from the Land of the Abandoned Gods full of spirit.
Now they appeared extremely downtrodden.
The team had been reduced from ten to less than six.
And each carried some injuries.
At this moment, Cheng gripped his black longsword, ready for battle, "Zhou Huang, are you sure we won’t join the other Survivors in the Witch Race army."
"But instead, continue acting alone?"
Zhou Huang nodded, "Yes."
"Why?"
Cheng looked bewildered, "Although our combat strength is strong."
"But it’s nothing compared to the Shadow Legion."
"With the Witch Race being so dangerous now, with war everywhere."
"If we act alone, not only can we not earn enough Battle Merit, but we might also face life-threatening danger!"
Zhou Huang looked at him calmly, "Can’t comprehend it?"
Cheng nodded, "Yeah, can’t comprehend."
"Initially, our plan was merely to establish ourselves in the Witch Race."
"Now, Star River has paved a way for us."
"That is, to climb through the military ranks."
"With our abilities, I believe we can quickly stand out in the military.
"Then, using these privileges, gradually develop our own force."
Hearing this, Zhou Huang sneered, "Yes, this way, we can establish ourselves in the Witch Race."
"If we do well, we might even land an official position."
"But by doing so, wouldn’t we just become Star River’s subordinates?"
Cheng’s puzzlement deepened.
Zhou Huang continued.
"Haven’t you noticed?"
"Star River came out way earlier than us, already having considerable influence in the Witch Race."
"Even those high-ranking Witch Race officers have to follow his orders."
"No matter how well we perform, no matter how much say we have in the army, in the end, we’d still be just Star River’s subordinates."
Cheng was stunned.
Initially, he hadn’t thought in this direction.
But now, Zhou Huang enlightened him.
Star River indeed wields a strong influence in the Witch Race Territory.
At this point, Zhou Huang also sighed helplessly.
"Right now, whether in the Land of the Abandoned Gods or in the Witch Race Territory, Star River already wields significant power."
"We have no hope of surpassing him."
"Only, by staying ahead of him..."
"By entering new territories ahead of everyone else."
"Leveraging our abilities, we can prepare in advance on the new maps and seize the initiative!"
Cheng stared at him, seemingly surprised that Zhou Huang was pulling another bold move.
"Zhou..."
Before Cheng could say more.
Zhou Huang interrupted, "This time you can rest assured, I’ve looked into it."
"Through the Witch Race Border, you can reach the Beastman Kingdom, and once through the Beastman Kingdom, you enter the Sky Island Forest."
"Then eventually you can reach the Elf Realm."
"Our goal is to choose one of these three maps to develop."
However, Cheng reluctantly said, "Zhou Huang, I really don’t understand why we have to surpass Star River?"
"The guy’s like a monster."
"During the first merge, I was in the same district as him and never won against him, not even once..."
"After all this time, I’ve given up all hope..."
Hearing this, Zhou Huang paused in surprise.
He didn’t expect Cheng to have given up so soon.
It was nearly as if he confessed with his own mouth that he wasn’t as good as Star River.
For someone so proud, this was a huge blow to one’s self-esteem.
However, unlike Cheng.
Before the merge, Zhou Huang was widely recognized as number one in District 1.
Even during the Blood Tide period, he was still considered number one by many after the first server merge.
Including Zhou Huang himself, he thought so too.
But then he met Han Xing post-merge.

sentences.text: Tower of Death Light!
Formidable attack power, and a cylindrical attack range, very suitable for this kind of war!
Meanwhile.
Over the Witch Race Main City, hundreds of the Tower of Witch Soul and the True Spirit Tower simultaneously erupted with terrifying energy waves.
On Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City, it was also continuously shaking.
The next moment!
At least a thousand beams imbued with the aura of destruction burst out simultaneously from the two Sky Islands!
That’s not all.
A thousand green flames also roared up into the sky at this time.
In Kathy’s shocked gaze.
The beams from the thousand Advanced Defense Towers instantly pierced into the Shadow Mist.
Sizzle...
Sizzle...
Boom!
From afar, they could see bursts of blue or red light emitting from within the Shadow Mist.
In the next moment, it seemed as though a black rain was falling from the sky.
Countless shadow monsters fell from the mist, then dropped into the Endless Void below.
And these monsters capable of falling, were at least of Elite Level, their flesh bodies not yet destroyed.
As for the ordinary Shadow Fangs, they were instantly blasted into black powder the moment they contacted the defense tower beams.
At this moment, those shadow monsters were still several thousand kilometers away from the Witch Race Main City.
Yet already countless had been slaughtered.
By the time these monsters get close, they will no longer pose any threat.
Even if those Shadow Dominators used countermeasures, it would be useless.
In the sky, large swathes of shadow fangs died and then fell.
Including the Shadow Crystals on their bodies, naturally disappearing into the air.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing silently sighed at the loss.
But he quickly tossed this emotion aside.
Indeed, it would be more profitable if Han Xing let these shadow monsters land on the Witch Race Sky Island and then carry out attacks.
But there’s no need for that.
There are still billions of civilians on the main island.
In the face of such a massive war, these civilians have no ability to resist.
Coupled with the Witch Race Sky Island being as large as a country.
Even Han Xing cannot attend to every corner.
Wu Ling’Er left the Sky Island to Han Xing when she departed.
Han Xing, naturally, will return it to her, whole and intact.
Besides, he has millions of Survivors helping him collect Shadow Crystals, so there’s no shortage.
For the Shadow Crystals on the Witch Race Soldiers, he has ways of obtaining them after the war ends.
Watching the scale of the Shadow Mist shrinking.
This wave of the Shadow Legion’s invasion is already insignificant.
Han Xing opened the communication channel.
"Alright, there’s no problem here anymore."
"You guys continue to support the other Witch Race Sky Islands.
Those Witch Race officers had just heard Kathy’s call for help, and not even a minute had passed.
Suddenly hearing Han Xing say there’s no problem anymore.
For a moment, they seemed unable to process it.
"O-Okay, Lord Han Xing!" that group of Witch Race officers answered in confusion.
Han Xing nodded.
At this time, as if remembering something, he continued.
"Oh right, send some people over later, and I’ll support you with some troops."
With the combined firepower of the Witch Race Main City and Ten Thousand Stars City, there is no fear of large-scale Shadow Legion invasions.
And on Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City, there are terrifying numbers of troop types.
These troops have nothing to do when idle.
If they can be deployed on the battlefield, they will be able to play a powerful role.
Han Xing dispatched nearly half of the Demon Elephant War Chariots, Chimeras, and Minotaur troops from the Ten Thousand Stars City.
To support other battlefields.
With such formidable forces joining in.
It can be said that in the area governed by Wu Ling’Er, the so-called Shadow Legion no longer poses a threat.
They come as many as they die!
Seeing the situation under control.
Han Xing immediately led everyone back into the Abyssal Rift.
Meanwhile.
In an unknown area in the Witch Race Territory.
A small Sky Island measuring only a few thousand square meters.
Several humans were cautiously maneuvering the Sky Island.
Among them, two figures with long swords and contrasting auras.
Precisely Zhou Huang and Cheng.
However, compared to when they initially emerged from the Land of the Abandoned Gods full of spirit.
Now they appeared extremely downtrodden.
The team had been reduced from ten to less than six.
And each carried some injuries.
At this moment, Cheng gripped his black longsword, ready for battle, "Zhou Huang, are you sure we won’t join the other Survivors in the Witch Race army."
"But instead, continue acting alone?"
Zhou Huang nodded, "Yes."
"Why?"
Cheng looked bewildered, "Although our combat strength is strong."
"But it’s nothing compared to the Shadow Legion."
"With the Witch Race being so dangerous now, with war everywhere."
"If we act alone, not only can we not earn enough Battle Merit, but we might also face life-threatening danger!"
Zhou Huang looked at him calmly, "Can’t comprehend it?"
Cheng nodded, "Yeah, can’t comprehend."
"Initially, our plan was merely to establish ourselves in the Witch Race."
"Now, Star River has paved a way for us."
"That is, to climb through the military ranks."
"With our abilities, I believe we can quickly stand out in the military.
"Then, using these privileges, gradually develop our own force."
Hearing this, Zhou Huang sneered, "Yes, this way, we can establish ourselves in the Witch Race."
"If we do well, we might even land an official position."
"But by doing so, wouldn’t we just become Star River’s subordinates?"
Cheng’s puzzlement deepened.
Zhou Huang continued.
"Haven’t you noticed?"
"Star River came out way earlier than us, already having considerable influence in the Witch Race."
"Even those high-ranking Witch Race officers have to follow his orders."
"No matter how well we perform, no matter how much say we have in the army, in the end, we’d still be just Star River’s subordinates."
Cheng was stunned.
Initially, he hadn’t thought in this direction.
But now, Zhou Huang enlightened him.
Star River indeed wields a strong influence in the Witch Race Territory.
At this point, Zhou Huang also sighed helplessly.
"Right now, whether in the Land of the Abandoned Gods or in the Witch Race Territory, Star River already wields significant power."
"We have no hope of surpassing him."
"Only, by staying ahead of him..."
"By entering new territories ahead of everyone else."
"Leveraging our abilities, we can prepare in advance on the new maps and seize the initiative!"
Cheng stared at him, seemingly surprised that Zhou Huang was pulling another bold move.
"Zhou..."
Before Cheng could say more.
Zhou Huang interrupted, "This time you can rest assured, I’ve looked into it."
"Through the Witch Race Border, you can reach the Beastman Kingdom, and once through the Beastman Kingdom, you enter the Sky Island Forest."
"Then eventually you can reach the Elf Realm."

"The guy’s like a monster."

"After all this time, I’ve given up all hope..."

For someone so proud, this was a huge blow to one’s self-esteem.
