chapters.title: Chapter 420 - 304: Fourth Transformation Full Level, A Qualitative Change in Strength
paragraphs: Ever since meeting Han Xing,
Zhou Huang’s brilliance had gradually been overshadowed by him, and eventually, he was on the verge of becoming just another face in the crowd.
At this moment, Zhou Huang could only smile bitterly and say, "To be honest, if I could, I wouldn’t want to compete with him for the title of number one."
"We’re all part of the Human Race, and clearly, being with him is much better than being with us."
"But there’s no choice, the things that the Golden Dragon gave me are related to the hearts of the people..."
"Hearts of the people?" Boundless wondered.
Zhou Huang nodded, "To be precise, it’s the people’s hearts."
"Only by uniting the people’s hearts and being revered by ten thousand people can I unleash the power of those things."
In fact, upon entering Sky Island Paradise,
Zhou Huang had activated the SS-level hidden Talent, Human Emperor’s Destiny.
He then knew that he was a candidate for the Human Emperor of this generation.
Yet now, he was watching helplessly as Han Xing took step after step ahead of him, stealing all the limelight.
Zhou Huang was unwilling.
So, he planned to step out of the Witch Race Territory first.
This time, he wanted to be ahead of Han Xing!
Han Xing had no idea about Zhou Huang’s plans.
He continued seizing time, leading everyone in a mad rush to level up.
Time flew by, and a week had passed...
During this period, the full-scale invasion of the Shadow Legion had reached a more frenzied stage.
In just these few days, the Witch Race Main City where Han Xing was located had faced three waves of monster attacks, each not lesser than billions in scale.
With the combined firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, they could withstand the attacks,
But that didn’t mean other Witch Race Main Cities could do the same.
More and more Sky Islands were being covered by the Shadow Mist.
War once again escalated to its most intense phase.
Even the fanatic Human Race Survivors were now feeling a tinge of exhaustion.
There was no choice; the frequency of the wars was too intense.
They would follow the main force to eliminate shadow monsters on one Sky Island,
Only to immediately join a Witch Race transport ship to support the next battlefront without respite.
Unlike during the Blood Tide duration,
The human survivors had some time to catch their breath.
This time, the number of monsters in the Shadow Legion was overwhelming, endless to kill.
The continued high-intensity battles had kept them on edge.
This, too, sent a signal.
The situation on the borders had worsened severely.
To the extent that they released more shadow monsters to invade Witch Race territories.
But the only good news was,
No legends had fallen yet.
This indicated that, at the very least, the legendary-level battlefield could still be barely maintained.
After defeating the level 60 stage boss, Wandering Demon,
A white light rose from Han Xing’s body.
The system prompt appeared.
"Your level has increased, current level LV50..."
"Congratulations, you have officially reached Fourth Transformation Full Level."
"Achievement: Path of the Strong has been unlocked..."
"Since you are the first survivor across the server to reach level 50, basic attributes +300."
Upon hearing the system prompt, a strong sense of joy flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
"Finally... reached level 50!"
Instantly, Han Xing felt a surge of immense strength emerging within his body!
It wasn’t just the attribute boost from leveling up, but also the recent additional rewards!
All attributes +300, equivalent to five levels’ worth of attribute growth for him now.
Moreover, Han Xing had previously slain three Shadow Legends, one being a High-tier Legend.
Altogether, it accounted for an additional boost of nearly a thousand in four-dimensional attributes!
Han Xing casually glanced at his own panel.
[Name: Han Xing]
[Race: Human Race]
[Profession: Wild Ranger]
[Level: LV50]
[Power: 6117, Agility: 6732, Spirit: 5874, Physical Strength: 6031]
Terrifying attributes!
Compared to other survivors, even if they reached level 50, their attributes would probably be only half of Han Xing’s.
Furthermore, this was without Han Xing equipping the Wandering Demon Set or the Demon-Defying Battle Bow.
Now that his level met the requirements,
It was time to equip these powerful gears!
With a full Orange Set and a Divine Artifact Level weapon,
Han Xing couldn’t even imagine how powerful he would become.
That’s right.
After all these days of effort,
They had already farmed enough for a complete Orange Set.
And not just one set, but two or three sets!
The other Wandering Demon Set was given to Su Xiaoyang.
She was also a Hunter, making the Wandering Demon Set just as suitable for her.
Even Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun had now donned their Orange Sets.
Since their Orange gear was all around level forty, they didn’t need to be level 50 to equip them.
At this moment, Han Xing eagerly began equipping the Wandering Demon gear from his backpack piece by piece.
First, the primary equipment: Wandering Demon Boots!
These boots, imbued with immense Power of the Demon,
Their surface was red-black, as if dried blood had congealed upon them.
At the ankle, two menacing demon spikes protruded.
Han Xing immediately put them on, and his attributes soared to another level!
Next were the Wandering Demon Pants.
The blood-stained pants had dark red patterns, resembling a network of lava rivers on charred earth.
Emitting faint glows intermittently.
Then came the Wandering Demon Hide Armor.
Also in a red-black hue, the top was form-fitting, showcasing Han Xing’s muscles perfectly.
Following that was a pair of wrist guards with demon spikes.
With each piece of Wandering Demon Set Han Xing equipped, his aura skyrocketed significantly!
Even those around him felt a slight sense of apprehension.
Just then, Han Xing had one last piece of gear in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - 304: Fourth Transformation Full Level, A Qualitative Change in Strength
paragraphs: Wandering Demon Cloak!
This cloak occupies the helmet slot, so once equipped, you can no longer wear a helmet.
The cloak looks extremely cool, as if it’s truly made from some special creature’s leather, exuding a terrifying aura.
Han Xing casually flicked his wrists, equipping the cloak.
Whoosh—
A powerful aura surged forth.
If the individual pieces of the Wandering Demon Set only enhanced Han Xing’s attributes and aura,
then now, with the final piece equipped, Han Xing’s overall aura underwent a bizarre transformation!
It was as if he had changed from a powerful member of the Human Race to a terrifying Demon!
There was even a faint aura of a High-level Demon.
Seeing the shocked expressions around him, Han Xing’s lips curled into a smile.
He could feel the powerful boost brought by the Orange Demon Set.
Now, he had the confidence to fight the Shadow Legend head-on and even achieve victory!
However, this was not the end!
In the next moment.
He pulled out a longbow from his bag, its appearance somewhat sinister and covered with eyes.
[Divine Artifact: Demon-Defying Battle Bow]
The moment Han Xing gripped the bow.
His aura once again underwent a qualitative change!
Now even more formidable than the Wandering Demon, by more than tenfold!
Like a Demon Monarch who has mastered royalty, descending upon the realm.
Ordinary Low-level Demons might just kneel and submit upon encountering him!
Beside him, Shen Yun couldn’t help but exclaim, "Cool!"
Cheng Jianyong also shouted excitedly, "Damn, that’s way too cool!"
"I thought my Thousand Ridge Set was already impressive, but Brother Xing’s Wandering Demon outfit looks several times cooler!"
Shen Yun glanced at him and said, "Your Thousand Ridge Set is an eyesore, okay?"
"With all those bones, if you weren’t wearing clothes underneath, people might think you’re just a Skeleton Soldier!"
When Shen Yun called his set ugly, Cheng Jianyong protested, "Come on, you’re the Skeleton Soldier!"
"I call this skeletal beauty!"
Shen Yun retorted disdainfully, "Skeletal beauty my ass!"
"Look at my Abyss Demon Set, with its quality and full-body sense of security; now that’s what I call impressive!"
Cheng Jianyong, unfazed, countered, "A pitch-black iron lump where I can’t even see the face, what’s so impressive about that?"
The two began arguing.
Beside them, two girls exchanged a glance, each with a helpless smile on their face.
They simply couldn’t understand these men’s aesthetics.
Still, the equipment from the Abyssal Rift always had those quirky appearances.
They just couldn’t see how these things were equated with looking cool.
Even Zhang Lianmeng’s ’Fear Wanderer’ set required a lot of mental preparation before she dared to put it on.
But——
Now all five of them had orange sets.
It meant they had all seen a massive upgrade.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced at his own status panel.
Immediately, his heart surged with excitement.
[Name: Han Xing]
[Race: Human Race]
[Profession: Wild Ranger]
[Level: LV50]
[Power: 8074, Agility: 9342, Spirit: 7961, Physical Strength: 8231]
His All Attributes have skyrocketed significantly compared to before equipping the gear!
Plus, the strong Attached Effects that come with the set.
The actual improvement is over a hundred percent!
Powerful!
Unparalleled power!
At this moment, Han Xing even had a feeling.
Even without relying on team support, or even using the Oracle Throne,
he was confident in killing the Shadow Legend.
If he went all out, he even dared to take on an entity like the Shadow Demon Venerable.
As for whether he could win, that was another matter.
Now, Han Xing had four pieces of Divine Artifact Level equipment on him.
They are: Demon-Defying Battle Bow, Oracle Throne, Mask of the Golden Goddess, and Blood Slaughter Medal.
The first three pieces require no further elaboration.
But the unique one is Han Xing’s final equipment, the Blood Slaughter Medal.
It was upgraded from the King of the Wilderness Medal.
[Blood Slaughter Medal (Red)]: Special equipment, when worn, All Attributes increase by 20%, and deal an additional 20% damage to Lord, Dominator, and Legendary-level Creatures.

Attached Effect: Hunting Moment (When this state is active, All Attributes increase by 100%, Critical Strike Rate increases by 100%, each attack comes with a 50% life-steal effect, this state lasts for 20 seconds, with a cooldown of 24 hours.)
[Medal Upgrade Progress]
Dominator Level Creatures: 1372/10000.
Legendary Level Creatures: 0/100.
Demigod Level Creatures: 0/1.
Note: Only by killing monsters not lower in level than oneself can one gain upgrade progress, and the next phase for the medal is the Hunter of Gods (Holy Artifact).
This medal has accompanied Han Xing for a long time.
Through slaying powerful BOSS creatures, it had risen from purple to the red Divine Artifact Level.
He originally thought that was its limit!
Unexpectedly, it had another phase.
It could even be directly upgraded to a Holy Artifact!
Han Xing already knew how terrifying the attributes of a Holy Artifact could be.
He just wondered what kind of surprises the medal would bring him once it reached Holy Artifact Quality?
Han Xing couldn’t help but anticipate.
At this moment, a second system prompt appeared.
"Since you’ve reached level 50, which is the current Level Limit, the advancement task: Path of Legends has been unlocked."
"Advancement tasks are divided into three options, each with varying difficulty levels. You can choose the appropriate option based on your strength."
"Option 1: Hero’s Trial."

"Solo kill a Leader Level creature not below level 51 to acquire the Heroic Emblem and absorb a small amount of Divine Power Source Fire to advance to a Fifth Transformation Powerhouses, with a 50% All Attributes increase."
"Option 2: Heroic Trials."

"Solo kill a Lord-level creature not below level 51 to obtain the Heroic Emblem, absorb Divine Power Source Fire, and advance to a Fifth Transformation Powerhouses, with a 100% All Attributes increase."
"3: Legendary Trial."

"Solo kill a Dominator-level creature not below level 51 to obtain the Legendary Emblem. Absorb a large amount of Divine Power Source Fire to advance to a Fifth Transformation Legendary Powerhouses with a 200% All Attributes increase!"
"Gain an extra Talent, Divine Power Control!"
"Note: Legendary Trial is the hardest trial, with a certain probability of failure during breakthrough."
Seeing the system introduction, Han Xing understood.
Indeed.
The Fifth Transformation trial tasks have different options.
One can choose an appropriate difficulty based on their strength.
The first task is clearly the lowest difficulty option.
Only requiring a solo kill of a Fifth Transformation Leader Level creature, plus a small amount of Divine Power Source Fire, to advance.
However, the attribute boost isn’t as grand, only 50%.
Moreover, although it’s the lowest difficulty, that’s only true for a small portion of humanity.
Most Survivors currently don’t have the strength to solo the same-level Leader Monsters.
Otherwise, how would those creatures be called Leaders?
And this time, it’s not just challenging the same-level Leader.
They need to kill a Leader Monster that’s a level higher than the Survivors.
Though it’s just 1 level, it signifies that these monsters have already completed the Fifth Transformation!
Their strength isn’t comparable to a level 50 Leader Monster at all.
It’s almost like challenging a level 50 Lord.
And it must be completed solo.
This condition alone blocks almost 90% of the Survivors.
It’s conceivable that when Survivors reach level 50, most of them will be stuck at this level for a very long time!
The second task, with even increased difficulty, is to solo a Fifth Transformation Lord Monster...
As for the third task, it goes without saying, defeating a Fifth Transformation Dominator.
Aside from Han Xing and their small group, there aren’t many people in all humanity who can do it.
But, it’s still reasonable.
After all, the Fifth Transformation is already high-end combat power in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Even an ordinary Fifth Transformation cannot be underestimated in terms of strength.
Once the breakthrough is achieved, it will be a terrifying qualitative change.
And this was consistent with what Wu Ling’Er informed them before...

When Shen Yun called his set ugly, Cheng Jianyong protested, "Come on, you’re the Skeleton Soldier!"
"I call this skeletal beauty!"
Shen Yun retorted disdainfully, "Skeletal beauty my ass!"
"Look at my Abyss Demon Set, with its quality and full-body sense of security; now that’s what I call impressive!"
Cheng Jianyong, unfazed, countered, "A pitch-black iron lump where I can’t even see the face, what’s so impressive about that?"
The two began arguing.
Beside them, two girls exchanged a glance, each with a helpless smile on their face.
They simply couldn’t understand these men’s aesthetics.
Still, the equipment from the Abyssal Rift always had those quirky appearances.
They just couldn’t see how these things were equated with looking cool.
Even Zhang Lianmeng’s ’Fear Wanderer’ set required a lot of mental preparation before she dared to put it on.
But——
Now all five of them had orange sets.
It meant they had all seen a massive upgrade.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced at his own status panel.
Immediately, his heart surged with excitement.
[Name: Han Xing]
[Race: Human Race]
[Profession: Wild Ranger]
[Level: LV50]
[Power: 8074, Agility: 9342, Spirit: 7961, Physical Strength: 8231]
His All Attributes have skyrocketed significantly compared to before equipping the gear!
Plus, the strong Attached Effects that come with the set.
The actual improvement is over a hundred percent!
Powerful!
Unparalleled power!
At this moment, Han Xing even had a feeling.
Even without relying on team support, or even using the Oracle Throne,
he was confident in killing the Shadow Legend.
If he went all out, he even dared to take on an entity like the Shadow Demon Venerable.
As for whether he could win, that was another matter.
Now, Han Xing had four pieces of Divine Artifact Level equipment on him.
They are: Demon-Defying Battle Bow, Oracle Throne, Mask of the Golden Goddess, and Blood Slaughter Medal.
The first three pieces require no further elaboration.
But the unique one is Han Xing’s final equipment, the Blood Slaughter Medal.
It was upgraded from the King of the Wilderness Medal.
[Blood Slaughter Medal (Red)]: Special equipment, when worn, All Attributes increase by 20%, and deal an additional 20% damage to Lord, Dominator, and Legendary-level Creatures.

Attached Effect: Hunting Moment (When this state is active, All Attributes increase by 100%, Critical Strike Rate increases by 100%, each attack comes with a 50% life-steal effect, this state lasts for 20 seconds, with a cooldown of 24 hours.)
[Medal Upgrade Progress]
Dominator Level Creatures: 1372/10000.
Legendary Level Creatures: 0/100.
Demigod Level Creatures: 0/1.
Note: Only by killing monsters not lower in level than oneself can one gain upgrade progress, and the next phase for the medal is the Hunter of Gods (Holy Artifact).
This medal has accompanied Han Xing for a long time.
Through slaying powerful BOSS creatures, it had risen from purple to the red Divine Artifact Level.
He originally thought that was its limit!
Unexpectedly, it had another phase.
It could even be directly upgraded to a Holy Artifact!
Han Xing already knew how terrifying the attributes of a Holy Artifact could be.
He just wondered what kind of surprises the medal would bring him once it reached Holy Artifact Quality?
Han Xing couldn’t help but anticipate.
At this moment, a second system prompt appeared.
"Since you’ve reached level 50, which is the current Level Limit, the advancement task: Path of Legends has been unlocked."
"Advancement tasks are divided into three options, each with varying difficulty levels.
You can choose the appropriate option based on your strength."
"Option 1: Hero’s Trial."

"Solo kill a Leader Level creature not below level 51 to acquire the Heroic Emblem and absorb a small amount of Divine Power Source Fire to advance to a Fifth Transformation Powerhouses, with a 50% All Attributes increase."
"Option 2: Heroic Trials."

"Solo kill a Lord-level creature not below level 51 to obtain the Heroic Emblem, absorb Divine Power Source Fire, and advance to a Fifth Transformation Powerhouses, with a 100% All Attributes increase."
"3: Legendary Trial."
"Solo kill a Dominator-level creature not below level 51 to obtain the Legendary Emblem.
Absorb a large amount of Divine Power Source Fire to advance to a Fifth Transformation Legendary Powerhouses with a 200% All Attributes increase!"
"Gain an extra Talent, Divine Power Control!"
"Note: Legendary Trial is the hardest trial, with a certain probability of failure during breakthrough."
Seeing the system introduction, Han Xing understood.
Indeed.
The Fifth Transformation trial tasks have different options.
One can choose an appropriate difficulty based on their strength.
The first task is clearly the lowest difficulty option.
Only requiring a solo kill of a Fifth Transformation Leader Level creature, plus a small amount of Divine Power Source Fire, to advance.
However, the attribute boost isn’t as grand, only 50%.
Moreover, although it’s the lowest difficulty, that’s only true for a small portion of humanity.
Most Survivors currently don’t have the strength to solo the same-level Leader Monsters.
Otherwise, how would those creatures be called Leaders?
And this time, it’s not just challenging the same-level Leader.
They need to kill a Leader Monster that’s a level higher than the Survivors.
Though it’s just 1 level, it signifies that these monsters have already completed the Fifth Transformation!
Their strength isn’t comparable to a level 50 Leader Monster at all.
It’s almost like challenging a level 50 Lord.
And it must be completed solo.
This condition alone blocks almost 90% of the Survivors.
It’s conceivable that when Survivors reach level 50, most of them will be stuck at this level for a very long time!
The second task, with even increased difficulty, is to solo a Fifth Transformation Lord Monster...
As for the third task, it goes without saying, defeating a Fifth Transformation Dominator.
Aside from Han Xing and their small group, there aren’t many people in all humanity who can do it.
But, it’s still reasonable.
After all, the Fifth Transformation is already high-end combat power in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Even an ordinary Fifth Transformation cannot be underestimated in terms of strength.
Once the breakthrough is achieved, it will be a terrifying qualitative change.
And this was consistent with what Wu Ling’Er informed them before...

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - 305: Floor 70, Slaying the Legendary Giant Dragon!
paragraphs: Among the Fifth Transformation, there are also differences in strength.
Countless people have fallen at this step, exhausting their lifespan, unable to break through.
Eventually, they fade into obscurity.
Becoming a legend is as rare as phoenix feathers.
However, Han Xing also knows.
The original inhabitants of this world definitely have a different way to break through to legend status than they do.
As beings who suddenly arrived in this world, they also have their own advantages.
The system will clearly list the advancement conditions for you, eliminating the need to explore laboriously.
Han Xing pondered, "Killing Dominators above the Fifth Transformation?"
"If I kill a stronger legend, does that count as fulfilling the task condition?"
"If not, that would be a bit of a hassle..."
After all, during the war period, finding Fifth Transformation legends is not difficult.
But Fifth Transformation Dominator level creatures are not common.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong asked from the side, "Brother Xing, what are we going to do now?"
"Continue farming the Abyssal Rift?"
Upon hearing Cheng Jianyong’s question, Han Xing pondered for a moment and asked, "How much experience value have you gained now? How much more to reach level 50?"
The group listened and glanced at their experience bars.
Then they reported their upgrade progress.
As Han Xing expected, most were over 60% of level 49.
At this rate, it will take another three days.
To bring them all to level 50.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Now, our strength has improved."
"I have a feeling that we can challenge higher levels of the Abyssal Rift."
"The higher the levels, the more experience monsters will give."
"Let’s see if we can rush to level 70 and claim the first clear reward of the Abyssal Rift!"
The group’s eyes brightened upon hearing this.
Then they all agreed with Han Xing’s decision.
The next moment.
They all stepped into the passage of the 61st layer of the Abyssal Rift.
Just as Han Xing expected.
The monsters on the 61st layer already possessed the strength of the Fifth Transformation.
Even the most ordinary Resentful Spirits and Evil Eyes were comparable to Fourth Transformation elites and leaders.
The leap from the Fourth Transformation to the Fifth Transformation is significant.
However, this was not difficult for Han Xing and his group.
Their strength was far beyond what it was two months ago.
They began frantically clearing the Abyssal Rift.
61st layer...
62nd layer...
63rd layer...
In four hours.
This time, they went straight to the 70th layer of the Abyssal Rift!
The system prompt appeared.
[Abyssal Rift, the challenge of the 70th layer is about to begin...]
"Please note, this is deep within the rift, very close to the Abyss Realm. Your battle fluctuations may be sensed by powerful entities within the Abyss Realm, please proceed with caution."
Hearing this prompt, the group frowned.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Being sensed, what does this mean?"
"Could some guys come out of the Abyss Realm to attack us?"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s very likely."
Upon hearing this, everyone felt a sense of crisis.
After all, the power of the Abyss Realm, even if they haven’t been there, they know.
A powerful race that has invaded the Holy Spirit Realm several times and almost succeeded.
How many terrifying creatures there are inside is unimaginable!
Han Xing said at this time, "However, it’s fortunate the system gave us a warning."
"We just need to eliminate the boss at the end as quickly as possible, and if there’s danger, teleport away immediately without hesitation."
Hearing this, everyone also felt slightly relieved.
Meanwhile.
Monsters emerged on the 70th layer.
Compared to previous layers, many new species appeared here.
Such as crab-like creatures covered with thick scales, with horns.
Others appeared to have magma flowing through them, similar to stone man-like creatures.
And Han Xing and his group’s old friends.
Hellfire.
These monsters all exhibited traits of the Abyss Realm.
The Hellfires here were obviously much larger than those summoned by Han Xing.
However, for the current Han Xing and the group, it made no difference.
After a fight.
The monsters turned into rich experience, falling at the group’s feet.
Han Xing’s experience bar was already full; killing more monsters wouldn’t increase it.
But Cheng Jianyong and the others were different.
Though it took longer to kill from the 60th to the 70th level,
The experience value gained was tremendous!
In just four hours, they gained about 10% experience!
Equivalent to the yield from going back and forth four to five times from the 50th to the 60th layer.
At this rate, it would only take them a day or two to all reach level 50.
Everyone showed joy on their faces!
Because this way, the leveling speed could greatly accelerate!
However, before they could rejoice for long.
The ground in front of them trembled violently.
Ahead, in a massive magma pool, something seemed to be emerging.
Gurgle——
Gurgle——
Bubbles continuously rose from the magma pool.
The temperature of the entire space increased again.
Rumble!
The ground shook, magma boiled!
The next moment, they saw a mountain slowly rising from the magma.
Splashing——
Magma gathered into rivers, flowing down from the mountain.
As the mountain gradually emerged from the magma, everyone realized it was not a mountain at all!
It was a gigantic creature with red scales, its body seemingly composed of magma!
A dragon!
A magma giant dragon!
When the giant dragon, its body flowing with magma and exuding terrifying firelight, appeared.
The region of the 70th layer of the Abyssal Rift was instantly fully illuminated.
Not only that, the dense fog nearby was dispelled by the terrifying firelight, revealing more ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - 305: Floor 70, Slaying the Legendary Giant Dragon!
paragraphs: The battle space on the 70th floor suddenly expanded tenfold!
It’s the first time Han Xing has encountered a creature capable of affecting the misty space.
This indicates that the dragon’s power far exceeds everyone’s imagination.
Attributes of this dragon appeared before Han Xing.
[Molten Giant Dragon: Astalos (Legendary Level Creature)]
[Level]: LV53
[Attributes]: Power 11327, agility 10246, Spirit 11045, Constitution 12078.
[Skills]: Magma Burst, Tearing the Earth, Catastrophe Dragon’s Roar, Giant Dragon Domain, Heaven-Burning Wings (Legendary Skills), Ultimate Skill—World-Ending Dragon Flame!

"Note: The Molten Giant Dragon carries the pure dragon bloodline. Thousands of years ago, it was defeated by the Great Demon Monarch and has since guarded the entrance to the Abyss Realm. All intruding creatures into the Abyss Realm will face destructive sanctions from the Molten Giant Dragon."
Formidable attributes!
Different from the shadow giant dragon phantom they faced before and the undead bone dragon below.
This is a complete dragon in the true sense!
With legendary level strength and pure dragon bloodline.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun clenched their fists spontaneously, preparing for battle.
However, Han Xing gazed at the giant creature in the air, his eyes bursting with dazzling brilliance!
Whoa! A dragon!
And it’s a legendary level dragon!
Han Xing hasn’t forgotten.
The last piece of material he needs to create the Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele is a legendary dragon soul!
It’s been half a year since he got that Holy Artifact blueprint!
Han Xing has been searching long and hard, and now he’s finally seen hope.
If he can take down this dragon, there’s a high chance he can gather the last material for the Holy Artifact.
At this moment, his breath became a little rapid!
The molten giant dragon’s eyes, like fireballs, glanced at Han Xing.
It seemed angry that he dared to look at it with such a gaze.
"Hmph—"
The molten giant dragon coldly snorted.
The entire magma lands instantly erupted.
"Who allowed an insignificant ant like you to look at me with such eyes?"
The dragon’s voice was deafening!
Faced with this terrifying entity’s questioning
However, Han Xing didn’t respond but directly shouted: "Xiaoyang, control it!"
"Everyone else, full firepower!"
"Take it down quickly!"
As Han Xing’s words fell.
Su Xiaoyang shot an arrow full of green energy.
In the void, countless green vines instantly grew, attempting to wrap around the massive body of the molten giant dragon.
However, as soon as those vines touched the dragon’s body, they produced a sizzling sound.
The surface of the molten giant dragon was extremely hot, causing each vine to be burned to ash before they could even approach.
Seeing this, everyone froze.
The dragon’s strength seemed far beyond their imagination.
Su Xiaoyang’s secret technique seemed to be countered.
"Hmph! A group of ants think they can control me with such means, truly overestimating themselves!"
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong cursed.
"Damn it, these dragons are each more arrogant than the last, becoming watchdogs for demons yet are so full of themselves."
In the air, the molten giant dragon seemed to understand Cheng Jianyong’s words.
Its fireball-like pupils widened instantly.
The words seemed to sting its ego.
"Human Race, are you seeking death?"
Cheng Jianyong retorted, "So what, aren’t you just a watchdog tied here by the Great Demon Monarch? Is saying it forbidden?"
The molten giant dragon was utterly furious.
Without hesitation, it unleashed a scorching dragon breath!
Whoosh—
Where the dragon breath passed, all life was extinguished.
At the critical moment.
Shen Yun raised the big hammer, a blinding Holy Light burst forth.
His figure flashed, shielding everyone behind him.
After the dragon breath dissipated, the entire 70th floor’s magma lands were boiling intensely.
However, on one piece of blackened earth.
Five figures stood there.
The molten giant dragon’s pupils flickered, seemingly very surprised.
Because it saw that although these people endured its dragon breath, they seemed unharmed.
Below, Shen Yun’s lips curved into a confident smile.
Not only Han Xing has been improving during this time.
Shen Yun’s prowess also saw great advancements.
Especially after donning the Abyss Knight Set, the defense power reached a terrifying level.
Now, he actually withstood the dragon’s breath of a legendary giant dragon!
Although the dragon breath is merely a regular attack from a legendary giant dragon.
It doesn’t matter; Shen Yun, with fourth transformation strength, accomplished the feat of resisting attacks from legendary creatures!
The Molten Giant Dragon snorted coldly, "You ants have some skill."
"However, let me show you the true power of a dragon!"
In the next moment—
everyone saw the Molten Giant Dragon abruptly spread its wings wide.
Its already over ten-thousand-meter long body, at that moment, reached a sky-covering and sun-blocking size.
At the same time, the magma across the entire land began to boil violently!
"Boom!"
Countless magma turned into towering fire pillars, surging skyward.
This dragon is far stronger than an ordinary legend!
By the power classification of this world, it possesses at least middle-tier legendary strength.
Also, the skill it released is clearly one of its ultimate moves.
Even Han Xing dared not claim he could take it head-on.
Thus, Han Xing decided to kill it as quickly as possible.
"With you launching moves one after another, anyone would think this is a turn-based fight."
With that, he slowly drew the bowstring in his hand.
A massive bright moon gradually gathered.
This full moon would change according to the enemy’s size.
Even though the Molten Giant Dragon’s form was sky-covering, it was fully enveloped by the moon.
When that moon was fully formed,
the Molten Giant Dragon was instantly frozen in mid-air.
Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Secret Technique couldn’t trap such a terrifying creature.
That didn’t mean Han Xing’s Shattered Moon couldn’t.
After all, it was the signature skill of the Fifth Generation Wild Ranger.
Always invincible!
As the Molten Giant Dragon was trapped, it was like a giant monster sealed in amber.
In the next moment—
Han Xing directly summoned the Oracle Throne, and his already terrifying aura soared dramatically!
Simultaneously.
Shen Yun also timely cast various state amplifications on Han Xing.
At that moment.
The divine power on Han Xing surged!
When the bowstring was slowly pulled back.
The space in front of Han Xing subtly warped.
This indicated that his current attack power was enough to affect space.
Whizz!
The first arrow shot out, as fast as lightning!
Before the sound could be heard, a head-sized, transparent blood hole suddenly appeared on the Molten Giant Dragon’s body.
Splurt!
A stream of blood pearls was drawn out.
The legendary dragon was severely injured.
Han Xing’s every strike now could cause severe damage to legendary holy artifacts.
Plus, his terrifying attack frequency.
Next came a machine-gun-like barrage!
Whizz! Whizz whizz whizz!
Each arrow carried enough destructive power to tear space.
In an instant, the Molten Giant Dragon was blasted into a sieve.
This was Han Xing’s current strength.
Even a legendary creature like the Molten Giant Dragon was suppressed by him.
If it were an ordinary Shadow Legend, Han Xing would have shot it down by now.
But should we say the Molten Giant Dragon is truly worthy of being a Dragon Race creature?
Its immense life force is unrivaled at its tier.
Even with such grave injuries, it began to heal its terrifying wounds at a visibly fast pace.
Though it seems long, the elapsed time was actually quite short.
This was only the first second of the Shattered Moon skill’s duration.
And the Shattered Moon, has a full five-second strong control.
In other words, when the Molten Giant Dragon was controlled, its fate was already sealed.
Meanwhile.
The attacks from others also fell onto the dragon’s body one after another.
Splurt! Splurt splurt splurt!
Sword Qi ravaged, Elemental Shock erupted.
When the five seconds ended.
The bright moon exploded instantly.
Swoosh—
Terrorizing energy rampaged.
Then, everyone saw the massive corpse of the Molten Giant Dragon falling from the sky.
System prompt appeared.
"Successfully killed a legendary creature: Molten Giant Dragon, gained 3.874 billion experience points, automatically absorbed the opponent’s divine power, all attributes +200."

In the next moment—
everyone saw the Molten Giant Dragon abruptly spread its wings wide.
Its already over ten-thousand-meter long body, at that moment, reached a sky-covering and sun-blocking size.
At the same time, the magma across the entire land began to boil violently!
"Boom!"
Countless magma turned into towering fire pillars, surging skyward.
This dragon is far stronger than an ordinary legend!
By the power classification of this world, it possesses at least middle-tier legendary strength.
Also, the skill it released is clearly one of its ultimate moves.
Even Han Xing dared not claim he could take it head-on.
Thus, Han Xing decided to kill it as quickly as possible.
"With you launching moves one after another, anyone would think this is a turn-based fight."
With that, he slowly drew the bowstring in his hand.
A massive bright moon gradually gathered.
This full moon would change according to the enemy’s size.
Even though the Molten Giant Dragon’s form was sky-covering, it was fully enveloped by the moon.
When that moon was fully formed,
the Molten Giant Dragon was instantly frozen in mid-air.
Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Secret Technique couldn’t trap such a terrifying creature.
That didn’t mean Han Xing’s Shattered Moon couldn’t.
After all, it was the signature skill of the Fifth Generation Wild Ranger.
Always invincible!
As the Molten Giant Dragon was trapped, it was like a giant monster sealed in amber.
In the next moment—
Han Xing directly summoned the Oracle Throne, and his already terrifying aura soared dramatically!
Simultaneously.
Shen Yun also timely cast various state amplifications on Han Xing.
At that moment.
The divine power on Han Xing surged!
When the bowstring was slowly pulled back.
The space in front of Han Xing subtly warped.
This indicated that his current attack power was enough to affect space.
Whizz!
The first arrow shot out, as fast as lightning!
Before the sound could be heard, a head-sized, transparent blood hole suddenly appeared on the Molten Giant Dragon’s body.
Splurt!
A stream of blood pearls was drawn out.
The legendary dragon was severely injured.
Han Xing’s every strike now could cause severe damage to legendary holy artifacts.
Plus, his terrifying attack frequency.
Next came a machine-gun-like barrage!
Whizz!
Whizz whizz whizz!
Each arrow carried enough destructive power to tear space.
In an instant, the Molten Giant Dragon was blasted into a sieve.
This was Han Xing’s current strength.
Even a legendary creature like the Molten Giant Dragon was suppressed by him.
If it were an ordinary Shadow Legend, Han Xing would have shot it down by now.
But should we say the Molten Giant Dragon is truly worthy of being a Dragon Race creature?
Its immense life force is unrivaled at its tier.
Even with such grave injuries, it began to heal its terrifying wounds at a visibly fast pace.
Though it seems long, the elapsed time was actually quite short.
This was only the first second of the Shattered Moon skill’s duration.
And the Shattered Moon, has a full five-second strong control.
In other words, when the Molten Giant Dragon was controlled, its fate was already sealed.
Meanwhile.
The attacks from others also fell onto the dragon’s body one after another.
Splurt!
Splurt splurt splurt!
Sword Qi ravaged, Elemental Shock erupted.
When the five seconds ended.
The bright moon exploded instantly.
Swoosh—
Terrorizing energy rampaged.
Then, everyone saw the massive corpse of the Molten Giant Dragon falling from the sky.
System prompt appeared.
"Successfully killed a legendary creature: Molten Giant Dragon, gained 3.874 billion experience points, automatically absorbed the opponent’s divine power, all attributes +200."

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - 306: Digesting Rewards, Constructing the Holy Artifact!
paragraphs: "Successfully killed Legendary Creature: Molten Giant Dragon, gained 3.874 billion experience value, automatically absorbed opponent’s divine power, all attributes +200."
Hearing the prompt, a smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
Great! Another two hundred points added to the four attributes!
He suddenly had a strange idea.
Since the 70th layer of the Abyssal Rift clearly has Legendary Creatures.
Could he repeatedly enter and keep slaying these legendary creatures to enhance his attributes?
That way, he wouldn’t even need to advance, just continuously absorb divine power.
His basic attributes would be enough to surpass those legendary, even demigod-level strong.
At this time, the second system prompt appeared.
"Note: The Molten Giant Dragon is an Abyssal Rift creature and can only have its divine power absorbed upon first kill."
Han Xing rolled his eyes.
Well, the system really wouldn’t let him exploit loopholes.
However, even if he couldn’t use this mechanism to farm attributes, the reward for the 70th layer was still incredibly terrifying.
Han Xing saw that at the place where the Molten Giant Dragon died, there was a massive red flame floating, with faint dragon roars emanating from it.
Besides that.
On the magma also quietly laid a Magma Battleaxe! And several glowing stones.
Han Xing eagerly walked forward to collect them.
The system prompt appeared.
"Obtained Lava Crystal Stone *172, Annihilation Battleaxe (Orange) *1, Giant Dragon Soul (Legendary) *1..."
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
Heaven really doesn’t disappoint the diligent, it truly is a Legendary Level Giant Dragon Soul...
With this.
He can finally create the holy artifact, the Sun Crown Stele!
Han Xing was so excited he almost cried.
He immediately stored the Giant Dragon Soul in his backpack.
As for the Annihilation Battleaxe, Han Xing glanced at it and did not pay further attention.
Obviously, this is a Berserker’s weapon, part of a set with the Annihilation Battle Armor, Destruction Bracelet, etc.
However, this set’s level is 53.
Han Xing doesn’t need it at the moment.
So far, the reward for the 70th layer is already quite generous.
But this isn’t the end!
Because this is Han Xing’s first time clearing the 70th layer.
In other words, they still have the First Conquest reward to claim!
Sure enough, the system prompt appeared at this moment.
"The battle on the 70th layer of the Abyssal Rift has ended, the battle took 9 minutes and 17 seconds..."
"Because you are the first team to clear the 70th layer, you receive the First Conquest reward: Void Soul Stone *200, Abyss Technology: Demon Furnace Blueprint *1."
Han Xing’s eyes revealed a look of surprise.
There’s actually something like a Void Soul Stone in the Abyssal Rift?
Previously, he thought the transmission frequency of the twelve High-Level Teleportation Arrays was a bit too slow.
There are still tens of millions of survivors in Xingyu City that haven’t been teleported over.
With this, he could build several more High-Level Teleportation Arrays, drastically improving efficiency!
A smile appeared again at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
However, before he could be happy for long.
He suddenly sensed a terrifying aura bursting out from the distant mist.
The intensity of that aura far surpassed that of the Molten Giant Dragon by an unknown number of times.
From a great distance, everyone heard a domineering yet surprised voice.
"I can’t believe a few ants made it to this place."
"Interesting, let me see which reckless fools dared to trespass in our Abyss Realm!"
This voice felt like a demon sound piercing through their ears.
At this moment, including Han Xing, the five people’s scalps tightened at once.
They clutched their heads, feeling a dizzying sensation.
Fortunately, this appeared to just be a mental attack.
The five, with a mix of shock and fear, stared into the depths of the mist.
There seemed to be something terrifying approaching rapidly.
However, Han Xing felt a hint of familiarity in that voice.
As if realizing something, Han Xing quickly gritted his teeth and said, "Go!"
As he said that, he directly activated teleportation.
The figures of the five disappeared from their original spots.
In the next moment.
Where the five had once stood, a massive explosion suddenly occurred!
"Boom!!"
The entire space of the 70th layer erupted like a volcanic explosion, with magma shooting up a thousand meters high!
At the center of the explosion, a terrifying figure appeared.
That figure was enormous in size, with muscles packed with explosive power.
The horn atop its head was nearly a hundred meters long.
Including its overall height, it reached nearly a thousand meters!
This was a Demon.
A terrifying being with pure High-Level Demon Blood!
At this moment, the demon casually carried a great sword burning with demon fire on its shoulder, lazily scanning the surroundings.
If Han Xing were here, he could recognize it by that horn.
This guy was his old acquaintance, Julius.
Right now, Julius casually said, "Those ants sure ran fast."
Its nose twitched as if smelling the air.
"Hmm? This lingering scent is so similar to the one that stirred up the Mist Space last time..."
"But compared to that, this one is much stronger. Could it be the strong ones of a lineage?"
It would never have thought that both times were Han Xing.
It had only been a few months in between.
Julius couldn’t believe anyone could grow to such an extent in just a few months.
After a moment, the demon shook its head and said, "Forget it, if they ran, they ran."
"That woman told me that the plan is about to succeed."
"At this critical juncture, it’s best not to complicate things further."
After saying so, Julius’s figure disappeared from the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - 306: Digesting Rewards, Constructing the Holy Artifact! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Meanwhile.
Han Xing and his team of five appeared once again in the familiar Ten Thousand Stars City.
At this moment, they all looked somewhat pale.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong remarked with some lingering fear, "Damn, what was that thing that just ran at us?"
"Why did it feel even more terrifying than the Shadow Demon Venerable we encountered last time!"
Beside him, Shen Yun also nodded fearfully.
Han Xing explained, "That thing is probably a Great Demon Monarch from the Abyss Realm."
"Great Demon Monarch?"
Upon hearing this title, everyone was taken aback.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Is that guy strong?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Very strong, but I don’t know its exact power."
"Presumably, it’s much more terrifying than the Shadow Demon Venerable."
Hearing this, everyone now had a clearer understanding of the power of the Great Demon Monarch.
Han Xing said seriously at this moment, "Looks like we can’t go to the Abyssal Rift in the near future."
The presence of a Great Demon Monarch in the Abyssal Rift was completely beyond Han Xing’s expectations.
Although Han Xing did not know exactly what level of power this creature had.
But he was certain it was not something he could contend with at his current level.
So, the exploration of the Abyssal Rift would have to be put on hold for now.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "It’s okay, Brother Xing, we’re just 30% short of leveling up now, we can grind outside."
Han Xing thought for a moment and nodded.
For now, that’s the only option.
At this moment.
Han Xing looked at the items in his backpack, his gloom swept away, and he became excited again!
This time, the gains from the Abyssal Rift were significant.
Apart from the first-clear reward of that Abyssal Technology Blueprint, he also collected a Legendary Level Giant Dragon Soul!
Now, he could start crafting the Holy Artifact he had longed for, the Sun Crown Stele!
At this moment, Han Xing decided to craft the Sun Crown Stele first!
As for that Abyssal Technology Blueprint, he would check it later!
Han Xing instructed his team with a few words.
Then he summoned the Oracle Throne, and with a flash, arrived at the center of Ten Thousand Stars City.
The location of the Lord’s Mansion.
This was the safest place in Ten Thousand Stars City.
There were all sorts of high-level buildings here.
Such as four Goddess Statues, the Barbaric God Statue, Miracle Tower, and so on...
Han Xing found a vacant plot and directly clicked to build.
The system prompt appeared,

"Consume materials: Permanent Gold Ingot*100,000, Shadow Divine Stone*50,000, Shimmering Terra Stone*10,000, Philosopher’s Stone*10,000, Giant Dragon Soul (Legendary Level)*1, to construct Sun Crown Stele?"
Han Xing, about to click confirm, suddenly hesitated a bit.
Without a doubt, the Sun Crown Stele was the most material-intensive building he had crafted so far.
He still remembered a few days ago when he crafted a special building, Miracle Tower, which had several special effects.
These included speeding up construction, reducing building consumption, and other miraculous effects...
Although these effects appear randomly.
If he could get an effect that speeds up construction or reduces consumption, Han Xing would be in luck.
Han Xing looked at the Miracle Tower in front of him.
There was a dwarf with a determined face holding a hammer standing atop the tower.
His hammer seemed to contain a peculiar divine power.
At this moment, Han Xing opened the Miracle Tower interface and clicked on the miraculous effect again.
The system prompt appeared: "Sacrifice Philosopher’s Stone*500, Rhythm Black Iron*5000, to obtain a random miraculous effect?"
The materials required for sacrifice were much lower than Han Xing expected.
He was pleased in his heart and directly clicked confirm.
In the next moment.
The dwarf statue atop the tower suddenly opened its eyes.
It seemed to come to life suddenly, and the hammer it held floated down gently at this moment.
Clang!!!
After a dull striking sound.
The entire Miracle Tower burst into dazzling multicolored light, enveloping the entire Ten Thousand Stars City.
At this moment, the system prompt appeared.
"Sacrifice successful, a random miraculous effect obtained, Construction Acceleration: Within 24 hours, the required time for all buildings is reduced by 50%."
Upon hearing the system prompt, a smile appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
Although it was not the reduced consumption miraculous effect he wanted.
Speeding up the construction was still quite decent.
Thinking of this, Han Xing opened the Corona Stele Blueprint once again and directly clicked on build.
As a massive amount of materials in the warehouse disappeared.
Including that burning Giant Dragon Soul in his backpack.
If Han Xing hadn’t acquired a batch of high-level materials from the Witch Race through the Space Backpack trading channel.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t have been enough for him to build it.
However, now the materials in the warehouse were about to run out.
In front of him appeared a mist covering a thousand square meters.
The system prompt appeared.
"Building Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele 1, Lord’s Mansion acceleration effect activated, Miracle Tower acceleration effect activated, remaining time 13 hours 17 minutes..."
Thirteen hours, not a bad time.
Han Xing waited silently.
However, while waiting, it wouldn’t hurt to do other things.
That is, to improve his strength and check the attributes of another Abyssal Technology, the Demon Furnace!
Han Xing first opened the crafting interface.
Then scrolled to the bottom of the runes tab and found an orange blueprint.
It was the reward from last time’s first kill of a Legendary Level monster: the Dragon Ancestor Rune Blueprint.
[Dragon Ancestor Rune (Orange)]: A rune containing the power of a giant dragon, can greatly enhance the four-dimensional attributes of survivors, with a range of improvement: 47~55.
Note: Orange Rune, each piece of equipment can only be enchanted with one.
Without a doubt, compared to the golden rune blueprint rewarded for the first Dominator kill.
The Dragon Ancestor Rune is far more powerful than the Destruction Rune.
Four-dimensional attributes enhancement across the board.
And by more than forty points.
Enchanted on ten pieces of equipment, adds up to an attribute boost of at least 500 points.
Even more formidable than the attribute boost he got from slaying the Shadow Demon Venerable.
Han Xing checked the materials needed for crafting the Dragon Ancestor Rune.
[Materials needed to craft the Dragon Ancestor Rune (Orange)]: Rune Crystal*50,000, Spirit Core*100,000, Ether*500,000.
Although the quantity required is large, they are all basic materials.
Han Xing had no shortage of these things.
So, he crafted 100 of them in one go.
In front of him, a series of orange glows appeared.
Each Dragon Ancestor Rune took three minutes to craft.
Taking advantage of this gap, Han Xing took out the last blueprint from his backpack.
[Abyssal Technology: Demon Furnace]
[Building Effect]: Allows building a Demon Furnace that can collect souls within the territory.
[All beings killed by friendly units (including buildings, territorial troops), their souls will be automatically collected by the Demon Furnace.
Once the number of collected souls reaches a certain level, the Demon Furnace can be activated to refine pure Soul Crystals.
Soul Crystals can increase Divine Power or four-dimensional attributes.]
After reading the introduction, Han Xing couldn’t help but furrow his brows.
Truly worthy of being Abyss Technology?
The functionality of this thing sounds so... malicious...
To collect the souls of other beings and refine them into Soul Crystals.
Although the purpose of the Soul Crystals increasing Divine Power is unclear.
But clearly, it isn’t something ordinary.
However, thinking it through.
Most of what Han Xing kills are those Sky Island Monsters and the Shadow Legion.
Refining their souls should be fine.
He doesn’t have that severe of a psychological barrier.
So, Han Xing clicked on build directly.
"Consume materials: Abyssal Magic Stone*500,000, Philosopher’s Stone*5000, Shadow Divine Stone*10,000, Shimmering Terra Stone..."
Han Xing’s face was full of pain.
The materials consumed by this thing were exceptionally terrifying as well.
Building this would mean the recent material gains from trading with the Witch Race were depleted again.
Furthermore, it was still wartime.
With the Shadow Legion’s attacks getting increasingly intense, Han Xing recently had fewer chances to trade with Wu Ling’Er.
However, regardless of the pain.
Han Xing still clicked on build immediately.
Materials can be gathered later by finding more methods.
First and foremost, his strength needed to be increased.
The system prompt appeared.

Truly worthy of being Abyss Technology?
The functionality of this thing sounds so... malicious...
To collect the souls of other beings and refine them into Soul Crystals.
Although the purpose of the Soul Crystals increasing Divine Power is unclear.
But clearly, it isn’t something ordinary.
However, thinking it through.
Most of what Han Xing kills are those Sky Island Monsters and the Shadow Legion.
Refining their souls should be fine.
He doesn’t have that severe of a psychological barrier.
So, Han Xing clicked on build directly.
"Consume materials: Abyssal Magic Stone*500,000, Philosopher’s Stone*5000, Shadow Divine Stone*10,000, Shimmering Terra Stone..."
Han Xing’s face was full of pain.
The materials consumed by this thing were exceptionally terrifying as well.
Building this would mean the recent material gains from trading with the Witch Race were depleted again.
Furthermore, it was still wartime.
With the Shadow Legion’s attacks getting increasingly intense, Han Xing recently had fewer chances to trade with Wu Ling’Er.
However, regardless of the pain.
Han Xing still clicked on build immediately.
Materials can be gathered later by finding more methods.
First and foremost, his strength needed to be increased.
The system prompt appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - 307: Bolt from the Blue! Annihilation Crisis!
paragraphs: "Constructing Demon Furnace in progress, acceleration effect active, remaining time 8 hours and 52 minutes..."
After dealing with these matters, Han Xing slowly exhaled.
"The recent gains have mostly been assimilated."
"We just need to wait for the construction to be completed, and the firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City will undergo a qualitative transformation."
"And I myself am about to break through to the Legend."
"By then, besides a few active entities in this Holy Spirit Realm, there won’t be many who can match me!"
Han Xing’s eyes were filled with excitement: "And dependent on myself alone, I have gained a standing in this world!"
"The next step is to repel the Shadow Legion and bring all the Human Race survivors out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Han Xing harbored anticipation.
At this time, Han Xing recalled that he still had a type of material in his backpack.
That would be the reward of 200 Void Soul Stones for just clearing the 70th layer of the Abyssal Rift.
This item is the main material for constructing High-Level Teleportation Arrays.
With 200 pieces, it’s enough for him to construct ten Teleportation Arrays each in Ten Thousand Stars City and Xingyu City.
By then, the efficiency of the survivors’ teleportation will greatly increase.
Han Xing’s figure flickered.
Utilizing the High-Level Teleportation Array, he shuttled between the two main cities.
Ignoring the shocked eyes of those survivors, Han Xing directly constructed ten Teleportation Arrays in Xingyu City.
Then he teleported back to Ten Thousand Stars City and built ten more Teleportation Arrays.
After completing these tasks, five to six hours had passed.
Han Xing returned to Ten Thousand Stars and slowly exhaled.
Finally.
Two months of intense battles allowed him to accomplish his goal with the fastest speed.
Not only did he reach Level 50, but his strength underwent a transformative enhancement.
Even the construction of the legendary Holy Artifact is now being rushed.
Everything is developing in a good direction...
Han Xing believes that once the Sun Crown Stele is completed, he will truly possess the power to establish a foothold in this world.
Not relying on Wu Ling’Er, nor depending on the Witch Race.
But by himself, he will have the strength to engage with the world’s powerhouses honorably.
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s mood improved.
Thus, he pulled out the Communication Jade and found Wu Ling’Er’s name, then sent a message.
"Ling’Er, how’s the situation on the border?"
Han Xing was just casually asking.
Now, the war situation within the Witch Race has gradually stabilized.
There are already over a thousand Human Race survivors fighting everywhere.
Adding Han Xing’s assistance.
The advantage is snowballing, growing larger.
Now, the Witch Race’s internal situation is not much of a concern.
The only worry is the battle situation on the border.
It is said that there have been several large-scale battles between Legendary Level powerhouses on both sides.
A Legendary Battle by nature covers a wide range.
And now, the combined Legendary Level powerhouses of the Witch Race and the Shadow Legion have exceeded eighty.
Among them are top powerhouses such as the High Priest and Wu Ling’Er.
When they fight, it’s comparable to the approaching doomsday!
At this moment, Han Xing’s Communication Jade slightly glowed, it was from Wu Ling’Er.
"Brother Han Xing, we are barely managing on this side."
"Although the Shadow Legion has more Legendary Level powerhouses than us, they are much weaker than ordinary legends."
"Their organized assaults have been repelled multiple times, the High Priest even slew three Shadow Legends."
"Now, they no longer dare to continue attacking the Witch Race’s defenses."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief.
Compared to the Witch Race’s legends, those Shadow Legion legends are evidently weaker.
It’s common for a Witch Clan Priest to battle against two Shadow Legends.
Demons like Wu Ling’Er can even face off multiple Shadow Legends alone and emerge victorious.
Along with a profound High Priest.
Overall, the Witch Race’s high-end combat strength is still strong.
Otherwise, they couldn’t have persisted for so many years without being overwhelmed by the Shadow Legion’s invasion.
Han Xing at this moment asked: "Will you be returning to the main city soon?"
The materials in his warehouse had already run out.
And the soon-to-be-completed Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele has the property of providing larger boosts with more Territory Defense Towers.
So Han Xing plans to mass-produce some Towers of Death Light.
Also, to ask Wu Ling’Er for help, to collect Shadow Crystals in the hands of other Witch Race members.
This way, he can sooner exchange for the ’Spiritual Godslaying Cannon Blueprint’ from the Battle Merit Store.
Upon hearing this question, Wu Ling’Er seemed to misunderstand something.
She spoke softly: "Um... Brother Han Xing, you... don’t worry."
"Ling’Er also misses you, but... the border situation is tense recently..."
"So, Brother Han Xing will have to endure for a while longer..."
The more she spoke, the softer Wu Ling’Er’s voice got.
Han Xing seemed to know she misunderstood.
He explained quickly: "No, I mean, do you have time to help me trade another batch of materials."
"Oh..." Wu Ling’Er’s tone seemed somewhat disappointed.
But she still replied honestly: "In the short term, I probably can’t return."
"Though within a month, the Shadow Legion lost seven Legendary powerhouses at our hands, they quickly replenished them."
"I don’t know what the Shadow Monarch is planning."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing frowned immediately: "They replenished several Shadow Legends?"
"Why does it sound like those Shadow Legends are deliberately dragging you?"
Wu Ling’Er hesitated for a moment, seemingly not knowing why Han Xing had such a thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - 307: Bolt from the Blue! Annihilation Crisis! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "Dragging us?" Wu Ling’Er asked.
Han Xing replied, "Yes, because as you said, there’s certainly more than this number of Legendary Powerhouses in the Shadow Legion."
"But why haven’t they appeared all at once?"
"If it were me, wanting to deal with a person or a force, I would undoubtedly do it with the most perfect posture and the most forceful means, sweeping like thunder."
"I would never give the enemy any opportunity."
"Since they haven’t done so, it shows that they’re fearing something."
"Is there anything you Witch Race people have that the Shadow Legion fears?"
Hearing this, Wu Ling’Er fell into thought.
She couldn’t help but murmur, "An existence to be feared..."
"Could it be the Lord Saint Master?"
Han Xing had also heard about the existence of the Witch Race Saint Master, but he had never appeared.
At this time, he couldn’t help but ask, "Where exactly has your Saint Master gone?"
Wu Ling’Er replied, "The Saint Master, during that war decades ago, dragged the Shadow Monarch into the Chaotic Void, and has not come out since."
"But we can be sure that the Saint Master is still alive."
"He sometimes sends messages to the High Priest, informing him of his recent situation."
Han Xing asked, "So when was the last time the Saint Master sent a message to the High Priest?"
Wu Ling’Er had a look of contemplation in her eyes, then seemed to remember something, "It seems it was just half a month ago, when the Shadow Legend invaded in full force!"
"Since then, the Saint Master has not sent any more messages to the High Priest, and the High Priest can’t reach him!"
Her voice was tinged with a tremor.
The more she spoke, the paler Wu Ling’Er’s face became.
"Brother Han Xing, I want to go and explain this situation to the High Priest to see if he can contact the Lord Saint Master."
Han Xing nodded, "Go ahead."
However, before they could hang up the phone.
In the sky.
Suddenly, there was a muffled sound.
Crack!
Like a bolt of lightning in a clear sky, suddenly splitting the heavens open!
The sky above the Witch Race suddenly appeared with cracks.
As if a mirror was suddenly shattered at this moment!
At the same time, with a sound of cracking.
The sky... broke!
It truly broke!
Rumble!
Lightning and thunder, thick clouds gathered.
At this moment.
In the hearts of a billion Witch Race people, it seemed as if a sense of something had appeared.
As if an important presence suddenly departed at this moment.
The hollow feeling made them feel as if a piece of their heart was missing.
"Swish..."
At this moment, the sky suddenly poured down a torrent of rain.
Accompanied by lightning and thunder.
Numerous Witch Race people came out of their homes, kneeling on the ground and crying aloud.
Watching the chaos on the Witch Race Sky Island below.
Han Xing frowned and asked, "Ling’Er, what happened?"
This time, Wu Ling’Er did not answer immediately.
A moment later, she replied with a trembling voice.
"Brother Han Xing... the... the Saint Master is dead!"
Buzz!
This statement struck Han Xing’s head like a bolt from the blue.
The Witch Race Saint Master is dead!
That confirmed peerless powerhouse with Demigod strength is dead...
Died so suddenly, without any forewarning.
And this also confirmed Han Xing’s speculation.
The Shadow Legion dragging the Witch Race powerhouses recently was truly concentrating its power to deal with their Saint Master!
An oppressive gloom suddenly enveloped his heart.
A strong sense of crisis pervaded his body.
Han Xing suddenly lifted his head, staring dazedly at the sky.
Meanwhile.
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm, many terrifying existences at this moment felt a sense of something in their hearts.
In the distant Elf Kingdom, a man in a white robe and elegant demeanor instantly appeared in mid-air.
He stared blankly in the direction of the Witch Race, murmuring, "Helas..."
"Have you really fallen?"
In the Dwarf Kingdom and the Giant Kingdom.
A massive, mountain-like figure, and another the size of a dwarf, were engaged in a spectacular battle.
The massive war axe capable of splitting mountains clashed with the big hammer in the Dwarf’s hand, emitting dull collision sounds.
Clang!
At the collision’s center, space cracks appeared once again.
The two retreated upon contact, then both withdrew their hands.
The Dwarf waved his black iron hammer, frowning, "Big Bear, Helas, seems to be dead."
Opposite, the muscular Giant covered in fur nodded, "Dead."
"Boloma, let’s cease this battle for now."
The Dwarf had no objections.
Then, they both stood in place, gazing toward the Witch Race Territory.
Meanwhile, in the Sky Island Forest, Beastman Kingdom, and even the Path of the Giant Dragon...
Those powerhouses all felt a sense of something arise in their hearts.
The death of a Demigod Level powerhouse had not occurred in the Holy Spirit Realm for many years.
Even if their relationship with the Witch Race isn’t too good.
At this moment, these powerhouses all felt a sense of lament for the death of such a powerful being.
However, the ones hit the hardest were the Witch Race people.
At this moment.
Han Xing, from the Communication Jade, heard the tremor and sadness in Wu Ling’Er’s voice.
Before this, even if the Shadow Legion forced the Witch Race to the brink multiple times, with devastating losses.
But they all knew.
As long as the Witch Race Saint Master was there, the Witch Race would never fall.
But now, the existence that supported their belief had suddenly fallen today.
This is harder to accept than the sky collapsing.
Han Xing was just about to open his mouth to comfort Wu Ling’Er.
The next moment, he lifted his head dazedly.
In the sky, out of those shattered spaces, suddenly appeared vast black clouds.
Upon closer inspection, those were not clouds at all.
But countless billions of the Shadow Legion!
At this moment, Han Xing slapped his thigh, exclaiming, "This is it! This is the true purpose of the Shadow Legion!"
"Previously, they were deterred by the existence of the Witch Race Saint Master, so they hadn’t exerted full force."
"Now, with the Saint Master’s demise, the Shadow Legion finally shows its fangs!"
At this time.
Below, Cheng Jianyong and others had also received the news of the Saint Master’s death.
They found Han Xing at the first opportunity.
With such an event, everyone’s faces were quite grave.
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, what do we do now?"
"The Shadow Legion is coming on strong, this scale, I’m afraid only here within the Witch Race domain can stand it."
Shen Yun was right.
This time, the Shadow Legion’s number of monsters exceeded expectations.
The main city of the Witch Race could only stand against it with the coordination of Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City defense towers.
Otherwise, it was impossible to fend off the impact of such many legendary-level monsters.
In Han Xing’s mind, ideas flashed by quickly, analyzing the current situation.
"Now it’s indeed troublesome, the entire Witch Race faces more severe extinction crisis than ever."
"The Shadow Legion is craftier than we imagined!"
"Now all their monsters, including those legendary powerhouses, will be out in force against us!"
"But the more dangerous thing is still on Ling’Er’s side."
"After comparing saving some Witch Race civilians, I am more inclined to go to join the battle on the frontier first."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun furrowed his brows and fell silent.
Because Han Xing’s decision meant that they had to participate in a rescue mission at the frontier rather than protecting the main city of the Witch Race.
He nodded, "Alright."
"Although it’s very harsh, it’s true, we are unable to determine the turning point in such a large-scale war."
"If we are surrounded by those legendary-level monsters, we won’t stand a chance!"
"The hope of breaking the current crisis lies in the frontier!"

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - 308: Hope for a Breakthrough, Full-Scale Mobilization
paragraphs: "The hope to break the deadlock lies on the border!"
"Only when there’s a breakthrough on the Legendary Level battlefield will the Witch Race have a slightest chance of victory!"
"Until then, we can only hope that the Witch Race can hold on."
The meaning of Han Xing’s words was very clear.
Next, he will not help the Witch Race resist the impact of the Shadow Legion.
Instead, he will rush to the border battlefield at the fastest speed to rescue Wu Ling’Er there.
Apparently, the Witch Race will lose many people this time.
If they delay too long, the annihilation of the entire race would be a normal consequence.
However, as Han Xing said, if the Legendary Powerhouses on Wu Ling’Er’s side are entirely wiped out,
by then, not only will the Witch Race face extinction, but even Han Xing and his team will be in mortal danger too.
A slight comparison allows everyone to know what choice to make now.
After listening to Han Xing’s plan,
the other four people didn’t utter a word and quickly prepared for battle.
Long-term cooperation has made them trust Han Xing’s decisions unconditionally.
In the next moment, Han Xing directly sent a message to Kathy.
"I need to go to the border battlefield to help Wu Ling’Er fight."
"You now quickly inform the officers on other main cities to all retreat to the Witch Race border!"
"Even if it means abandoning those resource Sky Islands, try to preserve the existing forces. Staying alive is most important..."
"This is your last chance, and as for the choice, it’s up to you."
Although Han Xing said he wouldn’t interfere with the Witch Race’s situation,
he still provided them with a plan.
That is to gather all Sky Islands in the Witch Race territory towards the border.
Abandon other resource Sky Islands and focus all forces to make one last fight.
If they hold on, all will be well, with only a massive loss of resources.
If they can’t hold on, it will spell the end for the race!
Logically speaking, Han Xing has the right to directly give them orders.
However, at the critical moment of the Witch Race’s survival,
the choice that determines the fate of this tribe should be left to the Witch Race itself.
Upon suddenly receiving Han Xing’s message, Kathy’s face instantly grew serious.
And when she finished listening to Han Xing’s words, her pretty face turned pale with fright.
At this time, if Han Xing leaves, relying solely on the Witch Race Main City’s strength is definitely not enough to withstand.
But she also knows that Han Xing’s decision is the correct one.
Sacrificing a portion of the Witch Race people to gain the continuation of the entire tribe is indeed the most correct choice.
Moreover, Han Xing is not of the Witch Race, and being able to do this already shows utmost benevolence and righteousness.
As the overwhelming dark clouds in the sky approached closer,
Kathy only thought for a few seconds before instantly making a decision.
"I understand, Lord Han Xing. Thank you for the contribution you have made to the Witch Race. On behalf of the entire Witch Race, I solemnly thank you!"
Han Xing did not speak, but hung up the communication.
Kathy took a deep breath and directly ordered, "All officers heed the order, abandon all surrounding resource Sky Islands, return to the main city, and defend!"
"We’ll join up with Lady Saintess together!"
Upon hearing this order, all Witch Race officers were instantly astonished.
The Witch Race Main City has not changed its position since its establishment thousands of years ago.
But now, they are forced into this situation.
At the same time,
Kathy also quickly sent messages to the commanders of other Witch Race Main Cities,
and explained Han Xing’s plan.
As for how to choose, it’s up to them as well.
Meanwhile, Han Xing also sent a message in the chat channel.
"All human compatriots, abrupt changes have occurred in the Witch Race Territory, please quickly return to the Third Main City."
"There, I have left some Ancient Weapons and other forces, with your help, can hold for a long time."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s message,
the chat channel exploded immediately.
Currently, only over ten million Survivors are in the Witch Race Territory.
The others don’t yet know what the abrupt change mentioned by Han Xing is.
They all quickly asked in the chat channel.
"What’s happening? The tone of the Star God seems a bit off!"
"What is the Third Main City and what crisis?"
However, those who had signed the Lord Contract with Xingyu City, the millions of Survivors, simply had no time to answer now.
They were stunned by the number of Shadow Legion members about to arrive in the sky.
Everyone had also received Han Xing’s directives.
In a moment, a large number of Survivors prepared for battle.
They started to follow the Witch Race army back to the main city for combat.
After arranging these matters, Han Xing directly initiated the acceleration device on Ten Thousand Stars City, starting to rush madly towards the Witch Race border.
At the same time,
the overwhelming Shadow Monsters had already arrived.
The war erupted instantaneously!
Rumble!
Each main city began to unleash its firepower!
Shadow Monsters were blasted away in large chunks.
Simultaneously, those giant Sky Islands, as large as a nation, began to move.
These were the Witch Race’s Main City Sky Islands, seemingly massive but quite fast.
In just a few minutes, they had moved thousands of kilometers.
While moving, they activated Defense Towers to attack.
These giant Sky Islands were like ships caught in a level eighteen gale, sailing fiercely on the roaring sea!
Their current target was to support the nearby combat units.
To gather all the Witch Race’s populace together.
At this moment, Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City was also advancing at a high speed.
Soon, they encountered the first wave of impediment from the Shadow Legion.
Han Xing was anxious to get on the road and had no mood to fight with these monsters.

"Until then, we can only hope that the Witch Race can hold on."
