chapters.title: Chapter 429 - 308: Hope for a Breakthrough, Full-Scale Mobilization
paragraphs: The next moment.
Above Ten Thousand Stars City, thousands of beams of light burst forth!
And they blasted in the same direction.
Buzz!
After the blinding light, a thick black cloud was suddenly blasted open with a gap.
Ten Thousand Stars City rushed through the gap at high speed.
During the passage through the dark clouds, dense shadow monsters rained down like raindrops.
Pop! Pop! Pop!
The corpses of these monsters fell onto Ten Thousand Stars City. Han Xing didn’t even glance at them, continuing forward.
Whoosh—
In his ears, the howling of the fierce wind.
Above his head, countless shadow monsters.
They surged from all directions, wanting to engulf Ten Thousand Stars City at all costs.
But this group of shadow monsters was destined to fail.
As the second wave of firepower from Ten Thousand Stars City struck out, those charging shadow monsters were once again blasted into shreds.
Han Xing’s gaze was fixed ahead, as Ten Thousand Stars City raced on.
He knew that the Witch Race Border was more than two hundred thousand kilometers away from his current position.
To get there, it would take at least four to five hours!
However, there were still seven hours until the Sun Crown Stele would be completed.
This meant that even if Han Xing reached the border, the Sun Crown Stele would still not be finished.
And Ten Thousand Stars City’s firepower wouldn’t undergo a qualitative change.
The threat to legendary powerhouses would be greatly reduced.
Indeed, waiting for the Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele to be completed before heading to the border would be the most prudent approach.
However, he was uncertain if Wu Ling’Er could hold on until then.
At this critical juncture.
Not to mention two or three hours.
Even two or three minutes could determine the final outcome of the battle.
At this moment...
In the Witch Race Border region.
The Shadow Legion reappeared on a large scale.
The border defense was already in a precarious state!
However, this wasn’t the most terrifying part.
Now, the most dreadful thing was in the sky, those over a hundred fearsome figures.
A total of one hundred and forty-seven Shadow Legends, including many high-tier Shadow Demon Venerables.
In contrast, on the Witch Race side, all the priests, including Wu Ling’Er, totaled only twenty-three people.
The immense disparity made everyone feel despair.
It appeared to be a ceasefire time for both sides.
The Shadow Legion hadn’t made a move, seemingly brewing something.
The Witch Race side also didn’t dare to act rashly.
At this moment.
The High Priest Xiao, clad in a black robe, frowned deeply.
He glanced around at the faces of the other Witch clan priests.
Seeing everyone’s worried expressions.
It was imaginable how significant the impact of the Saint Master’s death was on them.
Moreover, the vast numerical difference further dampened their fighting spirit.
At this moment, a black-robed Witch clan priest sighed and said, "Saint Master..."
"Why did you suddenly perish? You were our spiritual pillar! Without you, what are we supposed to do?"
Upon saying this, the ageless-looking Witch clan priest’s tone carried a hint of choking up.
Others didn’t know how to respond to this question either.
At this moment, Xiao seemed to realize something.
If things continued this way, this war would inevitably end in failure.
The extinction of the Witch race would occur today!
Xiao seemed to be making a difficult decision. A struggling look appeared in his eyes.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er approached Xiao and asked, "High Priest, have you contacted other races?"

Xiao shook his head slightly, "So far, only the Sky Island Forest has responded. They’ve heard of the Saint Master’s death and have promised to send reinforcements in the form of several legendary powerhouses."
"Also, the Beastman Kingdom has agreed to send reinforcements."
"However, as you know, both places are still a certain distance from our Witch Race Territory."
"The Holy Spirit Realm is too vast. Even for them, it would take at least several hours to arrive."
Upon hearing the news of reinforcements, Wu Ling’Er wasn’t relieved.
Though two major races promised to send a few legends.
In the current war situation, it hardly made a difference.
The Shadow Legion was too strong, and there were simply too many legendary powerhouses.
Wu Ling’Er continued to ask, "And the Elf Race and Dwarf Race?"
"Did these major races respond?"
Compared to the assistance from the smaller races.
Wu Ling’Er understood that the real salvation for the Witch Race lay in these major races.
At this time, Xiao sighed, "Contacts have been made."
"However, you should know the mentality of these major races."
"Like the Shadow Legion, they’ve coveted our Witch Race for a long time."
"When the Saint Master was still around, they didn’t dare stretch their hands too far."
"Now that the Saint Master has fallen, I’m afraid these guys can’t hold back anymore."
"Even if they agree to aid us, the conditions they propose may be unacceptable for us."
Wu Ling’Er gritted her teeth, "But that’s still better than the Witch Race’s extinction today!"
Xiao sighed once more, "Indeed, but the premise is that they are willing to help."
"This time, even the Saint Master died."
"They must have guessed that the Shadow Monarch definitely has means to deal with demigod-level powerhouses."
"Do you think those major race powerhouses would willingly risk their lives to help us?"
Wu Ling’Er’s expression changed dramatically.
What Xiao said was also a fact.
The strength of the Shadow Legion exceeded not only their expectations but also those of the major race powerhouses.
Who would be willing to take the risk of perishing to act for another race?
At this moment.
Xiao slowly said, "The fact that these major races haven’t responded for so long indicates that they are hesitating too."
"Now, we can only rely on ourselves."
Wu Ling’Er suddenly noticed the red secret pattern on Xiao’s body flashing.
She asked in surprise, "High Priest, what are you going to do?
Xiao did not answer but burst forth with an aura and disappeared from where he stood.
The next moment.
He suddenly appeared before the two armies.
The hundred-plus terrifying Shadow Legends opposite him looked at Xiao’s action in confusion.
They seemed to not know what he intended to do now.
One must know that the current situation was evidently in the Shadow Legion’s favor.
Dragging things out was the best choice.
At this time, Xiao took the initiative to act, could it be he thought he wasn’t dying quickly enough?
However, the black-haired High Priest, with red secret patterns continuously emanating from his body, ignored their stares.
The next moment, Xiao raised both hands high.
With a whoosh!
It was as if flames burst forth from within him.
The red secret patterns seeping from his body suddenly ignited at this moment.
His momentum skyrocketed.
In no time, it rose to the limit of a legendary-level powerhouse!
And was still rising.
The Shadow Legends opposite were thrown into a commotion.
The Witch race’s legends couldn’t help but exclaim in shock, "What’s the High Priest doing?"
"Did he ignite the Witch Patterns on himself?"
"What kind of technique is this?"
Everyone was puzzled.
Being legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race, they were beings of extraordinary talent.
But before this, they had never seen anyone actually ignite their own Witch Patterns.
The Witch Patterns were equivalent to carriers of divine power, almost a part of legendary powerhouses’ bodies.
What’s the difference between this and setting oneself on fire?
At this moment, Xiao seemed to be enduring enormous pain.
But he still gritted his teeth, continuously releasing more secret patterns to burn.
At that moment, a figure with an imposing presence equal to a high-tier legend, wielding a black crystal sword, suddenly stepped forward.
Its pupils, burning with eerie green flames, stared intently at the Witch Race High Priest and asked in a hoarse voice.
"Xiao... what are you doing?"
Upon hearing the questioning, Xiao glanced at it but did not answer.
That high-tier Shadow Legend seemed to feel a trace of urgency within.
Though it didn’t know what the Witch Race High Priest was doing, its instincts as a powerhouse told it to interrupt him immediately!
At this moment, the high-tier legend raised its sword, threatening, "Xiao, stop it right now, or I’ll immediately order an attack!"
Xiao’s lips curled into a smile.
Although, due to the pain, his smile appeared twisted.
"This is a forbidden technique I created myself and I’m not very skilled with it yet."
"If interrupted midway, it would be very troublesome."
"But fortunately, you guys are very cooperative..."

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - 309: Demon Furnace, Soul Refining!
paragraphs: A twisted smile appeared on High Priest Xiao’s face.
The Shadow Legend across from him was puzzled, seemingly unaware of the significance of the self-created forbidden technique Xiao mentioned.
However, this did not mean those Witch Race legends were unaware.
At this moment, a look of horror had already appeared in their eyes.
In the Witch Race, besides secret elixirs, they have a unique trait, which is the various forbidden techniques that are never shared with outsiders.
Each forbidden technique can provide powerful assistance to legendary powerhouses.
Earlier, Wu Ling’Er demonstrated the ’Forbidden Abyss’ and ’Thunder Purgatory’, showing just how terrifying the power of these forbidden techniques can be.
However, despite the powerful nature of forbidden techniques, their learning threshold is extremely high.
Even Wu Ling’Er has only mastered four Witch Clan forbidden techniques.
Moreover, creating a new forbidden technique is something only an unparalleled genius could achieve.
Throughout the millennia of Witch Race development, they have only ever created eight self-invented forbidden techniques, thanks to those extraordinary talents.
And the ultimate achievements of those geniuses all surpassed the limits of legends, reaching demigod status!
But now, High Priest Xiao claimed he has also created a forbidden technique!
This talent suggests that as long as he doesn’t fall, he definitely has a chance to reach the position of a demigod in the future!
At this moment.
The group of Shadow Legends seemed to finally realize something was amiss.
Because they felt that the aura around Xiao had accumulated to a frightening level.
It even vaguely reached another tier.
That is, demigod!
They knew they couldn’t let Xiao continue to increase his power.
The Shadow Demon Venerable holding a long blade immediately ordered.
"Interrupt him!"
The Shadow Legends, seeing this, charged toward Xiao one by one.
However, Xiao laughed.
Because his forbidden technique was already complete.
From his mouth came a clear incantation sound.
"Forbidden Technique—Soul-Burning Combat Technique!"
Buzz!
The entire Witch Race border, across billions of miles of the seventh battlefield, felt the oppressive sensation deep within their souls!
Demigod!
Though it was through the use of a forbidden technique, Xiao at this moment truly reached this tier.
In the next moment, Xiao shouted.
"Witch Race warriors, charge with me!"
"Today, slay the Shadow Legends and avenge the Saint Master!"
Upon hearing this, the eyes of the Witch Race powerhouses filled with hatred!
The death of the Saint Master still filled them with immense sorrow.
Now, being reminded by Xiao, a fire of vengeance ignited in their hearts.
And they all charged towards the much larger Shadow Legion!
Covered in red flames, Xiao took the lead!
Though not knowing what the Shadow Legion was brewing or waiting for.
But Xiao knew he must not let them continue!
His Secret Pattern Domain was instantly released, directly covering more than seventy Shadow Legends, including several high-tier legends!
He actually intended to take on half of the legendary-level powerhouses of the Shadow Legion by himself!
Seeing this scene, other Witch Race powerhouses’ eyes instantly turned red.
"Kill!"
The Legendary Battle thus erupted.
At the same time.
The entire Witch Race territory was already shrouded in black clouds.
War raged on every side.
More and more Sky Islands made the decision to abandon their current resource islands and head to the main city.
Then to the border, to meet with their legendary-level powerhouses.
Kathy closely followed the direction Han Xing had left.
This Sky Island, as large as an entire nation, moved rapidly in the sky.
Though it lacked Han Xing’s lord acceleration device.
Its forward speed still reached over forty thousand kilometers per hour.
But soon, they encountered obstruction from the Shadow Legion!
Kathy felt a sense of urgency.
Meanwhile, she also paid close attention to the movements of other Witch Race main cities.
At this moment, Kathy announced: "All Witch Race civilians, proceed to the underground shelters and wait until the war is over.
"Soldiers, prepare for the war!"
"I’ve already contacted the seventh main city; they are heading in our direction. Once we converge, we’ll gather our strength to break through!"
After hearing Kathy’s plan, a group of Witch Race officers expressed their agreement.
In the next moment, they were overwhelmed by the overwhelming Shadow Legion.
At this moment.
Han Xing’s Sky Island was still pushing forward with its attack.
Every Shadow Legion they encountered was fiercely blown open by the powerful firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Before those shadow creatures could react.
Ten Thousand Stars City accelerated and took advantage of the gap to rush through.
Thus, for Han Xing, the obstruction of the Shadow Legion was not effective.
Along the way, Han Xing also intervened to rescue those Sky Islands caught in the war.
In two hours, Han Xing had lost count of how many shadow creatures he blasted away.
Tens of millions, or hundreds of millions.
But none of that mattered anymore.
Because Ten Thousand Stars City had already advanced over a hundred thousand kilometers!
Half the distance to the Witch Race border still remained.
Han Xing couldn’t help but feel impatient.
And just at this time.
He suddenly heard a system notification.
"Your territory building: Demon Furnace has been successfully constructed."
With the acceleration from Miracle Tower, all of Han Xing’s construction times were greatly reduced.
Including this piece of Abyss Technology.
Han Xing took a moment to check the attributes of this building.
[Abyss Technology: Demon Furnace]
[Defense Value]: 500,000.
[Attack Power]: 0
[Current Stored Soul Quantity]: 0. (When the soul quantity reaches 100 million, the Demon Furnace can be activated to refine a Soul Crystal.)
[Current Soul Crystal Quantity]: 0.
"Note: The Demon Furnace is a special furnace belonging to some powerful entities in the Abyss; they may set their sights on your territory, waiting for an opportunity to seize it."

In the Witch Race, besides secret elixirs, they have a unique trait, which is the various forbidden techniques that are never shared with outsiders.
Each forbidden technique can provide powerful assistance to legendary powerhouses.
Earlier, Wu Ling’Er demonstrated the ’Forbidden Abyss’ and ’Thunder Purgatory’, showing just how terrifying the power of these forbidden techniques can be.
However, despite the powerful nature of forbidden techniques, their learning threshold is extremely high.
Even Wu Ling’Er has only mastered four Witch Clan forbidden techniques.
Moreover, creating a new forbidden technique is something only an unparalleled genius could achieve.
Throughout the millennia of Witch Race development, they have only ever created eight self-invented forbidden techniques, thanks to those extraordinary talents.
And the ultimate achievements of those geniuses all surpassed the limits of legends, reaching demigod status!
But now, High Priest Xiao claimed he has also created a forbidden technique!
This talent suggests that as long as he doesn’t fall, he definitely has a chance to reach the position of a demigod in the future!
At this moment.
The group of Shadow Legends seemed to finally realize something was amiss.
Because they felt that the aura around Xiao had accumulated to a frightening level.
It even vaguely reached another tier.
That is, demigod!
They knew they couldn’t let Xiao continue to increase his power.
The Shadow Demon Venerable holding a long blade immediately ordered.
"Interrupt him!"
The Shadow Legends, seeing this, charged toward Xiao one by one.
However, Xiao laughed.
Because his forbidden technique was already complete.
From his mouth came a clear incantation sound.
"Forbidden Technique—Soul-Burning Combat Technique!"
Buzz!
The entire Witch Race border, across billions of miles of the seventh battlefield, felt the oppressive sensation deep within their souls!
Demigod!
Though it was through the use of a forbidden technique, Xiao at this moment truly reached this tier.
In the next moment, Xiao shouted.
"Witch Race warriors, charge with me!"
"Today, slay the Shadow Legends and avenge the Saint Master!"
Upon hearing this, the eyes of the Witch Race powerhouses filled with hatred!
The death of the Saint Master still filled them with immense sorrow.
Now, being reminded by Xiao, a fire of vengeance ignited in their hearts.
And they all charged towards the much larger Shadow Legion!
Covered in red flames, Xiao took the lead!
Though not knowing what the Shadow Legion was brewing or waiting for.
But Xiao knew he must not let them continue!
His Secret Pattern Domain was instantly released, directly covering more than seventy Shadow Legends, including several high-tier legends!
He actually intended to take on half of the legendary-level powerhouses of the Shadow Legion by himself!
Seeing this scene, other Witch Race powerhouses’ eyes instantly turned red.
"Kill!"
The Legendary Battle thus erupted.
At the same time.
The entire Witch Race territory was already shrouded in black clouds.
War raged on every side.
More and more Sky Islands made the decision to abandon their current resource islands and head to the main city.
Then to the border, to meet with their legendary-level powerhouses.
Kathy closely followed the direction Han Xing had left.
This Sky Island, as large as an entire nation, moved rapidly in the sky.
Though it lacked Han Xing’s lord acceleration device.
Its forward speed still reached over forty thousand kilometers per hour.
But soon, they encountered obstruction from the Shadow Legion!
Kathy felt a sense of urgency.
Meanwhile, she also paid close attention to the movements of other Witch Race main cities.
At this moment, Kathy announced: "All Witch Race civilians, proceed to the underground shelters and wait until the war is over.
"Soldiers, prepare for the war!"
"I’ve already contacted the seventh main city; they are heading in our direction.
Once we converge, we’ll gather our strength to break through!"
After hearing Kathy’s plan, a group of Witch Race officers expressed their agreement.
In the next moment, they were overwhelmed by the overwhelming Shadow Legion.
At this moment.
Han Xing’s Sky Island was still pushing forward with its attack.
Every Shadow Legion they encountered was fiercely blown open by the powerful firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Before those shadow creatures could react.
Ten Thousand Stars City accelerated and took advantage of the gap to rush through.
Thus, for Han Xing, the obstruction of the Shadow Legion was not effective.
Along the way, Han Xing also intervened to rescue those Sky Islands caught in the war.
In two hours, Han Xing had lost count of how many shadow creatures he blasted away.
Tens of millions, or hundreds of millions.
But none of that mattered anymore.
Because Ten Thousand Stars City had already advanced over a hundred thousand kilometers!
Half the distance to the Witch Race border still remained.
Han Xing couldn’t help but feel impatient.
And just at this time.
He suddenly heard a system notification.
"Your territory building: Demon Furnace has been successfully constructed."
With the acceleration from Miracle Tower, all of Han Xing’s construction times were greatly reduced.
Including this piece of Abyss Technology.
Han Xing took a moment to check the attributes of this building.
[Abyss Technology: Demon Furnace]
[Defense Value]: 500,000.
[Attack Power]: 0
[Current Stored Soul Quantity]: 0. (When the soul quantity reaches 100 million, the Demon Furnace can be activated to refine a Soul Crystal.)
[Current Soul Crystal Quantity]: 0.
"Note: The Demon Furnace is a special furnace belonging to some powerful entities in the Abyss; they may set their sights on your territory, waiting for an opportunity to seize it."

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - 309: Demon Furnace, Soul Refining!
paragraphs: Han Xing pondered slightly, "A hundred million souls are needed to refine once, that number is truly terrifying."
"I just wonder what the effect of that soul crystal is."
Han Xing decided to experiment later on.
Anyway, for him, a hundred million monsters is a bit challenging.
But during wartime, it’s nothing too difficult.
As for——
The last note on the demon furnace, Han Xing ignored it.
Anyway, those demons are trapped in the Abyss Realm and can’t come out.
Targeting me? They’d have to have the skill to do so.
Apart from beings at the level of the Great Demon Monarch, even legendary level giant dragons no longer catch Han Xing’s eye.
Half an hour later...
Ten Thousand Stars City moved forward another ten thousand kilometers.
Along the way, he continuously controlled the buildings in his territory, bombarding the Shadow Legion.
Furthermore, Han Xing discovered.
Those shadow monsters slain by the defense tower would have a wisp of green ghost fire appear from their bodies.
These ghost fires vary in size, generated according to the strength of the defeated.
And they would automatically fly toward Ten Thousand Stars City.
Or, more precisely, they gathered towards the Demon Furnace.
At the center of the Lord’s Mansion, atop the hundreds-meter-tall demon furnace, there was a gigantic skull.
That skull had its mouth open, devouring one soul after another.
Each time a cluster of green ghost fire was collected by the demon furnace, the ’soul reserve quantity’ on the furnace interface kept increasing.
Moreover, Han Xing also found that the number of souls added by those ghost fires wasn’t fixed.
The larger ghost fires, once absorbed, added between 50 to 500 soul points.
While the ordinary ghost fires increased the soul count by only 10 to 50 points.
Among them, Han Xing also saw an enormous ghost fire rise from the body of a Dominator level being after he slew it, instantly absorbed by the demon furnace.
Then, the soul count suddenly skyrocketed by ten thousand points!
Watching the soul storage number soar on the furnace interface, Han Xing realized.
"I see, this demon furnace collects souls according to the monster’s strength, with varying amounts gathered."
"So it seems, there’s no need to kill a hundred million monsters to collect a billion souls."
"This saves quite a bit of trouble."
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
In just thirty minutes, the soul storage of the demon furnace had already reached 110 million.
The current soul count was enough for him to refine once.
Thus, Han Xing opened the furnace interface and attempted to click the refine button.
A system prompt appeared.
"Would you like to activate the demon furnace to refine a soul crystal? This refinement will consume 100 million souls."
"Yes."
Then, Han Xing saw it.
In the center of the territory, the over-four-hundred-meter-tall oval furnace built like a pile of bones suddenly spewed terrifying flames.
Whoosh—
The gigantic skull at the top of the furnace suddenly closed its mouth, flames erupting from its eye sockets and nostrils.
The refining of the demon furnace had begun!
It was as if countless souls were enduring horrific burning within the furnace, each one jumping up and down.
The entire demon furnace trembled continuously.
Meanwhile, Han Xing also heard the wails of those deceased souls at his ear.
Even at this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but shiver.
Admittedly, this refining method of the demon furnace was somewhat sinister.
If the refined soul crystal was not useful to him, Han Xing planned not to use it again.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Refinement successful, soul crystal +1..."
The flames emitted by the demon furnace gradually subsided.
Han Xing opened the interface and noticed some changes in the number of soul crystals.
"Current number of soul crystals: 1. Would you like to retrieve it?"
Han Xing clicked yes without hesitation.
Then, in his backpack, an item appeared that looked transparent yet substantial, like a jelly.
This object was the soul crystal.
It looked quite different from the sinister image he imagined.
On the contrary, it appeared very pure.
Han Xing checked the attributes of this thing.
[Soul Crystal]: Special item.
[Item Effect]: Each consumption can increase 1 point of divine power intensity, if consumed below legendary level, can increase 100 points in all attributes.
Seeing the item’s attributes, Han Xing’s eyes instantly lit up.
This thing turned out to be an item that could increase all attributes.
Even though it’s only one hundred points.
But it had no usage limits!
Meaning, as long as Han Xing collected enough souls, he could refine these soul crystals in batches.
Han Xing was instantly excited!
Damn, no wonder those demons love invading other worlds.
With such things, as long as there are enough living beings.
Gathering all their souls into the demon furnace for refinement.
They could almost increase infinitely!
Evil! Powerful!
Filled with temptation!
This thing truly is an abyss creation.
Han Xing immediately began slaughtering the path.
The souls of the Shadow Legion he killed were all collected by the demon furnace.
Then directly refined into soul crystals by Han Xing.
Just as previously stated, Han Xing had no qualms about killing these shadow monsters and Sky Island monsters.
Even refining their souls did not provoke any additional thoughts.
Two hours later.
Han Xing had slain over a hundred million shadow monsters.
And his backpack already had 4 more soul crystals.
Counting the ones he refined earlier, he now had 5!
If he could swallow these soul crystals, it could give Han Xing a 500-point attribute increase!
This effect is comparable to him slaying a high-tier legend.
However, the difficulty of killing a hundred million shadow fangs is far less than defeating one high-tier legend!
At this moment.
Han Xing glanced at the system map interface.
Now, he was over twenty thousand kilometers away from the border.
In no more than half an hour, Han Xing would reach Wu Ling’Er’s location.
He murmured in his heart.
"It’s close..."
"I hope Wu Ling’Er can hold on over there..."
The next moment, Han Xing swallowed all five soul crystals in his hand.
This thing looked like jelly on the outside and even tasted like jelly.
In an instant, Han Xing felt a comfortable sensation as if coming from the depths of his soul.
As if a body that had been dry for decades suddenly received nourishment.
Han Xing couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief.
An astonishing aura burst forth from his body!
At the same time, his four-dimensional attributes also soared at once.
At the Witch Race border.
Twenty-three legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race were facing off against over one hundred forty legendary powerhouses of the Shadow Legion!
A staggering power disparity of almost six to seven times made one almost despair.
If not for High Priest Xiao single-handedly dragging away half of the shadow legends.
The legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race would have been slain already!
However, even so, the Witch Race was just barely holding on.
The battle between the legendary powerhouses had already lasted two hours.
The rampant energy had shattered the space within a million miles around.
Purple lightning, black rain, blue blizzards...
All sorts of terrifying phenomena swept through their battle domain!
That area had become a land devoid of life.
Any living creature below legendary level stepping in would practically be annihilated instantly!
At this moment.
The shadow legends on the opposing side seemed to lose patience as well.
With such a power gap, they’ve been fighting for so long, yet still haven’t subdued their opponent.
Though the legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race were already injured.
Not a single one had died.
At this moment.
A high-tier legend battling Wu Ling’Er let out a cold snort, "Enough!"
"The time is almost up, there’s no need to delay anymore."
"Strike now, slay these legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race!"
Upon hearing the command, over seventy shadow legends unleashed terrifying auras.
Boom!
The over twenty legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race retreated instantly!
Even Wu Ling’Er was forced back several kilometers by the powerful aura.
Before she could react, she suddenly saw within the black mist in front of her.
A long crystal sword glimmering with light.
Slashing straight toward Wu Ling’Er’s face!

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - 310: Born as a Thread of Soul Between Heaven and Earth, Wandering Uncertain of Its Destination...
paragraphs: The crystal sword fiercely slashed towards Wu Ling’Er.
Hiss!
The terrifying sword qi rushed to her face.
She even saw the illusion of herself being split in half!
However.
From the moment she was born, the Witch Race was engulfed in war.
She grew up amidst war, having experienced countless battles, and was naturally no decoration.
Wu Ling’Er instantly recovered under the influence of the Shadow Demon Venerable.
Terrifying secret patterns gathered in her hand, being compressed, and then fiercely struck towards the Demon Venerable.
Buzz!
The power belonging to high-tier legends collided, causing that space to break apart directly.
This strike ended up evenly matched against the high-tier legend.
The sword-wielding Shadow Demon Venerable seemed extremely surprised.
However, Wu Ling’Er could withstand it.
It did not mean other Witch Race legends could withstand this burst!
When those Shadow Legends attacked in unison.
A few Witch Race High Priests had their Secret Pattern Domains broken on the spot.
The icy blade touched the flesh of these Witch Race legends.
Splatter! Splatter splatter!
At least five or six Witch Race Legendary Powerhouses were severely injured by this raid, coughing up blood and retreating.
However, these few severely injured powerhouses were still fortunate, at least they preserved their lives.
In the terrified eyes of the Witch Race powerhouses.
They saw an elderly Witch Race individual, whose Secret Pattern Domain was broken, leading to a significant reduction in defense.
Moreover, he at this moment became the target of a high-tier legend.
The high-tier legend wielded a crystal spear nearly three meters long, appearing behind the elder at the utmost speed.
"Careful!"
Everyone shouted warnings at the top of their lungs.
Yet it was already too late.
Thud!
As the sound of body penetration emerged.
The crystal spear pierced through the elder’s back, then through his chest.
"Ming Hai teacher!"
"Eighth High Priest!"
The Witch Race powerhouses looked at this scene in horror, their hearts overwhelmed with shock!
Especially Wu Ling’Er, whose eyes instantly turned extremely red.
This elder was Wu Ling’Er’s teacher.
And in the entire clan, he was a figure of considerable prestige.
"Thud!"
The Eighth High Priest, Ming Hai, suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, and then stared blankly at the spear before his chest.
After a moment, he helplessly glanced at his clansmen and then focused his gaze on Wu Ling’Er, appearing fondly in his eyes.
He slowly opened his mouth, his voice barely audible.
Yet Wu Ling’Er understood what he was saying.
He was saying, "Little Ling’Er... teacher is fine, don’t worry..."
At this moment, behind Ming Hai, came the hoarse voice of a high-tier demon.
"Fine, is it? Then it seems I was too gentle?"
As he spoke, the spear thrust forward another dozen centimeters abruptly.
The Eighth High Priest Ming Hai spat out another mouthful of blood, his breath becoming increasingly weak.
This scene almost caused Wu Ling’Er to lose her rationality instantly.
"Bastard! I will kill you!"
Her waterfall-like hair flew and surged to five or six meters!
An astonishing murderous intent erupted from her body!
Just as Wu Ling’Er was about to charge forward.
That high-tier legend of the Shadow Legion suddenly shifted the direction of his crystal spear, aiming it at Wu Ling’Er.
At this moment, this legend revealed a sneering smile and said hoarsely: "Do you want to come to save him?"
"Before you can make it, I can instantly split this old man’s body in half."
Wu Ling’Er stopped instantly, glaring at this high-tier legend filled with murderous intent.
"Release him!"
However, the high-tier legend sneered: "Release him? Why should I?"
Wu Ling’Er did not respond.
At this moment, he continued to sneer: "From your conversation, this old man seems very important to you.
"Since——you want to save him so badly."
"How about you come and take his place, and I’ll release him, how about it?"
Upon hearing this, besides the High Priest who was fighting against over seventy legendary powerhouses alone.
Other Witch Race legends’ faces changed.
They did not expect that even though the Shadow Legion was already in absolute advantage.
They would still use such despicable means to threaten Wu Ling’Er.
Moreover, they knew, out of the twenty or so legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race, aside from High Priest Xiao.
Wu Ling’Er was one of their very few high-end combat powers.
If Wu Ling’Er died, then today, the Witch Race would have no chance of recovering!
Seeing that Wu Ling’Er did not answer, the high-tier Demon Venerable continued to provoke: "What’s wrong? Isn’t he your teacher?"
"Doesn’t your teacher deserve your substitution for him in your heart?"
This was a clear and clumsy provocation.
However, it was very effective.
Especially, considering Wu Ling’Er is someone who values sentiment and loyalty.
Wu Ling’Er was caught in a massive dilemma now.
She knew agreeing to the Shadow Demon Venerable’s terms was a stupid decision.
But allowing her teacher to die in front of her, Wu Ling’Er could not bear.
At this moment.
Hai Ming, who was held aloft, the Eighth High Priest of the Witch Race.
Looked at Wu Ling’Er with a loving gaze and then shook his head self-deprecatingly.
After a moment, he sighed: "Alas... old now... becoming a burden to these youngsters."
"Little Ling’Er, you are very talented and work hard."
"In the future... you might achieve demi-godhood."
"But your heart is too soft... cough cough..."
Speaking here, Hai Ming seemed to cough up several mouthfuls of blood due to his severe injuries.
"Teacher..."
Wu Ling’Er shouted, choking on her sobs.
Hai Ming nodded and continued: "Little Ling’Er, you are personally taught by me and the most talented student I have ever taught in my life."

Moreover, they knew, out of the twenty or so legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race, aside from High Priest Xiao.
Wu Ling’Er was one of their very few high-end combat powers.
If Wu Ling’Er died, then today, the Witch Race would have no chance of recovering!
Seeing that Wu Ling’Er did not answer, the high-tier Demon Venerable continued to provoke: "What’s wrong?
Isn’t he your teacher?"
"Doesn’t your teacher deserve your substitution for him in your heart?"
This was a clear and clumsy provocation.
However, it was very effective.
Especially, considering Wu Ling’Er is someone who values sentiment and loyalty.
Wu Ling’Er was caught in a massive dilemma now.
She knew agreeing to the Shadow Demon Venerable’s terms was a stupid decision.
But allowing her teacher to die in front of her, Wu Ling’Er could not bear.
At this moment.
Hai Ming, who was held aloft, the Eighth High Priest of the Witch Race.
Looked at Wu Ling’Er with a loving gaze and then shook his head self-deprecatingly.
After a moment, he sighed: "Alas... old now... becoming a burden to these youngsters."
"Little Ling’Er, you are very talented and work hard."
"In the future... you might achieve demi-godhood."
"But your heart is too soft... cough cough..."
Speaking here, Hai Ming seemed to cough up several mouthfuls of blood due to his severe injuries.
"Teacher..."
Wu Ling’Er shouted, choking on her sobs.
Hai Ming nodded and continued: "Little Ling’Er, you are personally taught by me and the most talented student I have ever taught in my life."

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - 310: Born as a Thread of Soul Between Heaven and Earth, Wandering Uncertain of Its Destination... (Part 2)
paragraphs: "Now, just being able to hear you call me teacher one more time, I am already very satisfied."
"Even if my soul returns to the Heroic Spirit Hall after death, I can brag to those guys that I brought you out..."
As he spoke, more blood oozed from Hai Ming’s mouth.
The attack from the Shadow Demon Venerable was not merely physical damage, even Hai Ming’s soul was greatly wounded at this moment.
"Teacher, don’t say that, I won’t let you die!" Wu Ling’Er said excitedly.
The next moment, Hai Ming turned his head to glance at the High-tier Demon Venerable and then shook his head.
"Little Ling’Er, this old man is beyond saving. Don’t make meaningless sacrifices for my sake."
"Let me... give you one last lesson..."
Under the puzzled gazes of everyone.
The Witch Clan Secret Patterns on Hai Ming’s body suddenly erupted.
The Shadow Demon Venerable immediately sensed something was wrong and hurriedly scolded, "Old man, what are you doing?"
"If you act rashly again, I will kill you on the spot!"
In response to the Shadow Demon Venerable’s threat, Hai Ming gave a calm smile.
The next moment, all the Witch Clan Secret Patterns on his body transferred to Wu Ling’Er.
A look of indescribable shock appeared in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes.
"Teacher Hai Ming!"
This elder of the Witch Race shook his head.
"Little Ling’Er, do you still remember what I taught you?"
"Born with a wisp of soul between heaven and earth, drifting aimlessly..."
"Those who once danced with weapons, where does the soul go today."
"How high is the sky, how deep is the earth."
"Above and below is heaven, the middle is man, every man is equal and united, mutually maintained, this is—"
"Witch!"
With that, the Witch Clan Secret Patterns on Hai Ming’s body fully fused into Wu Ling’Er’s Secret Pattern Domain.
At this moment.
The momentum of Wu Ling’Er rose sharply!
Under the watchful eyes of everyone.
The elder who shouted what it meant to be Witch Race, the kind old man, lost his last breath.
At the same time, within the entire Witch Race territory, the hearts of hundreds of billions of Witch Race people once again felt that empty sensation.
As if someone important had passed away again.
Legendary Powerhouses carry the fate of a race.
Their death can even affect the fate of an entire race.
On this day, the Witch Race suffered an unprecedented blow.
At this moment, the Shadow Demon Venerable, who was using a spear to lift Hai Ming’s body, also felt that the other party was lifeless.
A look of disdain flashed in its eyes.
With a casual fling, it sent Hai Ming’s body flying.
Then it was devoured by the surrounding space turbulence.
"Teacher Hai Ming!!!" Wu Ling’Er cried out in anguish.
She suddenly stared at the Shadow Demon Venerable with a gaze full of murder, and said in a cold tone, "Today, I will kill you!"
The next moment.
Her already terrifying Witch Patterns Domain instantly enveloped the remaining seventy-plus Shadow Legends.
"Witch Clan Forbidden Technique—Thunder Purgatory!"
At this moment, the entire Sea of Secret Patterns boiled instantly!
Wu Ling’Er intended to directly confront so many Legendary Powerhouses like Xiao with her own strength!
However, she was not a High-tier Legend, nor did she know Xiao’s self-created Forbidden Technique.
If it continues like this, she will suffer terrifying backlash.
However, at this moment, she was completely consumed by anger, without regard to this!
Buzz!
Among the seventy-plus Shadow Legends, three High-tier Legends showed sneering smiles.
"Overestimating herself!
Together they opened the Shadow Realm to block Wu Ling’Er’s forbidden technique bombardment!
Other Witch Race Legends of course wouldn’t just stand there.
Seeing Wu Ling’Er show power, they too recklessly unleashed all kinds of attacks.
Rumble!
Various heaven and earth destroying energies collided.
At this moment.
The space in this area completely collapsed.
But even so, their attacks failed to cause effective damage to these legends.
The group of Shadow Legends showed victorious smiles.
However, before they could celebrate for long, they heard Wu Ling’Er’s terrifying voice again.
"Forbidden Technique—Thunder Purgatory!"
At this moment, the faces of the Shadow Legends changed one after another.
"Another forbidden technique! Is this woman desperate?"
"Ignore it, continue defending!"
Rumble!
Destructive Secret Pattern Thunder rampaged again.
However, under the desperate defense of this group of Shadow Legends, this wave of forbidden technique bombardment was blocked again!
At this moment, the Shadow Demon Venerable holding a spear shouted, "Go, kill this woman first!"
With that, a dozen Shadow Legends were just about to pounce on Wu Ling’Er.
But they were blown away, running helter-skelter by two more waves of forbidden technique bombardment.
Buzz!
In their panic, the Shadow Legends once again raised the Shadow Realm.
Rumble!
As the rampant thunder dissipated.
The Shadow Realm was blasted with several large gaps.
Of course, this wasn’t something Wu Ling’Er could achieve alone.
Other Witch Race Legends, taking advantage of Wu Ling’Er’s suppressing fire, also unleashed their strongest attacks one after another.
Among them, even a few Shadow Legends were severely injured on the spot, almost getting killed instantly by combined attacks.
At this moment, the expressions of those three High-tier Legends were also very grim.
After enduring four consecutive waves of Forbidden Technique bombings, coupled with Wu Ling’Er’s terrifying Attack Power.
Even they were finding it hard to withstand.
But fortunately, it finally ended.
The thunder had dissipated.
At this time, that Shadow Demon Venerable holding the war blade spoke in a hoarse voice, "I’ll go kill the Witch Race Saintess."
"The others..."
Before it could finish speaking.
At this moment, those Shadow Legends once again heard a sound that made their scalps tingle.
"Witch Clan Forbidden Technique—Thunder Purgatory!"
In a flash, the faces of these Legendary Powerhouses changed dramatically!
"Damn it! Is this woman crazy?"
"Doesn’t she know that continuously casting Forbidden Techniques will cause tremendous backlash on herself?"
Before they could react, they were already engulfed by the Sea of Thunder!
Beside them, another High-tier Legend struggled to open the Shadow Realm, saying with difficulty, "Hold on!"
"Let’s see how many more Forbidden Techniques she can cast, by then, we won’t need to make a move, she will die from the backlash herself!"
However, Wu Ling’Er didn’t say a word.
Her response was a series of terrifying Witch Clan Forbidden Techniques.
Among them, several Shadow Legends failed to withstand the rampant Energy Bombardment, and the Shadow Realm was breached.
Then, seized by the Witch Race Legends, they were blown up instantly!
The faces of the three Shadow Demon Venerables turned pale, their hearts filled with shock.
"She’s mad! This woman is completely mad!"
"We must eliminate her quickly, or if she continues to suppress us, she’ll really take us all down by herself!"
After six rounds, the Shadow Legion had already lost seven Legendary Powerhouses.
Although this number of deaths seemed insignificant compared to their total numbers,
But these were not just ordinary shadow monsters.
These were powerhouses with Legendary Level combat strength!
Losing even one was a significant loss to the Shadow Legion!
This outburst by Wu Ling’Er, in concert with other Witch Race powerhouses, directly annihilated seven Shadow Legends.
This also reignited the confidence in the hearts of those despairing Witch Race Legends.
Just when they thought that Wu Ling’Er could still continue her onslaught.
Suddenly they sensed.
The aura on Wu Ling’Er suddenly plummeted!
After seven consecutive waves of Forbidden Techniques, the powerful backlash made blood seep from the corner of her mouth.
However, just as Wu Ling’Er was about to recklessly continue the Forbidden Technique bombardment.
She found a High-tier Legend had somehow rushed to her front at lightning speed.
"Wu Ling’Er, this ends here!"
The voice came from the Shadow Demon Venerable holding the large blade!
Seeing the opponent approaching, Wu Ling’Er gathered her strength.
She was about to use the escape Forbidden Technique—Witch Soul Transfer.
However, she found that her previous explosion was too fierce.
The backlash state hadn’t yet dissipated.
The Forbidden Technique activation failed...
Opposite her, the Shadow Demon Venerable seemed to sense something off about Wu Ling’Er’s state.
"Oh? Finally reaching your limit?"
A victorious smile appeared on its face.
"Then, you shall die!"
Crack!
The Shadow Demon Venerable swung its sword down.
The heavens and earth seemed to be filled with the shadow of this blade!
At a critical moment.
Wu Ling’Er gritted her teeth, preparing for a life-or-death gamble with this High-tier Legend.
Suddenly a figure appeared in front of her.
It was a woman wearing a red priest’s robe, with a redwood hairpin on her head.
She stood in front of Wu Ling’Er.
Then, she forcibly took the brunt of the Shadow Demon Venerable’s strike!
Poof!
The blade cleaved from head straight to foot.
Wu Ling’Er witnessed it all, immediately shouting.
"Wumei!"
This Witch Race female Legend gave Wu Ling’Er a strained smile.
Then, with great effort, she opened her mouth slightly.
Wu Ling’Er heard what she was saying.
She said.
"Saintess, I believe in you..."
Poof!
Blood splattered.
The Eleventh Priest of the Witch Clan, Wumei, fell.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - 311: Battle of Life and Death, That Man...
paragraphs: The Eleventh Priest of the Witch Race, Wumei, has fallen.
In just a few hours, hundreds of billions of Witch Race civilians have felt this heart-wrenching sensation three times.
In wars of this scale, death is a common occurrence.
Not only are the legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race falling one after another.
Within the Witch Race’s territory, extensive casualties are also occurring in major cities.
Not all major cities have the ancient weapons left by Han Xing and his troops to help.
They cannot withstand the fierce onslaught of the Shadow Legion.
City after city is falling.
Tens of thousands of soldiers are dying.
A large number of Witch Race civilians are being slaughtered...
The remaining forces are all gathered in the major cities, making their last stand.
At this moment, Kathy, listening to the battle reports and calls for help from various places, showed an anxious expression.
"Everyone, you must hold on!"
"Hold on until you reach the border, hold on until the Saintess achieves victory on her side!"
However, what Kathy doesn’t know is that the situation at the border is even less optimistic than within the Witch Race’s territory.
Even legendary powerhouses are dying one after another.
Even if they rush over, it would only be to their deaths.
They must break the current deadlock.
Otherwise, the Witch Race would truly perish today.
Ten Thousand Stars City is moving at maximum speed, sprinting all the way.
Finally, they are just over ten thousand kilometers from the border.
From afar.
Han Xing and the others could see the overwhelming black clouds.
And the chaotic weather phenomenon caused by various energy collisions.
Han Xing’s gaze instantly locked onto that place.
He knew that was where Wu Ling’Er’s battlefield was.
Only battles between legendary powerhouses could cause such a spectacle.
The next moment!
Ten Thousand Stars City adjusted its direction, rushing toward the battlefield like a falling meteor...
At the same time.
Wu Ling’Er, with tears, accepted all the secret patterns from the Eleventh Priest of the Witch Race, before his death.
These secret patterns are manifestations of the Witch Race’s divine power.
They can also be said to be the energy of these Witch Race powerhouses.
After consecutively receiving the secret patterns of two legendary powerhouses, Wu Ling’Er, whose aura was already dwindling, surprisingly recovered once more.
She began to madly unleash various forbidden techniques again.
However, the Shadow Legion, having suffered losses once, would definitely not allow Wu Ling’Er to resort to the same trick again.
At this moment, the Shadow Demon Venerable holding a spear shouted, "Sword, Fist, go deal with the Witch Race Saintess."
The two names he called are the other two among the three high-tier legends.
Although they were a bit displeased with being ordered by this guy,
these two shadow legends still charged toward Wu Ling’Er.
Boom!
In just one encounter, Wu Ling’Er was blasted to fly backward!
Facing the offensive of two high-tier legends, even in her enraged state, Wu Ling’Er was no match at all.
Wu Ling’Er, after all, is only a middle-tier legend, with a huge gap from high-tier legends.
Under the absolute suppression of strength, going berserk is useless.
If you can’t win, you just can’t win.
Wu Ling’Er was beaten into retreat after retreat.
At this moment, the shadow legend with the spear gave another order.
"Other shadow legends, follow me to kill!"
With that, he led the charge.
Like a tiger entering a flock of sheep, he charged into the ranks of the Witch Race legends!
Witnessing this, the other shadow legends also charged over.
Now, it was a true life-and-death battle, with no concept of mercy!
Both sides were engaged in fierce, head-on combat!
A young-looking Witch Race powerhouse could be seen gripping the neck of a shadow legend tightly, seemingly wanting to suppress and kill the opponent with power.
At this moment.
A shadow demon venerable suddenly appeared, then pierced the heart of the Witch Race powerhouse with a spear.
Puff!
The sound of flesh being penetrated was heard.
The Witch Race legend’s eyes widened fiercely.
Yet, he still didn’t let go.
Mustering his last bit of strength, he punched out fiercely!
"Ha!"
With a shout.
The head of the shadow legend he had locked in, exploded on the spot!
Puff!
"You’re courting death!"
Seeing this insane act, the Shadow Demon Venerable wanted to deliver a fatal blow immediately.
But at that moment, the Witch Race powerhouse sneered, "You’re not worthy of killing me!"
"Saintess, please hold on!"
With a loud burst!
Just like the two Witch Race legends who died before him, he blew himself up before his death, passing all his witch patterns to Wu Ling’Er.
"Uncle Ye!"
Wu Ling’Er was overwhelmed by grief and rage!
After receiving the secret patterns of this Witch Race powerhouse, her aura skyrocketed once more!
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er withstood the attacks of the two high-tier legends and forcefully broke through the encirclement.
In a flash, she appeared in front of the group of shadow legends.
The next moment.
Her slender palm descended.
Pa!!
In an instant, a shadow legend was smacked to death on the spot, blood splattering everywhere.
Wu Ling’Er’s figure flashed again, appearing in front of another shadow legend.
As Wu Ling’Er’s palm struck down.
This shadow legend met the same fate as its companion.
Puff! Puff Puff Puff!
Wu Ling’Er had gone on a killing spree!
One shadow legend after another was smashed into pulp by her!
Such terrifying means exhibited her title of Storm Ripper to the fullest extent.
However, the attack from that group of shadow legends grew even more ferocious!
The death of their companions hadn’t made them retreat; instead, their war intent soared.
They rushed toward Wu Ling’Er with reckless abandon.
"Great Shadow God, please grant me divine power!"
"For the sake of the Monarch, kill!"
At this moment, the two high-tier legends also caught up, blocking Wu Ling’Er.

But at that moment, the Witch Race powerhouse sneered, "You’re not worthy of killing me!"
"Saintess, please hold on!"
With a loud burst!
Just like the two Witch Race legends who died before him, he blew himself up before his death, passing all his witch patterns to Wu Ling’Er.
"Uncle Ye!"
Wu Ling’Er was overwhelmed by grief and rage!
After receiving the secret patterns of this Witch Race powerhouse, her aura skyrocketed once more!
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er withstood the attacks of the two high-tier legends and forcefully broke through the encirclement.
In a flash, she appeared in front of the group of shadow legends.
The next moment.
Her slender palm descended.
Pa!!
In an instant, a shadow legend was smacked to death on the spot, blood splattering everywhere.
Wu Ling’Er’s figure flashed again, appearing in front of another shadow legend.
As Wu Ling’Er’s palm struck down.
This shadow legend met the same fate as its companion.
Puff!
Puff Puff Puff!
Wu Ling’Er had gone on a killing spree!
One shadow legend after another was smashed into pulp by her!
Such terrifying means exhibited her title of Storm Ripper to the fullest extent.
However, the attack from that group of shadow legends grew even more ferocious!
The death of their companions hadn’t made them retreat; instead, their war intent soared.
They rushed toward Wu Ling’Er with reckless abandon.
"Great Shadow God, please grant me divine power!"
"For the sake of the Monarch, kill!"
At this moment, the two high-tier legends also caught up, blocking Wu Ling’Er.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - 311: Battle of Life and Death, That Man... (Part 2)
paragraphs: The battle situation changes rapidly.
In a flash, three more strong members of the Witch Race had their domains shattered under the siege of those Shadow Legends.
Then their flesh bodies were blasted apart.
Just before death.
They unanimously imitated the previous strong warriors, passing their own Witch Patterns to Wu Ling’Er.
Wu Ling’Er accepted these final waves from her fellow warriors with tears in her eyes...
"Everyone..."
Just then, another strong member of the Witch Race was blasted apart.
This was already the seventh Witch Race Legend to die today.
Whether this battle ends in victory or defeat, the Witch Race has already suffered severe losses, unable to recover in the short term.
The death of seven Legends in exchange for the fall of twenty-eight Shadow Legends.
A one-to-four exchange ratio, it seems like a gain no matter how you look at it.
However, all the strong members of the Witch Race felt incomparable heartache.
Because those who died were friends and family they were familiar with.
And they might face the same situation next.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er was already fighting with utter madness.
Her long hair danced like spirit snakes, and the raging blue Secret Patterns boiled like an ocean.
Those ordinary Shadow Legends would suffer severe damage the moment they were enveloped by Wu Ling’Er’s Secret Pattern Domain.
However, these two High-tier Legends were also desperately suppressing Wu Ling’Er, preventing her from heading to the other battlefield.
Speaking of which, it was somewhat unexpected.
They, as dignified High-tier Legends, together could barely hold back Wu Ling’Er.
This woman was too terrifying.
Although one after another, Witch Race Legends passed all their Power to Wu Ling’Er.
But she was able to instantly absorb and transform these Divine Power into her own.
This kind of Talent, just thinking about it makes one’s scalp tingle!
Moreover, a High-tier Legend named "Sword" discovered that Wu Ling’Er’s aura was rapidly soaring.
In a short time, she was already about to break through the limit of Middle-tier Legend, reaching the same level as them!
Once Wu Ling’Er breaks through to High-tier Legend, even if they join forces, they will no longer be able to suppress her.
And just at this moment.
A sudden change occurred.
In the sky, that large expanse of Red Secret Pattern Domain.
Originally the battlefield of High Priest Xiao and over seventy Shadow Legends.
After casting that terrifying Forbidden Technique, Xiao gained Demigod level power.
Single-handedly, he took down over seventy Legendary Powerhouses of the Shadow Legion.
Among them were also five High-tier Legends.
It can be said that if it weren’t for Xiao, the formation of the Witch Race would have already collapsed.
Including those Legendary Powerhouses, they might have already been slaughtered to the last.
However, Xiao dragged over seventy Shadow Legends into battle for so long.
That large expanse of Red Secret Pattern Domain also showed signs of imminent collapse.
In the astonished gazes of those strong members of the Witch Race below.
The Secret Pattern Domain instantly collapsed.
Dozens of terrifying black silhouettes emerged.
At the same time, a figure clad in a black robe, covered in blood, flew out.
It was the High Priest of the Witch Race, Xiao.
This scene almost terrified these strong members of the Witch Race to the point of despair.
They all knew what this represented.
This represented that their High Priest had been defeated.
At this moment, a High-tier Legend holding a spear laughed and said, "Looks like your High Priest isn’t that capable, couldn’t even take out a single Legendary Powerhouse from our camp."
"At this rate, you’re bound to be defeated."
It mocked without holding back.
Including the other Shadow Legends, they too displayed vicious smiles of victory.
A group of Witch Race Legends immediately glared hatefully at this High-tier Legend.
To be honest, for Xiao to single-handedly hold off so many Powerhouses for such a long time, he had done very well.
But, just as the Shadow Demon Venerable stated.
The failure on Xiao’s side had already fated the battle’s outcome.
The Witch Race was bound to be defeated.
However, not allowing the opposing side to gloat for long.
In the air, those Shadow Legends who had fought against the High Priest suddenly felt something wrong with their bodies.
Among them, a High-tier Legend with four heads asked in a roar, "Xiao, what did you do to us?"
Xiao, who was retreating rapidly in mid-air, suddenly revealed a sinister smile.
He raised three fingers.
Then began to count down.
Three...
Two...
One...
As the countdown cleared to zero.
At least twenty Shadow Legends suddenly erupted with Red Secret Patterns.
They looked at their bodies in horror, covered with dense cracks, like a crystal container on the verge of collapse.
It was as if Xiao had planted time bombs within them.
"Damn it! What kind of trick is this?"
"My body is out of control!"
"Demon Venerable, help me!"
However, Xiao’s method could even affect the Demon Venerable, leaving this group of Shadow Legends with no hope of resisting!
Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang!
After a series of hair-raising sounds of flesh exploding.
These twenty-plus Shadow Legends exploded, their flesh bodies shattering into pieces.
Among them were also two Shadow Demon Venerables of terrifying aura.
This scene caused both sides’ Powerhouses to inhale sharply!
At this moment, Xiao’s lips twisted into a mixture of tragic yet slightly smug smile.
And this thoroughly enraged the remaining Shadow Demon Venerables.
Among the remaining six High-tier Legends, a creature with a massive head suddenly said in a raspy voice, "This guy is done for."
"Kill him!"
As soon as the words fell, a group of Powerhouses simultaneously lunged at Xiao.
Wu Ling’Er, of course, knew their intention, she gritted her teeth and said, "Rescue the High Priest!"

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - 311: Battle of Life and Death, That Man... (Part 3)
paragraphs: Wu Ling’Er transformed into a blue lightning, rushing rapidly in the direction of Xiao’s retreat.
Other strong members of the Witch Race also charged forward.
The strong individuals from both sides clashed together once more.
At the same time, those High-tier Legends noticed Wu Ling’Er charging alone and were instantly moved.
They knew that in the entire Witch Race, the strongest now were Xiao and Wu Ling’Er.
Now, Xiao was already half dead.
So, as long as they dealt with Wu Ling’Er, the Witch Race could be said to crumble on its own!
As the words fell, below, the Shadow Blade Master and Shadow Boxing King.
As well as in the sky, the other four High-tier Legends, all simultaneously focused on Wu Ling’Er.
"Slay the Witch Race Saintess!"
Someone shouted out.
All six High-tier Legends unceremoniously charged towards Wu Ling’Er!
This scene made all the Witch Race strong warriors’ faces dramatically change!
They didn’t expect the battle awareness of these Shadow Legends to be so frightening!
They instantly found the breakthrough point of the Witch Race.
If Wu Ling’Er died, then it would all be over.
Even Xiao, who was retreating rapidly, sensed that something was amiss.
He gathered his strength and said, "Trying to kill the Saintess of my clan? Have you asked me?"
In the sky, among the three High-tier Legends, a strange man with six arms was holding different weapons and shouted, "Don’t bother with Xiao, he’s already spent!"
"Everyone, come with me, let’s slay the Witch Race Saintess!"
The next moment, all six weapons in his hand blasted towards the High Priest Xiao.
Bang!
The color of heaven and earth changed, space shattered.
Xiao was forcibly cut off from the blocking route.
The remaining five High-tier Legends simultaneously surrounded Wu Ling’Er from different angles!
Faced with this certain death scenario, Wu Ling’Er’s eyes showed no fear, only a slight regret.
A man’s figure appeared in Wu Ling’Er’s mind.
"Brother Han Xing..."
"I’m sorry..."
She glanced at the surrounding Shadow Legends with icy eyes, intending to detonate the Witch Clan Secret Patterns all over her body.
To perish together with these Shadow Legends.
And at this moment.
Thousands of kilometers away.
A black light beam suddenly shot out.
That black light beam did not exert much pressure on the crowd.
Only enough to harm an ordinary legend.
However, the next moment.
More than a dozen, even dozens of black light beams converged together.
The overlay of dozens of black light pillars.
Already made Wu Ling’Er feel a strong threat.
Yet, this wasn’t the end!
The next moment.
Hundreds of black light pillars converged into a straight line.
At this moment, the attack power of this light pillar already made everyone including Wu Ling’Er feel a mortal crisis!
She had a premonition that even if she was in full state, resisting this wave of attack would result in severe injury if not death!
Including those few High-tier Legends, they felt the same way.
Buzz!
In an instant, hundreds of energy beams reached.
The target was surprisingly the two High-tier Legends above Wu Ling’Er’s head!
These Shadow Legends instantly identified the source of
"Defense tower? Who is it?"
"Has reinforcements from the Witch Race arrived?"
Despite the surprise.
But these two Shadow Legends had to abandon the encirclement of Wu Ling’Er.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er, facing the siege of the remaining three High-tier Legends, felt a significant reduction in pressure.
She launched a mass of Secret Pattern Ball.
The blue energy immediately burst forth, causing the sky to vibrate violently.
After a collision from both sides, Wu Ling’Er retreated hundreds of miles again.
Although she was slightly injured, fortunately, she survived the siege of five High-tier Legends.
Moreover, what’s even more surprising to Wu Ling’Er was.
Thousands of black energy balls suddenly appeared above those High-tier Legends’ heads.
Then, they exploded simultaneously!
Rumble!
These energy balls seemed to be attacks from some kind of defense tower as well.
They were not aimed at bodily destruction.
They were more about mental attacks.
Even though these High-tier Legends had terrifying Spiritual Power.
They also suffered from bouts of dizziness from the blasts.
They held their heads, angrily shouting, "Damn it, who is it?"
Even Wu Ling’Er beside them was puzzled and confused.
However, what responded to these Shadow Demon Venerables was more energy attacks.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
The sound of exploding made their scalps tingle.
For them, these attacks might just be like firecrackers exploding on an elephant’s head.
However, when the number of firecrackers is multiplied by thousands, even an elephant would feel their heads buzzing.
At this moment, the Shadow Legend with the spear suddenly had his gaze fixed.
He instantly discovered a massive Sky Island in the extreme distance.
From there, various attacks were continually launched harassing them.
"Cloud Beast, you go and take out the guys on that Sky Island, blow that Sky Island to smithereens for me!"
Among the remaining five High-tier Legends, a fierce beast resembling a Qilin but exuding black smoke quickly charged toward the area where the attacks were coming from.
And at this moment.
The Shadow Legend with the large sword, who was besieging Wu Ling’Er, suddenly felt the sound of the wind above his head.
The next moment, a sharp stabbing pain came from the area around his heart.
The figure of the Shadow Legend abruptly raised his head.
Suddenly, he saw an arrow, fast to the extreme, tearing through space, rapidly shooting towards him.
He wanted to slash and cut off this arrow.
However, even with his High-tier Legend reflexes, he was still one step too slow!
The Shadow Demon Venerable watched helplessly as the arrow pierced through his heart, carrying a string of blood beads.
At the same time, in his ear, a calm yet murderous male voice appeared.
"Just now, it was you, wasn’t it, who said you wanted to slay Ling’Er, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - 312: Burst—Slaying the Demon Venerable Again!
paragraphs: "Just now, was it you who said you wanted to kill Wu Ling’Er?"
Hearing this voice, everyone looked up, staring blankly at the figure in the sky.
The figure stood atop a magnificent throne, both hands still holding a bow and arrow.
This person was Han Xing.
Upon seeing Han Xing’s figure, Wu Ling’Er’s eyes instantly lit up with joy.
She almost instinctively exclaimed, "Brother Xing!"
At the same time.
Not just Wu Ling’Er.
All the legendary powerhouses engaged in battle also looked in confusion at the suddenly appearing human.
The legendary battlefield suddenly experienced a momentary halt.
The Witch Race legends looked bewildered.
"Where did this human strongman come from?"
The other Witch Race legends shook their heads, puzzled by Han Xing’s appearance.
At this moment, a young female legend seemed to recall something.
"I think I remember now, a group of human powerhouses recently arrived in the Witch Race territory, helping us resist the Shadow Legion as allies and making great contributions!"
"And the leader of this group of humans seems to be a friend of the Saintess!"
Hearing this, the other Witch Race legends were suddenly surprised.
"It’s actually the Saintess’s friend, coming to help at such a time, truly loyal and righteous!"
"But, have you noticed, this human’s aura seems a bit weak?"
Upon hearing this, everyone turned their gaze to Han Xing.
Even Xiao, in the process of accelerating his own healing, looked at him with a puzzled gaze.
Fourth Transformation?
At this time.
The group of Shadow Legends also seemed to notice Han Xing’s strength.
They snorted mockingly, one by one.
In the air, the Shadow Blade Master said, "I thought it was some peerless powerhouse, but it turns out to be just an ant below the Fifth Transformation!"
"Human race, with just this bit of strength, dare to get involved in battles among legends, do you have a death wish?"
Upon hearing the Shadow Legends mocking Han Xing, Wu Ling’Er immediately erupted in anger.
However, Han Xing waved his hand, signaling Wu Ling’Er to calm down.
At the same time, Han Xing saw the injuries on Wu Ling’Er’s body.
She had a sword wound several centimeters long on her back and right arm.
The wound seemed to be eroding, emitting hissing smoke.
Han Xing’s gaze instantly locked onto the Shadow Demon Venerable holding a large sword.
Murderous intent surfaced in his eyes.
Being a Shadow Demon Venerable, its perception of killing intent was naturally extremely sensitive.
Facing Han Xing’s gaze, it seemed to understand something and sneeringly said, "What, human boy."
"The wounds on the Witch Race Saintess, I cut them. Dissatisfied?"
"Just now, if you had arrived a moment later, the Witch Race Saintess’s beautiful head would already be separated from her body!"
Han Xing looked at it, murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
"You’ve already chosen your path to death."
"Today, I will kill you!"
The Shadow Blade Master seemed to hear the biggest joke of its life.
"Hahahahaha! What did I hear?"
"A human at the Fourth Transformation, saying he wants to kill me?"
It laughed wantonly, even the other Shadow Demon Venerables had the same smile on their faces.
No one would believe that this human could kill a Demon Venerable, something that has never happened in the history of the Holy Spirit Realm.
"Human, this little bit of strength, yet you learn from others to be a hero and save the damsel in distress, you..."
Before he could finish speaking.
He suddenly saw.
That human below the Fifth Transformation had already put on a golden mask.
His aura surged instantly by a large margin.
And it was still climbing.
As Han Xing activated the special effects of his equipment one by one.
Except for the special effects of his weapon and emblem, all other equipment effects were activated.
Additionally, with Shen Yun’s buff bonus.
And Han Xing pouring several bottles of Secret Elixir into his mouth.
At this moment, Han Xing’s aura directly surged to a level comparable to a middle-tier legend.
The Shadow Blade Master finally took him a little more seriously.
"Interesting, I didn’t expect this human to have some tricks."
The Shadow Blade Master chuckled, "But to deal with me, you’re still far off..."
Before he could finish his sentence.
Han Xing’s arrow had already been shot.
Moreover, it was faster and more terrifying in power than the previous arrow.
The Shadow Blade Master was about to block it.
The next moment, he saw a dense barrage of thousands of arrows coming at him.
Each of these arrows was endowed with the ’Gale·Break’ skill.
Having the destructive power to severely wound a common legend!
With the aid of Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Secret Technique and Han Xing’s cooldown reduction equipment effects.
Han Xing’s skill had entered a CD-free state.
Although it was only a brief few seconds, it was sufficient.
Thud! Thud thud thud!
As a symphony of flesh-piercing sounds echoed.
The Shadow Blade Master stood motionless.
It looked dazedly at its own body.
The indestructible crystal physique was now riddled with dense holes!
There wasn’t a single intact spot on its entire body.
Then, a series of shattering sounds emerged.
It was about to raise its long sword but found that its blade was also riddled with holes.
The consciousness of the Shadow Blade Master gradually faded.
In its final moments, it heard the voice of that man.
"This move is nice, just right to kill you."
"Let’s call it ’Heart-Piercing Arrow Barrage’ then."
Amidst the puzzled gazes of the Shadow Legends.
The Shadow Blade Master’s towering flesh body shattered into countless pieces in an instant!
Crack!
A torrent of violent black energy gushed out from where the Shadow Blade Master shattered.
