She almost instinctively exclaimed, "Brother Xing!"
At the same time.
Not just Wu Ling’Er.
All the legendary powerhouses engaged in battle also looked in confusion at the suddenly appearing human.
The legendary battlefield suddenly experienced a momentary halt.
The Witch Race legends looked bewildered.
"Where did this human strongman come from?"
The other Witch Race legends shook their heads, puzzled by Han Xing’s appearance.
At this moment, a young female legend seemed to recall something.
"I think I remember now, a group of human powerhouses recently arrived in the Witch Race territory, helping us resist the Shadow Legion as allies and making great contributions!"
"And the leader of this group of humans seems to be a friend of the Saintess!"
Hearing this, the other Witch Race legends were suddenly surprised.
"It’s actually the Saintess’s friend, coming to help at such a time, truly loyal and righteous!"
"But, have you noticed, this human’s aura seems a bit weak?"
Upon hearing this, everyone turned their gaze to Han Xing.
Even Xiao, in the process of accelerating his own healing, looked at him with a puzzled gaze.
Fourth Transformation?
At this time.
The group of Shadow Legends also seemed to notice Han Xing’s strength.
They snorted mockingly, one by one.
In the air, the Shadow Blade Master said, "I thought it was some peerless powerhouse, but it turns out to be just an ant below the Fifth Transformation!"
"Human race, with just this bit of strength, dare to get involved in battles among legends, do you have a death wish?"
Upon hearing the Shadow Legends mocking Han Xing, Wu Ling’Er immediately erupted in anger.
However, Han Xing waved his hand, signaling Wu Ling’Er to calm down.
At the same time, Han Xing saw the injuries on Wu Ling’Er’s body.
She had a sword wound several centimeters long on her back and right arm.
The wound seemed to be eroding, emitting hissing smoke.
Han Xing’s gaze instantly locked onto the Shadow Demon Venerable holding a large sword.
Murderous intent surfaced in his eyes.
Being a Shadow Demon Venerable, its perception of killing intent was naturally extremely sensitive.
Facing Han Xing’s gaze, it seemed to understand something and sneeringly said, "What, human boy."
"The wounds on the Witch Race Saintess, I cut them.
Dissatisfied?"
"Just now, if you had arrived a moment later, the Witch Race Saintess’s beautiful head would already be separated from her body!"
Han Xing looked at it, murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
"You’ve already chosen your path to death."
"Today, I will kill you!"
The Shadow Blade Master seemed to hear the biggest joke of its life.
"Hahahahaha!
What did I hear?"
"A human at the Fourth Transformation, saying he wants to kill me?"
It laughed wantonly, even the other Shadow Demon Venerables had the same smile on their faces.
No one would believe that this human could kill a Demon Venerable, something that has never happened in the history of the Holy Spirit Realm.
"Human, this little bit of strength, yet you learn from others to be a hero and save the damsel in distress, you..."
Before he could finish speaking.
He suddenly saw.
That human below the Fifth Transformation had already put on a golden mask.
His aura surged instantly by a large margin.
And it was still climbing.
As Han Xing activated the special effects of his equipment one by one.
Except for the special effects of his weapon and emblem, all other equipment effects were activated.
Additionally, with Shen Yun’s buff bonus.
And Han Xing pouring several bottles of Secret Elixir into his mouth.
At this moment, Han Xing’s aura directly surged to a level comparable to a middle-tier legend.
The Shadow Blade Master finally took him a little more seriously.
"Interesting, I didn’t expect this human to have some tricks."
The Shadow Blade Master chuckled, "But to deal with me, you’re still far off..."
Before he could finish his sentence.
Han Xing’s arrow had already been shot.
Moreover, it was faster and more terrifying in power than the previous arrow.
The Shadow Blade Master was about to block it.
The next moment, he saw a dense barrage of thousands of arrows coming at him.
Each of these arrows was endowed with the ’Gale·Break’ skill.
Having the destructive power to severely wound a common legend!
With the aid of Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Secret Technique and Han Xing’s cooldown reduction equipment effects.
Han Xing’s skill had entered a CD-free state.
Although it was only a brief few seconds, it was sufficient.
Thud!
Thud thud thud!
As a symphony of flesh-piercing sounds echoed.
The Shadow Blade Master stood motionless.
It looked dazedly at its own body.
The indestructible crystal physique was now riddled with dense holes!
There wasn’t a single intact spot on its entire body.
Then, a series of shattering sounds emerged.
It was about to raise its long sword but found that its blade was also riddled with holes.
The consciousness of the Shadow Blade Master gradually faded.
In its final moments, it heard the voice of that man.
"This move is nice, just right to kill you."
"Let’s call it ’Heart-Piercing Arrow Barrage’ then."
Amidst the puzzled gazes of the Shadow Legends.
The Shadow Blade Master’s towering flesh body shattered into countless pieces in an instant!
Crack!
A torrent of violent black energy gushed out from where the Shadow Blade Master shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - 312: Burst—Slaying the Demon Venerable Again!
paragraphs: Dark clouds densely covered the sky, lightning flashed and thunder roared.
This is the phenomenon when a high-tier legend dies.
The system notification appeared.
"Successfully slain Shadow Blade Master: High-tier Legend, received 2.532 billion experience value, automatically absorbed the divine power from the opponent’s body, all attributes +500."
"Due to your outstanding performance, you have received an additional reward, Shadow God’s Divine Fragment (polluted)."
Upon hearing the system notification, Han Xing laughed.
He didn’t expect this Shadow Blade Master to underestimate him so much.
Facing Han Xing’s attack, the opponent not only did not counterattack but stood arrogantly in place.
Furthermore, Han Xing didn’t even use the legendary skill Shattered Moon and the ultimate skill Sunfall.
He directly slew this high-tier legend.
However, the hundreds of legendary powerhouses present, including several high-tier legends, were stunned.
They blinked their eyes and could hardly believe what they saw.
The legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race said in bewilderment: "What happened just now?"
"The Shadow Blade Master was killed by this human?"
"Seems like it, really unbelievable..."
"I almost wonder if I haven’t woken up!"
Contrary to the reaction of the Witch Race legends.
At this moment, the six-arm Demon Venerable said in disbelief: "Impossible!"
"How could Blade be taken down by you, what method did you use!?"
Facing his questioning, Han Xing shrugged.
"I don’t know, maybe you Shadow Legends are just too useless."
The six-arm Demon Venerable was instantly enraged by Han Xing’s mockery.
"Damn, I will kill you!"
The next moment, it charged towards Han Xing.
Wu Ling’Er reacted immediately, rushing over at high speed to aid.
The Shadow Demon holding a spear blocked Wu Ling’Er’s path.
"Saintess, you’d better take care of yourself first."
"Damn it! Get out of my way!"
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er looked at Han Xing’s side, anxious.
Though the scene where Han Xing slew the Shadow Blade Master deeply shocked her.
But Wu Ling’Er had experienced it once and knew Han Xing had such means.
However, she also remembered that after Han Xing slew the Shadow Demon Venerable last time, he fell into a very severe weakened state.
So, Wu Ling’Er naturally assumed that Han Xing’s burst state had ended, and he was already exhausted.
At this time.
Han Xing suddenly drew another arrow.
However, the six-arm Demon Venerable seemed aware of Han Xing’s terror.
His attack power could actually cause damage to existences like them!
Thus, the six-arm Demon Venerable’s figure instantly vanished from its original position, seemingly trying to attack Han Xing from another location.
A high-tier legend’s movement speed far exceeds that of a fourth transformation existence.
It’s even indescribable.
However, Han Xing laughed: "Fool!
The next moment, the six-arm Demon Venerable suddenly saw a full moon appear behind him.
That full moon quickly formed into shape.
Then, he was fixed in mid-air.
Until Han Xing drew an arrow again, the six-arm Demon Venerable remained motionless in mid-air.
There wasn’t even the slightest sign of struggle conveyed.
At this point, the Shadow Legends finally reacted.
The six-arm Demon Venerable seemed to be trapped by this human in some way!
Recalling the terrifying attack power he displayed earlier.
The high-tier Demon Venerable holding the spear exclaimed in horror, "Damn it, save six-arm!"
Compared to their panic-stricken eyes, Wu Ling’Er’s eyes showed a glad expression.
Turns out Han Xing wasn’t weakened; he had other means!
The blue secret pattern on her erupted suddenly, directly intercepting the high-tier Demon Venerable.
"Wu Ling’Er, get out of the way!" The Shadow Demon Venerable roared angrily.
However, Wu Ling’Er countered with his words, "You better take care of yourself first."
The Shadow Demon Venerable was furious.
"You guys go save six-arm! I’ll take care of the Witch Race Saintess!"
Instantly, the remaining four high-tier legends all rushed towards the six-arm Demon Venerable.
However, in Han Xing’s ultimate state, as fast as they were, they were no match for the arrows in Han Xing’s hand.
When the terrifying arrow rain descended.
The six-arm Demon Venerable, like the Shadow Blade Master, watched the descending arrows in despair.
No, his situation was even worse than the Shadow Blade Master’s.
At least the opponent could struggle a bit.
But now, the six-arm Demon Venerable was already controlled by Shattered Moon, unable to struggle at all.
Whizz! Whiz whiz whiz!
One after another arrow passed over, and the six-arm Demon Venerable’s massive body, standing a hundred meters tall, also appeared with thousands of holes.
At this time, the five-second duration of the Shattered Moon skill had not ended yet.
System notification had already appeared.
"Successfully slain Six-armed Demon Venerable: High-tier Legend, received 2.772 billion experience value, automatically absorbed the divine power from the opponent’s body, all attributes +500."
"Due to your outstanding performance, you have received an additional reward, Shadow God’s Divine Fragment (polluted)."
When the full moon exploded, the hundred-meter-tall terrifying body of the six-arm Demon Venerable was instantly blasted to nothing.
At this moment, the whole scene was silent.
If Han Xing’s earlier slaying of the Shadow Blade Master was possibly due to luck and the opponent’s carelessness.
But now.
Han Xing had openly, with a dominant posture, slain the six-arm Demon Venerable.
Everyone seemed to have an unreal feeling.
They even wondered if they were dreaming.
This guy, clearly just had the power of a fourth transformation!
With their power, they could crush him with a mere finger!
But this ant-like figure had slain two high-tier legends!
What kind of monster is this?
What has become of this world?
The Witch Race legends murmured: "Fourth transformation power, slaying high-tier legends, and it’s two in a row...
"Has there ever been such a peerless demon in Holy Spirit Realm’s history?"
Everyone’s throat moved with difficulty, shaking their heads.
The answer was obvious; they didn’t know either.
Perhaps there had been such a peerless demon in history.
But with their experience and knowledge, they had never seen or heard of such a person.
The Witch Race High Priest Xiao, whose eyes were initially calm, suddenly emitted gleams of light.
"Witch God..."
Xiao murmured.
He seemed to recall that one’s demeanor when young.
One must know that that figure was the faith of the Witch Race, single-handedly establishing the vast Witch Race.
Now he had become a legend, the God of the Witch Race.
And Wu Ling’Er, who had already admired Han Xing immensely.
Looked at Han Xing with surprise and some relief.
If they weren’t in the midst of a battle, Wu Ling’Er might have rushed into Han Xing’s arms.
Yet at this moment, everyone suddenly felt.
The once terrifying aura of the young man standing on the throne rapidly diminished.
Dropped from middle-tier legend down to initial-tier legend.
Then directly back to tier four.
Han Xing’s ultimate state had ended.
In the bewildered gaze of the Witch Race legends, Han Xing took off the mask on his face and shouted.
"Why are you still standing there? Charge!"
This sentence made the Witch Race powerhouses react.
They rushed towards the Shadow Legion.
At this point, the Shadow Legion’s powerhouses also reacted.
The high-tier Demon Venerable with a spear shouted, "This kid is done, go slay him!"
As the words fell, a Shadow Legend with a three-meter-tall head, but only a one-meter-long body, with extremely disproportionate proportions, charged toward Han Xing.
Still one of the four remaining high-tier legends in the Shadow Legend camp.
Upon seeing the opponent charging and the overwhelming evil aura rushing towards him.
Han Xing’s eyes instantly turned cold.
"Slay me?"
"Fine, today I’ll slay another high-tier legend for you to see!"
As the words fell, he sharply drew the bowstring.
The high-tier Demon Venerable with the huge head instantly felt chills down his spine!
They had witnessed this human’s terrifying attack power firsthand.
Even the Six-armed Demon Venerable and Shadow Blade Master had died.
Against it, there was probably no chance to block it directly!
Thinking this, the Big Head Demon Venerable instantly retreated!
While retreating, it shouted, "Save me!"
Not knowing what method it used, the Big Head Demon Venerable’s speed in escaping far surpassed average powerhouses, with dense black smoke spurting!

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - 313: The Cunning Han Xing, the Scales of War Tip
paragraphs: "Help me!"
The Big Head Demon Venerable cried for help while fleeing at high speed!
Whoosh—
All along the way, there was black exhaust left behind by the Big Head Demon Venerable.
Hearing this Demon Venerable’s shout, the faces of the other three High-tier Demon Venerables changed dramatically.
They instinctively thought this human was about to burst out again.
They abandoned their own opponents immediately and rushed toward the Big Head Demon Venerable.
"Trying to leave?"
Wu Ling’Er and High Priest Xiao instantly realized their intention.
So they both unleashed their strongest attacks to intercept them.
Chichi...
Red and blue secret patterns burst out.
However, these few High-tier Demon Venerables were not interested in a prolonged fight.
Even at the cost of taking a hit, they just wanted to abandon the fight at hand to rescue the Big Head Demon Venerable.
Pfft!
With the help of Wu Ling’Er and Xiao’s attacks, although they suffered heavy blows, they also charged tens of kilometers in an instant.
However, just when they had racked their brains to reach the Big Head Demon Venerable’s side.
They saw that the human did not attack.
Instead, he immediately put away his longbow and fled rapidly toward the back.
This scene once again left the group of legendary powerhouses dumbfounded...
What happened?
Weren’t you going to burst out?
Weren’t you going to kill the High-tier Legends?
What the hell! How can you just run away like that?
Leaving the group of High-tier Demon Venerables looking at Han Xing’s back, bewildered in the wind...
Yet Han Xing’s face showed an expression of acting naturally.
Are you kidding me? My strongest state is over.
A burst that killed two High-tier Legends, that’s already pretty awesome, right?
Although, he still has a trump card in his hand.
But he didn’t want to use it.
At this moment, of course, it was time to make a strategic retreat.
The group of Shadow Demon Venerables then realized they had been tricked.
Feeling a burning sensation on their faces,
They, a group of powerhouses, were actually scared and toyed with by a human who had not even reached the Fourth Transformation.
"Argh! Cunning human, I will kill you!"
However, when this group of Shadow Demon Venerables just wanted to pursue Han Xing.
They found that the Witch Race Saintess and High Priest Xiao had already appeared before them.
Wu Ling’Er’s beautiful eyes, filled with extreme killer intent, were locked onto this High-tier Legend.
She and Xiao struck instantly.
The four Shadow Demon Venerables didn’t dare to underestimate their opponents and unleashed their strongest power to resist the duo’s attack.
At this time, the High Priest, after a period of rest, seemed to gradually regain his body’s vitality.
Although that forbidden technique took a severe toll on him.
However, the secret elixir of the Witch Race was equally miraculous, possessing quite powerful healing effects.
After a chaotic battle between both sides.
The battlefield gradually separated.
Xiao dragged the high-tier Legend that resembled a Qilin, and the Shadow Demon Venerable holding a spear, into the battle.
Wu Ling’Er was battling the Big Head Demon Venerable and the Shadow Boxing King.
High-end combat power once again reached a delicate balance.
And below.
This time, the Witch Race lost seven legendary powerhouses.
The Shadow Legion also lost nearly fifty legendary powerhouses.
Now, there were still over 80 Shadow Legends remaining.
The power disparity not only didn’t diminish but instead widened.
But at least, compared to before, a nearly certain death situation now had some turnaround.
All thanks to that human named Han Xing.
The human who suddenly appeared and forcibly killed two High-tier Legends.
This kind of event, no one could have expected beforehand.
Even if they believed in the occurrence of miracles, they wouldn’t believe a human came to save them.
But now, the facts were laid bare.
This group of Witch Race powerhouses felt a mixture of emotions in their hearts.
At this moment.
Han Xing had already returned to the Ten Thousand Stars City.
Seeing Han Xing’s return, Cheng Jianyong and others simultaneously smiled.
They were also close to the limit of the Fourth Transformation and had strong enough eyesight to see scenes hundreds of kilometers away.
Naturally, they had seen Han Xing kill those two High-tier Legends.
Now, the teammates were each extremely excited.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "Awesome, Brother Xing!"
"Killing two High-tier Legends in one go at the Fourth Transformation level, such an achievement, I think would scare the natives of this world to death if it gets out!"
"If I, Old Cheng, had that ability, I would definitely record it and boast for a lifetime!"
Cheng Jianyong’s words were exaggerated, but this event indeed could give one an enormous shock.
Han Xing at this moment asked, "Did you record it?"
Cheng Jianyong was stunned for a moment, then nodded.
"Great, send me a copy later."
The two revealed smiles of tacit understanding.
Shen Yun, standing by, also sighed, "Brother Xing now deals with legendary powerhouses so easily."
"When he truly steps into the Legendary Realm, it’s hard to imagine how strong he would become!"
Even Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang looked at him full of admiration.
Hearing Shen Yun’s remark about stepping into the Legendary Realm, Han Xing seemed to remember something.
He opened his quest log.
There, the legendary challenge task still showed an unfinished state for killing a level 51 Dominator creature.
Han Xing pondered, "As expected, because of the BUFF bonuses from teammates, and Wu Ling’Er and the others also inflicted some damage on those Shadow Legends."
"Thus, killing those two High-tier Legends doesn’t count as completing the challenge alone."
Han Xing felt a bit regretful.
His strongest state was over now.
To have the power to threaten high-tier legends again, he would need to wait at least one day.
If, at this moment, he could break through to the Legendary realm, his strength would undergo a terrifying qualitative change.

She and Xiao struck instantly.
The four Shadow Demon Venerables didn’t dare to underestimate their opponents and unleashed their strongest power to resist the duo’s attack.
At this time, the High Priest, after a period of rest, seemed to gradually regain his body’s vitality.
Although that forbidden technique took a severe toll on him.
However, the secret elixir of the Witch Race was equally miraculous, possessing quite powerful healing effects.
After a chaotic battle between both sides.
The battlefield gradually separated.
Xiao dragged the high-tier Legend that resembled a Qilin, and the Shadow Demon Venerable holding a spear, into the battle.
Wu Ling’Er was battling the Big Head Demon Venerable and the Shadow Boxing King.
High-end combat power once again reached a delicate balance.
And below.
This time, the Witch Race lost seven legendary powerhouses.
The Shadow Legion also lost nearly fifty legendary powerhouses.
Now, there were still over 80 Shadow Legends remaining.
The power disparity not only didn’t diminish but instead widened.
But at least, compared to before, a nearly certain death situation now had some turnaround.
All thanks to that human named Han Xing.
The human who suddenly appeared and forcibly killed two High-tier Legends.
This kind of event, no one could have expected beforehand.
Even if they believed in the occurrence of miracles, they wouldn’t believe a human came to save them.
But now, the facts were laid bare.
This group of Witch Race powerhouses felt a mixture of emotions in their hearts.
At this moment.
Han Xing had already returned to the Ten Thousand Stars City.
Seeing Han Xing’s return, Cheng Jianyong and others simultaneously smiled.
They were also close to the limit of the Fourth Transformation and had strong enough eyesight to see scenes hundreds of kilometers away.
Naturally, they had seen Han Xing kill those two High-tier Legends.
Now, the teammates were each extremely excited.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "Awesome, Brother Xing!"
"Killing two High-tier Legends in one go at the Fourth Transformation level, such an achievement, I think would scare the natives of this world to death if it gets out!"
"If I, Old Cheng, had that ability, I would definitely record it and boast for a lifetime!"
Cheng Jianyong’s words were exaggerated, but this event indeed could give one an enormous shock.
Han Xing at this moment asked, "Did you record it?"
Cheng Jianyong was stunned for a moment, then nodded.
"Great, send me a copy later."
The two revealed smiles of tacit understanding.
Shen Yun, standing by, also sighed, "Brother Xing now deals with legendary powerhouses so easily."
"When he truly steps into the Legendary Realm, it’s hard to imagine how strong he would become!"
Even Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang looked at him full of admiration.
Hearing Shen Yun’s remark about stepping into the Legendary Realm, Han Xing seemed to remember something.
He opened his quest log.
There, the legendary challenge task still showed an unfinished state for killing a level 51 Dominator creature.
Han Xing pondered, "As expected, because of the BUFF bonuses from teammates, and Wu Ling’Er and the others also inflicted some damage on those Shadow Legends."
"Thus, killing those two High-tier Legends doesn’t count as completing the challenge alone."
Han Xing felt a bit regretful.
His strongest state was over now.
To have the power to threaten high-tier legends again, he would need to wait at least one day.
If, at this moment, he could break through to the Legendary realm, his strength would undergo a terrifying qualitative change.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - 313: The Cunning Han Xing, War’s Balance Tipped
paragraphs: At that time, relying on him alone would be enough to secure victory for the Witch Race.
However, even though Han Xing had fallen from his strongest state,
it didn’t mean that he had lost the power to intimidate those Legendary Powerhouses.
With his own strength and that of his team members, along with the firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City now,
a general Legendary Powerhouse, if faced with the full force of a hundred Towers of Death Light,
would almost instantly fall.
Besides this, Han Xing also gained substantial benefits from this battle.
A High-tier Legend provided him with 500 points of four-dimensional attributes, equivalent to the total attributes from level 41 to 50.
His attributes improved once again.
Moreover, Han Xing noticed,
when he had just slain those two High-tier Legends, two massive Ghost Fires were absorbed by the Demon Furnace.
The soul value increased directly by two billion.
This means that besides their divine power being absorbed by Han Xing upon death,
their souls were also refined by the Demon Furnace, giving Han Xing an additional 100 points in four-dimensional attributes.
This was truly extracting divine power while alive, and making use of them as materials after death.
Making full use of things.
Thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t help but smile.
Then, while urging the Demon Furnace to begin refining, he maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City.
Rushing into the battlefield of the Witch Race.
Meanwhile,
within the Witch Race, over a thousand large and small Sky Islands were advancing towards the same place.
With nearly eighty percent of the Witch Race population on them.
As for the remaining twenty percent, their fate was already clear.
At least tens of billions of Witch Race people, having failed to evacuate in time, were buried in the invasion of the Shadow Legion.
And those Sky Islands that had escaped the battle, gathering a large Witch Race population, were all rushing towards the same coordinates.
The Witch Race truly lived up to being a great race.
The speed of these Sky Islands’ advance was extremely fast, maintaining a speed of thirty to fifty thousand kilometers per hour.
Even though they were constantly battling shadow monsters along the way,
they were gradually approaching the Witch Race Border.
At this moment, Kathy looked at the main city covered in black fog.
Countless shadow monsters continuously crawled out of the black fog.
If it were any other main city, it might already be struggling to cope, and even prepared to defend to the death.
However, Kathy’s third main city was different.
Above,
there were tens of millions of Human Race survivors brimming with war intent.
Faced with the tide of incoming monsters, rather than being scared, their eyes lit up with excitement.
At this moment, the survivor named Shu Jun was controlling a Demon Elephant War Chariot, bombarding the shadow monsters’ heads at will.
Occasionally activating the chariot’s charge ability to cut through the flesh of these monsters.
"Hahaha! Brothers, I’m having so much fun killing!"
"In just these few hours, I’ve already taken down hundreds of thousands of shadow monsters!"
"After this war ends, I won’t just be a squad leader; at least, I’ll get a position as a battalion leader, even a regiment leader!"
Other survivors, while slaughtering shadow monsters, showed envious looks in their eyes.
"Envious, aren’t you? Taking down ten thousand shadow monsters grants you a squad leader position in the military; taking down a hundred thousand earns you a battalion leader spot."
"I’d bet this group of Witch Race people never expected that we’d be such efficient killers from Blue Star."
"Hahaha, at this rate, we’ll all be at the squad leader level."
"I’m wondering if the Witch Race army has enough positions for us to fill."
They said this in the team channel, but the Witch Race people didn’t hear it.
Upon hearing it, other survivors laughed heartily.
"But we also have to thank the firepower assistance from the Witch Race."
"Compared to the Blood Tide period, when most of us only had a few catapults and had to fight the Blood Tide Monsters in close combat."
"Now, even though these shadow monsters are strong, the situation is so much better than before."
This statement, once again, received unanimous agreement.
In short, they’ve never fought such a well-equipped battle.
With so many high-tier defense towers at their backs, along with over a hundred ancient weapons and Witch Pattern battleships,
with such strong firepower support, what is there to worry about?
Just charge forward, and it’s done!
At this time, Shu Jun once again led the charge.
As the only survivor who received a reward from Han Xing, he controlled the Demon Elephant War Chariot, stealing the spotlight.
Moreover, Shu Jun wasn’t lying.
He had an extremely strong flying talent.
Controlling the Demon Elephant War Chariot felt the same as piloting those fighter planes, only more convenient to operate.
In the aerial combat state, it’s like a fish in water.
Logically speaking, a Demon Elephant War Chariot at most has the strength equivalent to a Fourth Transformation Lord.
But in his hands, the Demon Elephant War Chariot utilized two hundred percent of its potential.
The flexibility was such that the shadow monsters couldn’t even touch its edge.
The formation of the Shadow Legion was continuously torn open by him.
The threat he posed alone was comparable to a Fourth Transformation Lord.
At this moment.
Kathy looked at the group of excited survivors.
She couldn’t help but wonder in her heart, are all humans such a group of madmen?
But now is wartime, Kathy quickly pushed these thoughts aside.
Instead, she focused on the projection in front of her.
As a special technology of the Witch Race,
this projection device could monitor the war situation on the entire Sky Island.
Shadow monsters surged in from all directions.
However, with the help of these humans, the situation was barely manageable.
At this point, Kathy couldn’t help but worry about the battle conditions on other Witch Race Sky Islands.
Compared to the Third Main City, the defensive strength of other Sky Islands was much weaker.
Kathy took a deep breath and spoke on the Witch Race officer communication channel.
"The Third Main City is about to reach the Witch Race border, and we will stay here for a while to wait for the other main cities to converge."
"All Witch Race Sky Island troops nearby, please continue to hold on!"
After Kathy finished speaking, she closed the communication.
This was the last thing she could do.
As for how many in the Witch Race could survive this war, it would depend on their luck.
She gazed into the distance towards the border.
There were still more than sixty thousand kilometers to the border battlefield.
At most, in a little over an hour, they would be able to arrive.
By then, whether Wu Ling’Er’s side won or lost, Kathy was ready to face everything calmly.
And at that moment, Kathy suddenly felt the Communication Jade in her Space Backpack light up.
Looking at the space backpack at her waist, Kathy couldn’t help but sigh.
Unexpectedly, for legendary powerhouses, even incredibly precious spatial items,
one day, she could receive one as well.
Through previous trades, Han Xing had provided the Witch Race with a large amount of space backpacks.
Now, those at the rank of legion leader and above had each received a backpack.
And Kathy, as the commander of a main city, naturally was no exception.
At this time, Kathy retrieved the Communication Jade from the backpack.
The sender was her close friend, Rosanna.
As one of the few female powerhouses in the Witch Race, Rosanna was also the commander of the First Main City.
Moreover, it was said she had a subtle romantic connection with the High Priest.
But both of them were slow-paced.
Even though everyone knew their inner feelings,
neither of them had broken through this layer of tension.
At this moment, Kathy saw the message Rosanna had sent.
"Kathy, my dear sister, are you almost at the border? Are you unharmed?"
Hearing the concern in the other’s voice,
Kathy couldn’t help but show a slight smile at the corners of her mouth, and she quickly replied, "Nana, I’m absolutely fine."
"Let me tell you, I have over ten million humans brought by Lord Han Xing with me, and with them here, those monsters can’t even get close to the main city!"
The other side quickly replied, "Oh! That’s great, my dear sister."
"Lord Han Xing is truly our savior in the Witch Race, with his help, even the Shadow Legion’s invasion can be held off."
"Unlike my place, those monsters have already overtaken several cities, and are now besieging the First Main City on a large scale."
Upon hearing this, the smile on Kathy’s face disappeared and she frowned, asking, "Nana, how severe is the situation on your side?"
"If it’s really untenable, let me know, and I’ll order a retreat to support you."
Rosanna replied, "Kathy, I greatly appreciate your help."
"You know, this main city is Lord Xiao’s pride, I don’t want his main city to be lost in my hands."
Upon hearing this, Kathy smiled again.
Before she could speak, she suddenly heard Rosanna exclaim.
Kathy’s expression instantly tensed up, she hurried to ask, "Nana, what happened on your side?"
Rosanna didn’t answer for a long time.
After a few seconds, Rosanna managed to utter in a difficult tone,
"Run... quickly..."
Then, the communication was abruptly cut off.

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 314: Blood Sacrifice and Han Xing’s Smile
paragraphs: "Run... quickly..."
This was the last message sent by Rosanna.
Kathy’s face changed drastically!
In this situation, there are only two possibilities.
Either Rosanna hung up the call voluntarily.
Or, her Communication Jade was destroyed.
But no matter which scenario, it represents that something unexpected happened on her side!
At the same time.
A huge Witch Race Sky Island was advancing in the sky, facing the black cloud formed by the Shadow Legion gathering.
And this is one of the seventeen main islands of the Witch Race.
The first main city Sky Island of the Witch Race.
On the Sky Island.
There are hundreds of millions of elite Witch Race soldiers and those defense towers bravely resisting the Shadow Army surging in like a tide from all directions.
In the sky, the muzzles of ancient war chariots and Witch Pattern battleships roared.
One by one, huge shells with smoke trails drew arcs in the air, then landed straight into the group of monsters.
"Boom!"
After the earth-shattering explosion, tens of thousands of shadow monsters died.
Although the soldiers’ battle was tough, with combined forces, they could barely hold on.
At this moment.
Main City Center Command Center.
A Witch Race woman, appearing to be in her twenties or thirties, with a plump figure and wearing a commander’s uniform, stood in front of the projection screen.
She was smiling with relief, seemingly talking to someone.
This person is the head commander of the first main city, Rosanna.
The person she was talking to was naturally Kathy.
Being able to chat with a good friend for a few moments during such tense times is something comforting.
At this moment.
Rosanna just wanted to reply to her good friend Kathy’s message.
Suddenly feeling a pang of unease in her heart,
before she could react, she saw a shocking scene from the command room’s projection screen.
Something unknown happened.
The entire Sky Island, the shadow monsters, and Witch Race soldiers on it were all frozen as if trapped in an Immovable Spell.
Those shadow monsters were suspended in mid-air, looking ferociously at their enemies.
A Witch Race soldier, having just thrust his weapon into a shadow monster’s eye socket, couldn’t advance further.
Including the hundreds of millions of shadow monsters and Witch Race soldiers.
As well as those defense towers.
All of this was completely still!
It was as if an extremely terrifying power had directly enveloped the entire Sky Island.
Rosanna instantly realized something was wrong.
She just wanted to send a message to Kathy when suddenly her body stiffened.
Then, the Communication Jade in her hand exploded.
The next moment.
She was frozen in place, just like the external Witch Race soldiers and shadow monsters.
Several seconds later.
Rosanna’s eyes moved.
She realized that although she was frozen, her consciousness could still function.
Through the command room’s projection interface, she saw two figures slowly descending from the sky.
They appeared to be a man and a woman.
The man was holding a pitch-black Great Sword.
The woman beside him wore a hood, with a seductive figure.
Before this, the whole Witch Race knew of the Shadow Monarch’s existence.
But except for a few, not many had seen its appearance.
However, although Rosanna didn’t know the identity of these two.
She knew they were definitely not ordinary people.
It was even highly possible that the time-stop phenomenon trapping the Sky Island was caused by them.
Such terrifying power to seal the entire Sky Island in an instant, even on the High Priest, she hadn’t seen before.
Under Rosanna’s terrified gaze.
She saw these two heading straight for the core area of the Witch Race Main City.
And finding an underground passage more familiar than she was.
Then, this man and woman went straight in.
At this moment, Rosanna seemed to have a bad premonition.
At this moment.
The Shadow Monarch and the mysterious woman strolled leisurely in the underground passage of the Witch Race’s first main city.
They effortlessly broke through layers of seals and gates.
A few seconds later, they finally reached the end of the passage.
At this moment, in front of them, appeared a one-meter high, square black altar.
The mysterious woman slowly raised her head.
Under the hood, a face exuding immense charm appeared.
"Finally, found it~"
The woman’s crimson lips slowly curled into a smile, seeming pleased to find this altar.
The Shadow Monarch’s hoarse voice came from behind: "Is this the Ancestral God Altar?"
"Yes~" the mysterious woman softly replied.
"We’ve planned for so many years for this altar, now we’ve finally completed the first step of the plan."
She extended her blood-red tongue, gently licking her lips, then took a deep breath.
"I sensed it, there’s an aura from that guy above; it’s indeed the Ancestral God Altar of the Witch Race~"
The Shadow Monarch nodded, continuing in a lukewarm tone.
"Since we’ve got what we came for, let’s move on to the next step."
However, the mysterious woman did not act immediately.
She looked at the Shadow Monarch and suddenly chuckled softly.
"Did you forget what I wanted this Ancestral God Altar for?"
"The number for the blood sacrifice isn’t enough yet~"
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch glanced at the altar.
It was already wrapped in a lot of red blood energy.
Since the fall of the Witch Race Saint Master, in less than half a day, hundreds of billions of Witch Race civilians had died.
Accounting for the battle loss in the past two to three months.
The Witch Race’s population had plummeted significantly.
This Ancestral God Altar, carrying the Witch Race’s fate, was now also enshrouded by the blood energy.
The Shadow Monarch thought for a moment and shook his head.

"We’ve planned for so many years for this altar, now we’ve finally completed the first step of the plan."
She extended her blood-red tongue, gently licking her lips, then took a deep breath.
"I sensed it, there’s an aura from that guy above; it’s indeed the Ancestral God Altar of the Witch Race~"
The Shadow Monarch nodded, continuing in a lukewarm tone.
"Since we’ve got what we came for, let’s move on to the next step."
However, the mysterious woman did not act immediately.
She looked at the Shadow Monarch and suddenly chuckled softly.
"Did you forget what I wanted this Ancestral God Altar for?"
"The number for the blood sacrifice isn’t enough yet~"
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch glanced at the altar.
It was already wrapped in a lot of red blood energy.
Since the fall of the Witch Race Saint Master, in less than half a day, hundreds of billions of Witch Race civilians had died.
Accounting for the battle loss in the past two to three months.
The Witch Race’s population had plummeted significantly.
This Ancestral God Altar, carrying the Witch Race’s fate, was now also enshrouded by the blood energy.
The Shadow Monarch thought for a moment and shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 314: Blood Sacrifice and Han Xing’s Smile
paragraphs: "I only promised to help you deal with Helas, but didn’t say I’d strike against these ants."
However, the mysterious woman didn’t care.
"Really?"
"Shadow, you’re not getting soft-hearted, are you?"
The mysterious woman chuckled lightly, "Do you think your hands aren’t already stained with enough blood?"
"Shadow, don’t forget your current identity~"
The Shadow Monarch looked at her deeply.
Then slowly extended a hand, thin as a corpse’s.
Gently clenched.
With the sound of an invisible crack.
The entire first main city of the Witch Race.
Hundreds of billions of civilians, plus hundreds of millions of elite Witch Race soldiers, all exploded into blossoms of blood.
"Puff-puff-puff!"
The endless sound of bodies bursting appeared.
Playing a requiem of death’s dirge.
The entire Witch Race Sky Island was instantly covered by a blanket of blood aura.
That was the blood mist formed by the bodies of billions of Witch Race people bursting open.
Covering the sky and sun, within it, as if countless beings were crying out unwillingly.
Including those high-ranking officers, without exception, their bodies uncontrollably exploded.
Rosanna, at the last moment, realized she was about to die.
Two hot tears fell from her eyes.
Puff!
A blood flower burst open.
The first main city of the Witch Race, declared wiped out.
After doing all this, the chest of the Shadow Monarch rose and fell slightly.
This is the demigod-level power.
A blow to anything below Legendary Level is simply a disaster.
At this moment.
The mysterious woman looked at the altar before her, the blood aura intensified again.
A delighted smile appeared in her eyes once more.
The Shadow Monarch exhaled and then shook his head.
"Let’s go."
At this moment, on the border battlefield.
High Priest Xiao suddenly felt a sense of unease.
At his level of existence, he could already sense when something bad was happening.
But now, there were still two powerful Shadow Demon Venerables, fighting against him.
Xiao had no choice but to focus all his spirit on the battle before him.
Below.
In the battlefield of the low, middle-tier legends.
Initially, the Witch Race legends were being suppressed one-sidedly.
But with Ten Thousand Stars City joining the battle, the situation fell into a delicate balance once again.
Those Shadow Legends angrily found that this Sky Island wouldn’t fight you head-on.
Instead, it would occasionally launch an energy attack, gathering hundreds of beams of destruction black light, and take a shot at you unexpectedly.
And the angles chosen were exceptionally tricky.
Always seizing the moment when these Shadow Legends were embroiled in intense fighting, it would suddenly fire a shot.
Forcing this group of Shadow Legends to abandon their opponents and choose to evade.
There were even several times when several Witch Race Legendary Powerhouses were besieged and almost in a death-ensured situation.
Overhead, suddenly appeared thousands of black energy balls, exploding with a boom.
Like a large string of firecrackers exploding overhead, causing these Shadow Legends, including those Witch Race legends, all to feel their heads buzzing.
The Witch Race was not Han Xing’s ally.
His Spiritual Shock Tower could also harm this group of Witch Race.
Several times have already greatly irritated those Shadow Legends.
At this moment.
Watching Han Xing continually operate the Defense Towers on Ten Thousand Stars City from above, performing pinpoint explosions, the crowd also wore a smile as expected.
Previously, hearing Han Xing say he was going to participate in the Legendary Battlefield, everyone felt a bit under pressure.
After all, it wasn’t just one or two Legends, but dozens!
The firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City was strong indeed, but if it were to be affected by the attacks of these legends, the losses would be severe.
But fortunately, Han Xing was very rational.
Han Xing certainly wouldn’t rush foolishly.
He was clearly aware of his own power level.
With the current firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, it could handle three to four Legendary Level powerhouses, already at the limit.
Even adding five more, they could only deal with six Legendary Powerhouses at most.
This was already an extremely terrifying force.
Before, it could even reverse the victory of a battle.
But compared to the number of powerhouses in this battlefield, it was far from enough.
Thus, Han Xing decided to control Ten Thousand Stars City to perform remote harassment from several hundred kilometers away.
After all, the only thing capable of damaging these Legendary Level powerhouses was the Tower of Death Light.
As for the Spiritual Shock Tower, with enough accumulation, it could also have some impact on those Legendary Level powerhouses.
The other low-level defense towers either lacked range or insufficient damage.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but murmur to himself.
"It would be great to have the enhancement effect of the Sun Crown Stele now!"
"An all-around boost; the firepower of my Ten Thousand Stars City will instantly undergo a qualitative change, and upgrading the Sun Crown Stele to full level can even multiply the firepower!"
"By then, dealing with these ordinary legends, I might even sweep them away directly!"
He glanced at the construction time of the Sun Crown Stele, with twenty-seven minutes remaining.
Before then, he could only harass those Shadow Legends from afar, ensuring his safety.
However, those Shadow Legends seemed to have noticed Han Xing’s current state.
Earlier, he suddenly burst forth, slashing down two high-tier Demon Venerables, frightening everyone.
Causing those Shadow Legends to hesitate to attack Han Xing as he uses Ten Thousand Stars City’s attacks from the side.
But now, through observing during this period.
They found this human truly falling into decline.
Thinking about it, it’s logical.
After all, with Fourth Transformation strength, killing high-tier Demon Venerables.
And in succession, slaying two of them.
It’s simply too shocking to express.
If he could maintain this battle power all the time, what are they living for?
For a moment, those Shadow Legends quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
Just then.
A strand of Light of Death suddenly came from Han Xing.
Several Shadow Legends sidestepped to dodge.
A black monster like a Violent Bear, standing a hundred meters tall, seemed slow to evade due to its sluggish movement.
Its shoulder was grazed by the black beam.
With a sizzling sound.
The right arm and half of its body of the Shadow Bear evaporated into the air.
"Awooo!" The Shadow Bear let out a painful howl.
After all, it was compounded by hundreds of attacks from the Tower of Death Light.
Even a creature like the Shadow Bear, renowned for its defense, could not withstand it.
If it were to directly withstand this wave of attack, it might fall on the spot.
For Legendary Powerhouses, facing these defense towers’ advantage, it’s their terrifying movement speed.
At this moment.
Several Shadow Legends exchanged glances.
Then.
A few immensely powerful existences retracted their black aura, silently withdrawing from the battle group.
The Shadow Legends retreating from the battle suddenly burst into speed, vanishing from their original location.
However.
Though the Shadow Legends were quick to act.
Han Xing, observing the entire battlefield on the Sky Island, was the first to notice the disappearing legends.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun exchanged an unnoticeable look.
A moment later.
Han Xing pretended not to see anything.
Continuing to launch attacks at those Shadow Legends fighting the Witch Race.
However, he held some reserves.
On Ten Thousand Stars City, half of the Towers of Death Light remained unused.
Seconds later, Han Xing felt a vague sense of foreboding creeping into his mind.
Yet he still held his position.
Just then.
The five people simultaneously saw the surrounding space suddenly ripple.
In all directions, appeared terrifying presences.
They seemed aware of the weakness of Han Xing’s defense towers.
That is, must concentrate all forces on a single attack to inflict deadly damage on Legendary Powerhouses.
So, they chose to attack from different directions.
At the same time, the Shadow Legends also spotted the five people on the territory.
Particularly, the man holding the longbow.
It was him who slew two Demon Venerables, dragging what should have been a decisive victory until now.
Moreover, they also sensed the weakening aura of Han Xing at this moment.
"This boy really seems to be done!"
"Let’s go!"
Upon saying, the four Shadow Legends charged towards Han Xing with cruel smiles.
And just when they were less than ten kilometers away from Han Xing.
They suddenly saw, among the five humans.
The faces of three men simultaneously displayed mysterious smiles.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly shouted, "Shen Yun, throw the sun."
From behind, Shen Yun’s voice answered.
"Alright, Brother Xing!"
With that, a sacred radiance instantly shone forth.
At the same time, Shen Yun’s two blessings were instantly applied.
In the shocked eyes of these Shadow Legends, they suddenly felt the aura of these humans surge!
Especially the man holding the longbow.
As the throne emerged under his feet.
He actually regained the aura of Legendary Level again!

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - 315: Divine Format Emerges, Holy Artifact Successfully Forged!
paragraphs: At this moment, these four Shadow Legends seemed to feel as if they had fallen into a trap.
The moment they thought about that man’s terrifying burst of power, they instinctively wanted to flee.
"Something’s fishy, retreat now!"
With those words, each Shadow Legend once again harnessed their speed and vanished.
Yet at that moment, they simultaneously heard the man’s voice, tinged with a hint of murderous intent and mockery.
"Since you’re already here..."
"Why the hurry to leave?"
With those words, countless green vines grew out of the void, tightly encasing the Shadow Legends.
They began to struggle furiously, destroying vine after vine.
However, the speed at which they demolished them was nowhere near the speed at which the green vines regrew.
This skill was precisely Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Secret Technique, Withered Life Vine.
While this Secret Technique couldn’t trap that Legendary Giant Dragon,
it surely could constrain these weaker Shadow Legends compared to general Legends.
Seeing the Shadow Legends’ mobility greatly reduced, a satisfied smile appeared on Han Xing’s face.
No need for Han Xing to say more.
Cheng Jianyong and the others unleashed their strongest attacks.
Storm Chaos Dance!
Meteor Technique!
Elf’s Eye!
And Han Xing’s Gale·Break!
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The four’s attack rhythm was exceptionally fast.
With various state enhancements, their attacking speed and skill cooldowns were significantly reduced.
The first wave of attacks hadn’t ended before the second wave rapidly commenced.
Anyway, Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Secret Technique provided four to five seconds of control, enough for dozens of rounds of output among them.
After one encounter,
these four Legends already bore various severe injuries!
They looked at their bodies in horror, aware they had once again been outsmarted by this human.
Thinking about the fate that awaited them, they desperately shouted.
"Demon Venerable! Save us!"
Yet, their cries for help were doomed to be futile.
Even the Shadow Demon Venerable couldn’t instantly teleport hundreds of kilometers.
Perhaps only a Demigod-level powerhouse could achieve that.
Thud thud thud!
Han Xing and the others’ attacks were swift and fierce.
Amongst the gazes of those Shadow Legends,
these Legendary Powerhouses were blown to bits on the spot!
Those Shadow Legends were beside themselves with rage.
"Damned bastard, he was waiting for us deliberately!"
"Cunning humans! We won’t fall for his tricks again!"
Those Shadow Legends were truly infuriated by Han Xing.
From his appearance till now,
a total of six Legendary Powerhouses had died directly at his hands.
Among them, there were even two high-tier Legends!
The losses were indeed heavy.
Yet, facing the wrath of these Shadow Legends,
Han Xing wanted to retort,
I never said I couldn’t do it, dammit.
You’re the ones who misjudged and guessed wrong!
At the same time,
A system prompt echoed in Han Xing’s ear.
"Successfully killed Initial-stage Legend: Shadow Wind Tiger, gaining 317 million experience points, automatically absorbed divine power from the target, all attributes +100."
Not only did Han Xing hear the system prompt.
Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, and Su Xiaoyang all received system prompts as well.
At the moment Cheng Jianyong heard the system prompt, he exclaimed in shock: "Whoa! I killed a Legend, Shadow Thunder Leopard!"
"I actually took down a Legendary Creature, I’m so damn awesome!"
Watching his exaggerated manner, Shen Yun couldn’t help but roll his eyes, "It was just a severely injured Legend, what’s there to be so excited about?"
However, the next thing Cheng Jianyong said truly moved him.
"What do you know?"
"The system just notified me that when I killed this Legend, I absorbed the divine power from its body, giving me a whopping increase of 80 points in four-dimensional attributes!"
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also replied softly, "We also added 100 points in all attributes."
Shen Yun exclaimed in surprise: "What?
"Damn, does killing a Legend offer such benefits?"
Cheng Jianyong instantly boasted: "Haha, didn’t expect that, did you?"
As a support profession, Shen Yun rarely engaged in direct combat now.
He wasn’t aware that killing a Legend also allowed absorption of divine power from the target, improving four-dimensional attributes.
At that moment, he felt quite envious.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly signaled with his eyes.
Everyone instantly tensed up.
The long-standing tacit understanding told them what Han Xing’s glance meant.
Then, as everyone was caught off guard, they suddenly attacked the sky.
There seemed to be nothing there.
But as their attacks landed, an earth-shattering explosion occurred!
The next moment,
a creature covered in black scales and resembling a water monkey was forced out with a terrified expression.
Initially, it had followed the four Shadows in the raid.
However, upon noticing the situation was wrong, it hid immediately.
Yet, it never expected that these humans’ perception would be so sharp, seeing through its disguise instantly!
This Shadow Monkey, in furious panic, still attempted to escape.
However, with the situation now five against one, it had no hope of escape.
Under several rounds of attacks from the group, it was blown to bits on-site.
Even Shen Yun threw a Holy Light Ball into the air to get a piece of the action.
Moments later, surprise filled Shen Yun’s face.
"Damn! I seem to have secured the kill!"
"Hahaha! I also eliminated a Legendary Powerhouse."
"A Fourth Transformation strike killing a Legend, old Shen, what a rare demon-level achievement indeed!"
Shen Yun raised his shield, laughing exaggeratedly.
Cheng Jianyong rolled his eyes endlessly.
He mentioned his own reaction was big.
Turns out this guy was even more exaggerated!
However, after this incident.

However, the battlefield was ever-changing.
Even with Han Xing’s help.
Next, Legends from both sides continued to fall.
Ever since Han Xing and his team killed five Shadow Legends.
Twelve more Legendary Powerhouses had fallen on the battlefield.
The Shadow Legion had lost eight Legends, and the Witch Race had lost four Legendary Powerhouses.
This was a true life-and-death struggle, with no one holding back.
Failure would mean extinction for their race.
The Witch Race Legends showed impressive resilience.
Even gravely injured, they were determined to bite off a piece of the enemy before dying.
Han Xing witnessed firsthand.
A relatively young-looking Witch Race woman was attacked by a group of Shadow Legends.
In a brief moment of carelessness, she suffered a heavy blow.
However, even with her head smashed by the enemy.
This female Legend managed to pass on her Witch Patterns to Wu Ling’Er before her death.
The ongoing battle cast somber expressions over Han Xing and his companions.
The war was brutal.
Despite the Shadow Legion losing so many Legends.
They still had over sixty remaining.
In contrast, the Witch Race’s initial count of over twenty Legends.
After constant losses, only twelve remained...
The Witch Race had spent thousands of years accumulating so many powerhouses.
And now, half were gone in a single conflict.
Even if they won this battle, the Witch Race would be severely weakened.
Moreover, even the hope of victory seemed slim.
No one dared to say if they would survive to the end.
The Witch Race Legends now only thought of taking down as many enemies as possible before dying.
At this moment.
A sudden shift occurred on the battlefield.
A Witch Race Legend was surrounded by over ten Shadow Legends, his flesh body instantly shattered.
Yet he still clung to a Middle Tier Legend, refusing to let go.
Poof!
With the sound of flesh bursting.
The Witch Race lost yet another Legend.
Everyone was filled with immense grief.
Han Xing anxiously checked the territory interface.
[Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele 1 is under construction, remaining time 3 minutes and 13 seconds...]
It’s close!
Hold on for three more minutes!
Just then.
The four High-tier Legends exchanged glances before nodding.
At this moment, the Spear Demon Venerable holding a spear shouted, "It’s about time! The Monarch should have acquired what he wanted."
"Let’s hurry and eliminate these guys, and start the blood sacrifice directly!"
Next moment, a sea-blue rhombic crystal appeared in its hand.
Emitting powerful Divine Power fluctuations.
Upon seeing the rhombic crystal, Wu Ling’Er, the High Priest, and all Witch Race Legendary Powerhouses.
Felt a wave of unease rise within them.
At this moment.
Xiao defended against the enemy’s attacks while querying in confusion, "What is this?"
The Shadow Demon Venerable had a smile on its face.
"What’s wrong, don’t you recognize it?"
"This is your Lord Saint Master, Helas’s Divine Format!"
Hearing this, all Witch Race powerhouses went pale with shock!
Although they already knew the Witch Race Saint Master had died.
They never expected the Saint Master to end up in such a pitiful state.
Even his Divine Format had been stripped away.
At this moment, the Shadow Demon Venerable said, "This Divine Format should carry your Witch Race’s destiny."
"Along with Helas’s Essence Blood."
"The Monarch said that granting me this Divine Format could allow me to advance further!"
"If I manage to kill you all within the required time, I won’t need to use this thing."
"But now, to avoid delaying the Monarch’s plan, I can only crush this!"
Xiao’s eyes widened instantly, knowing more than anyone how crucial a Divine Format is.
It’s the carrier of a tribe’s fortune.
Once shattered, these Witch Race powerhouses would suffer severe backlash!
Yet now, it was in the hands of the Shadow Demon Venerable.
Seeing the opponent about to crush the Divine Format.
Xiao shouted explosively.
"Stop!"
The Shadow Demon Venerable sneered coldly.
"Too late!"
With a crisp snap.
The sea-blue Divine Format in the Shadow Demon Venerable’s hand shattered.
Thus, Helas’s last mark on the world dissipated.
The blood aura on the Ancestral God Altar intensified once more.
At the same time.
Throughout the Witch Race’s territory, billions of Witch Race People, suffered severe backlash.
Ordinary people found it bearable.
They just felt a stifling pressure in their chest, like an impending doom.
Whereas captains, legion commanders, and other Fourth Transformation Powerhouses were suddenly severely wounded.
All spewing a mouthful of blood.
The stronger the individual, the greater the backlash.
Next moment.
The Witch Race Legendary Powerhouses didn’t sense any physical injuries.
Instead, they felt their entire body’s Power sealed as their Divine Power vanished.
At this moment, the remaining twelve Witch Race Legends, including Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest.
All fell down from the sky.
This sudden scene left everyone dumbfounded.
Despair flashed in the eyes of the Witch Race Legends.
In such an ever-changing battlefield, losing combat strength suddenly.
Even for a moment could lead to being instantly blown apart by the enemy.
And now, they all lost combat strength.
This might result in total annihilation!
Han Xing and the others were relatively unaffected.
Because they weren’t members of the Witch Race.
So the backlash of fortune from the Ancestral God Altar didn’t affect them.
As the Shadow Legends prepared to deliver a lethal blow.
Right at this moment.
A system notification whispered in Han Xing’s ear.
"Your territory’s building, Sun Crown Stele 1 has been successfully forged..."
"As the server’s first Survivor to forge a Sacred Artifact, World Impact +103, Legendary Points +50..."
"Legendary Points accumulated enough to extract the second Legendary Skill, do you wish to extract?"
Upon hearing the system notification, Han Xing couldn’t react immediately.
Next moment.
A radiant column of light soared skyward, covering the entire Ten Thousand Stars City.
The light pillar was exceedingly bright and dazzling, so much so that the sky seemed to tremble.
Even the Witch Race contingent over ten thousand kilometers away noticed the pillar of light.
The four Shadow Demon Venerables all turned their gaze toward Han Xing’s side.
Even the Shadow Legends halted their actions.
In that light pillar, they felt an intense sense of danger!
They were all awed by the divine and vast aura emanating from it.
At this moment, the Shadow Boxing King said uncertainly, "Is it the aura erupting from that Sky Island, what is that kid up to now?"
Beside him, the Spear Demon Venerable who had just crushed the Divine Format shook his head, "Not sure, but this aura makes me feel an undeniable threat!"
"I’ve only felt this sensation before in the presence of the Monarch."
"That kid, can actually pull off such a feat!"
Upon hearing this, the pupils of the other Shadow Demon Venerables contracted sharply.
Meanwhile.
At the very center of Ten Thousand Stars City.
A stele over two hundred meters tall, engraved with intricate text appeared before Han Xing.
Seeing the stele, Han Xing felt an intense surge of excitement.
It’s finally built!

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 316: The Terrified Shadow Legends
paragraphs: At this moment, the [Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele] is finally completed!
With the firepower of his territory and the qualitative change brought by the Sun Crown Stele.
Han Xing is confident that he can directly annihilate a High-tier Demon Venerable!
He stood on the throne and shouted loudly, "The holy artifact is completed, today, I will slay another High-tier Demon Venerable."
"Listen up, you guys are already surrounded by me!"
The Shadow Legends suddenly felt their scalps tingle.
Because they heard the words "Holy Artifact"!
Thinking back to the commotion on the human Sky Island just now.
What this human said might actually be true!
And in the next moment, they saw Han Xing’s Sky Island charging toward them.
At this moment.
The spearman hurriedly shouted, "Quickly fall back to defend!"
"This human actually has a holy artifact in his hand!"
"Concentrate all forces, stop him!"
The four High-tier Demon Venerables converged together.
Han Xing’s gaze was fixed on the group of Shadow Legends.
As Ten Thousand Stars City advanced, Han Xing also saw the attributes of the stele.
[Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele1]
[Defense Value]: 1 million
[Attack Power]: 0

[Building Effect]: Makes all buildings in the territory upgradeable. (Each time the Sun Crown Stele levels up, all building range, attack speed, attack range, armor, attack power are increased by 10%.)
[Current Level]: LV1.
Note: To level up the Sun Crown Stele, 1000 Philosopher’s Stones, 1000 Shimmering Terra Stones, and 5000 Shadow Divine Stones are required.
In the moment he saw the note, the expression on Han Xing’s face froze.
To level up the Sun Crown Stele, it actually requires so many high-level materials!
The Sun Crown Stele is currently level 1, leveling it to level 10 would need 9000 Philosopher’s Stones and Shimmering Terra Stones, and 45,000 Shadow Divine Stones.
However, the troublesome thing is.
Han Xing currently doesn’t have them.
His high-level stones were already used up when building the Sun Crown Stele.
In the current state, although the defense towers in the territory also have some enhancements.
It’s not enough to cause fatal damage to these high-level powerhouses.
If the war hadn’t started yet, Han Xing could still ask Wu Ling’Er to help him get a batch of materials.
But now.
He can’t possibly tell this group of Shadow Legends.
You all wait here, let me get some materials, and then fight you?
Also, he had already made bold statements.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel cold sweat running down his back!
But he didn’t dare stop the advancement of Ten Thousand Stars City, for fear that this group of Shadow Demon Venerables might see through his ruse.
Han Xing’s gaze roamed around the entire battlefield, searching for a way to break the stalemate.
Just then.
Han Xing’s gaze caught sight of the falling Witch Race Legends, along with Wu Ling’Er.
He dashed over directly.
The group of Shadow Legends saw him coming and was so frightened that they retreated dozens of kilometers.
Taking this opportunity, Han Xing maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City to dive sharply, chasing after the falling Shadow Legends.
The High-tier Demon Venerables saw this and exclaimed, "Not good, this kid intends to rescue those Witch Race Legends!"
"Stop him!"
With the words spoken, dozens of Shadow Legends gritted their teeth and pursued relentlessly.
At that moment, Han Xing activated several hundred Tower of Death Light within his territory.
The next moment.
The Sun Crown Stele burst out with a holy white light once more.
Simultaneously, Han Xing continued to activate all the defense towers within his territory.
The Hellfire Missile Silos and Demon Elephant War Chariots, along with tens of thousands of Thunderbolt Towers, were all enveloped by the white light emanating from the Sun Crown Stele.
The vast and holy aura once again overawed the group of Shadow Legends!
At this moment,
Han Xing pulled out an arrow.
The arrow was imbued with terrifyingly scorching energy.
The surrounding temperature suddenly increased by several degrees.
This arrow from Han Xing was actually the precursor of his ultimate skill—Sun-Destroying Arrow.
"Come, let me see who wants to be the first to die?"
Han Xing challenged with veiled confidence.
Feeling the unparalleled lethality of Han Xing’s arrow, even those High-tier Legends halted their steps.
Though they didn’t know what this human was scheming now.
Why he just released the holy artifact’s aura without actually attacking.
But the previous lessons had already made this group of Shadow Legends no longer underestimate him.
For a moment, not a single Shadow Legend dared to advance.
Han Xing’s expression remained unchanged, yet he secretly exhaled in relief.
Taking this gap.
Ten Thousand Stars City unleashed high speed, appearing directly below the trajectory of the falling Witch Race Legends.
Thud! Thud!
One after another, the falling Witch Race Legends crashed onto Ten Thousand Stars City, creating large pits on the ground.
When it was Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest’s turn.
Han Xing’s figure flashed, directly catching Wu Ling’Er.
Next to him, the High Priest, who was falling with Wu Ling’Er, could only land headfirst, smashing onto the ground heavily.
At this moment, the High Priest looked at Han Xing speechlessly.
This kid, I was clearly closer to you just now.
You actually pretended not to see me and turned to catch Wu Ling’Er!
Too much!
Ignoring the looks from these guys.
Han Xing turned his gaze skyward.
He knew the Shadow Legends in the sky were merely intimidated by him.
If they eventually saw through Han Xing’s bluff, they would definitely rush forward in swarms.
At this moment, with the beauty in his arms, Han Xing went directly to the side of the Witch Race Legends, extending his hand.
"Hand over all of your Philosopher’s Stones, Terrastones."
The Witch Race Legends looked at each other.
It seemed they were shocked by Han Xing’s bandit-like speech.
Even Wu Ling’Er in his arms looked at him with bewildered eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 316: The Terrified Shadow Legends
paragraphs: However, Han Xing didn’t have the time to explain so much to them.
"Hurry up, I can use them."
The crowd hesitated a little.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er directly said, "Give them to him!"
All the Witch Race legends handed their space backpacks to Han Xing without hesitation.
Han Xing took them all, quickly checked the contents, and his face immediately lit up with joy.
These Witch Race legends indeed had a wealth of resources.
Han Xing casually scanned through one legendary’s backpack and found many high-tier materials and various powerful secret elixirs.
Among them, Han Xing spotted some powerful jewelry and blueprints.
He even saw several skill books.
The words "Witch Clan Forbidden Technique" were written on them.
Through previous battles, Han Xing already knew how powerful these Witch Clan Forbidden Techniques were.
Learning any one of them was comparable to the enhancement brought by a legendary skill!
However, he quickly dismissed these thoughts.
Han Xing only took out the Philosopher’s Stone and Shimmering Terra Stone from inside.
He checked the quantity.
There were more than twenty thousand Philosopher’s Stones and more than ten thousand Shimmering Terra Stones.
It was more than enough to upgrade the Sun Crown Stele to full level.
Almost half of these resources were obtained from the High Priest’s backpack.
Han Xing took a deep look at this man, then returned the backpacks to the others.
It seems long to say.
But in fact, from Han Xing’s rush to rescue the Witch Race legends, less than twenty seconds had passed.
The group of Shadow Legends had been watching Han Xing’s actions all along.
Even seeing him save the Witch Race legends, they did not dare to advance.
However, several high-tier Demon Venerables, after observing for a while, gradually noticed something amiss,
"This kid, isn’t he just bluffing to scare us again?"
The Shadow Boxing King swung his heavy, mechanical-like fist, a gleam of cold light in his eyes.
Dozens of legends, including four high-tier legends, were actually frightened by a human at less than the Fourth Transformation.
At this moment.
The Demon Venerable with a spear shouted, "Enough of this!"
"We attack from four angles separately!"
"No matter what this kid has up his sleeve, he can’t manage so many directions at once!"
With these words, the four high-tier legends, along with the remaining dozens of Shadow Legends, all pounced toward Han Xing.
Seeing the Shadow Legends preparing to make their move.
On the Ten Thousand Stars City, those Witch Race legends lying on the ground, looking like dead fish, suddenly widened their eyes.
They looked at Han Xing with eyes full of fear.
Through this period of observation,
They realized that this human named Han Xing, although arrogant in his words, had never truly acted.
The group of Shadow Legends had already entered the attack range.
If there were any means to deal with them, he would have used them by now.
But Han Xing kept still.
So they roughly guessed that Han Xing was indeed bluffing.
Yet thinking about how this human came to save them, a warmth bloomed in their hearts.
At this point, a Witch Race legend hurriedly said, "Those guys are coming, Human, you should run!"
"Their target is us."
"If you leave now, you still have a chance of survival."
Wu Ling’Er also urged Han Xing to leave quickly.
However, Han Xing did not respond.
Instead, he was quickly clicking on the Sun Crown Stele, hitting the upgrade button.
The system prompt appeared.
"Do you want to consume Philosopher’s Stone*1000, Shimmering Terra Stone*1000, Shadow Divine Stone*5000, to upgrade the Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele?"
"Yes!"
Han Xing clicked nine times in succession.
Meanwhile.
In the center of Lord’s Mansion, the towering stone stele, over a hundred meters high, suddenly transformed at immense speed.
From its original height of over two hundred meters, it instantly shot up to more than three hundred meters, still rising rapidly.
Simultaneously, the holy light emitted by the Sun Crown Stele grew ever more intense.
But the Shadow Legends were no longer frightened by him.
At this moment, they all charged toward Ten Thousand Stars City.
The Witch Race legends involuntarily clenched their fists.
Lying on the ground, the High Priest’s chest heaved continuously, red secret patterns bursting from his body.
He was struggling to regain control over his divine power.
At this critical moment.
A smile suddenly appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
He looked at the surrounding Shadow Legends charging in.
The few high-tier legends felt a sudden surge of strong anxiety when they saw Han Xing’s smile.
The next moment.
He directly activated every defense tower on his territory!
Including those Thunderbolt Towers, Spiritual Shock Towers, Towers of Death Light, Hellfire Missile Silos, Demon Elephant War Chariots...
At this moment.
The defense towers with long-range attack capabilities all bloomed with dazzling white light.
The Demon Venerable holding a spear exclaimed, "No, retreat quickly!"
But it was already too late!
Buzz!
When the first wave of energy beams descended.
The Shadow Legends clearly sensed the difference in these attacks.
They were more destructive and potent than before!
Even on the beams emitted by those Thunderbolt Towers, the Shadow Legends felt a strong sense of crisis.
When attack range, attack power, and firing speed all doubled!
Even a structure like the Thunderbolt Tower, when amassed in numbers, was enough to threaten Legendary Powerhouses.
At this moment, Han Xing showed them what the power of a Holy Artifact meant!
Pfft, pfft, pfft!
A group of Shadow Legends was instantly hit by the attacks from the Thunderbolt Towers?
The paralysis effect they carried, though greatly reduced on them, still resulted in a 0.1-second control time.
The Shadow Legends convulsed repeatedly in the air.
And as the various Spiritual Shock Towers’ attacks overhead exploded.
Before, they only had the lethality of firecrackers; now they turned into the effect of thunder.
Moreover, something even more terrifying followed.
In the sky, clusters of noticeably enlarged Hellfire.
And the devastating shells from the Demon Elephant War Chariots, trailing thick smoke, slashed through the sky.
In an instant, they reached the Shadow Legends.
Then came the most powerful and terrifying attack from Han Xing’s territory— the Tower of Death Light!
Augmented by the Sun Crown Stele.
The Tower of Death Light’s attack power doubled from 30,000 to 60,000!
This wasn’t just as simple as 3+3.
60,000 attack power had achieved a qualitative leap, able to break through a Middle-tier Legend’s domain.
A single Tower of Death Light was enough to severely wound an Initial-tier Legend!
Not to mention, more than four hundred defense towers erupted simultaneously!
When those shells exploded.
The area tens of kilometers around Ten Thousand Stars City turned into a sea of fire!
At the same time.
The entire battlefield for thousands of miles fell into intense tremors.
Then, a fierce gale swept through!
Even the Witch Race army battling the Shadow Legion in the distance felt the tremors.
A few seconds later.
The clouds of dust gradually dispersed.
Dozens of figures fled in a disheveled panic.
Compared to the number of powerhouses that came to besiege Ten Thousand Stars City seconds ago.
The Shadow Legends here were noticeably fewer!
Adding them up, there were now less than forty left!
This indicated that, in that recent wave of explosions, at least nearly twenty Shadow Legends perished.
Including that one black monster that looked like a Qilin.
That was a true High-tier Legend!
This showed just how terrifying the damage from Han Xing’s recent bombing was.
But even those Shadow Legends who escaped weren’t in good shape.
Each was badly injured.
To survive under such terrifying firepower, they paid a huge price.
Even the three High-tier Legends had extensive damage on their bodies.
This was due to Han Xing spreading out the firepower.
If all the firepower had focused on them just now.
Those three High-tier Legends might have fallen on the spot!
They looked at that Sky Island with eyes full of fear!
At this moment, Han Xing smiled as he looked at the suddenly skyrocketing number of souls in the Demon Furnace.
Though killing these Legendary Powerhouses with defense towers wouldn’t grant experience.
Nor could he absorb the divine power from them.
The Demon Furnace collecting their souls was still a nice reward.
These dozen Shadow Legends provided Han Xing with over two hundred million souls.
At this moment.
On Ten Thousand Stars City, the Witch Race Legends were staring in a daze at this scene.
What just happened?
Why did these defense towers suddenly unleash such terrifying power?
Why was even a High-tier Legend instantly killed?
And so many Shadow Legends!
Before this, aside from the Dwarf Race’s top-tier technology and some high-tier ancient weapons.
They had never heard of any defense tower that could threaten a High-tier Legend!
How did that Human achieve it?
These Witch Race Legends were completely bewildered...

"Yes!"
Han Xing clicked nine times in succession.

Simultaneously, the holy light emitted by the Sun Crown Stele grew ever more intense.
But the Shadow Legends were no longer frightened by him.
