chapters.title: Chapter 447 - 317: Massacre, the Monarch Appears!
paragraphs: However, it wasn’t just this group of Witch Race Legends that were bewildered.
The opposite Shadow Legends were even more bewildered and filled with dread!
This human was terrifying!
Han Xing gently put down Wu Ling’Er.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er had only regained a small bit of Divine Power, able to barely stand and move.
The backlash had caused too much impact.
It’s imaginable, if not for Han Xing’s presence.
When Helas’s Divine Format was extracted from that Shadow Demon Venerable, the outcome was already decided!
The Witch Race would undoubtedly be defeated!
But now, because of Han Xing’s heroic turn of events, the battle had taken an unexpected turn.
"Hu... Human Race..."
Han Xing saw that group of Witch Race Legends gradually stand up.
Before they could continue speaking.
Han Xing directly turned his gaze to that group of Shadow Legends.
The next moment.
The Ten Thousand Stars City burst out with a dazzling Holy Light once again.
After experiencing the previous scene.
The group of Shadow Legends, upon seeing this light appear, each looked as if they had seen a ghost, terrified, scattering in all directions.
The recent burst had truly left them utterly deflated.
A group of Shadow Legends scattered like birds and beasts.
Boom!
The shell exploded.
Seeing them flee, Han Xing controlled the Ten Thousand Stars City from the rear, continuously bombarding.
Buzz!
Some who couldn’t dodge in time, were targeted by the Tower of Death Light among the Shadow Legends.
As if struck by the Finger of Death, they froze in place.
Then, like crystal structures, their flesh bodies shattered with a crash.
At this moment, Han Xing transformed into a ruthless bombing machine.
Legendary Level creatures that struck fear, were blasted on the spot by the terrifying firepower of the Tower of Death Light!
"Boom! Boom! Boom!
One after another, Shadow Legends fell.
Massive souls gathered towards Han Xing’s Demon Furnace.
At this moment, the group of Witch Race Legends was completely dumbfounded.
A strong sense of unreality surged within their hearts.
Those were the Shadow Legends that almost annihilated them, bringing immense pain to the entire Witch Race Territory!
Now, they were being chased and killed like dogs by this young man!
Han Xing, while controlling the Ten Thousand Stars City to continue bombing, felt extremely excited!
"Indeed, this kind of absolute firepower suppression is more satisfying!"
"No matter what Basic Legend, High-level Legend, they all fall under my artillery!"
Han Xing, along the route those Shadow Legends fled, chased frantically.
However, although the Ten Thousand Stars City now had extremely strong firepower.
It had one drawback, which was that its movement speed was far slower than those Legendary Powerhouses.
At this moment, after Han Xing chased and killed for hundreds of kilometers, another seven or eight Legendary Powerhouses had fallen.
Currently, the remaining Shadow Legends were already fewer than forty.
From over one hundred and fifty, down to now.
More than a hundred Legends had fallen directly.
Even though the Shadow Legion had deep foundations, they couldn’t withstand such a death toll.
The group of Shadow Legends all scattered, and seeing Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City approach, they were scared to the soul!
At this time, they suddenly saw a large shadow appear in the distance.
These were the Witch Race Main Cities pushing towards the border defense line with the Shadow Legion!
In the distance, Kathy saw Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City.
Being familiar with frequently interacting with Han Xing, Kathy recognized it.
"Look! That’s Lord Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City!" Kathy exclaimed.
Other Witch Race officers, from afar, also saw the battlefield of the Legendary Powerhouses.
However, when they saw the Ten Thousand Stars City chasing that group of Shadow Legends, causing them to lose armor and abandon their weapons.
They all looked at each other in confusion for a moment.
"Uh... what happened? Where are our Witch Race Priests?"
"It looks like Lord Han Xing is facing those Shadow Legends alone?
Kathy also shook her head in confusion.
And when she looked closely, she exclaimed, "There!"
"The Priests are on the Ten Thousand Stars City!"
A group of Witch Race officers turned their gaze.
At the same time.
The Legendary Powerhouses on the Ten Thousand Stars City saw their Sky Island.
It had drifted over to them, and they were all astonished.
At this moment, Shen Yun came over.
Then simply explained to them that it was Han Xing who provided the plan to those Witch Race officers.
And helped these main cities escape from within Witch Race territory.
After listening to Shen Yun’s explanation.
The Legendary Powerhouses raised their heads in respect.
They had not expected that Han Xing not only came to support their Legendary Battle.
But he even considered the Witch Race civilians.
Han Xing’s plan essentially saved billions of Witch Race people!
At this moment.
The gazes of those Witch Race Legends towards Han Xing changed from shock to admiration!
No matter Han Xing’s identity or race.
What he had done today was enough to be recorded in the annals of the Witch Race, revered for generations by the Witch Race people!
At this moment, not only were those Legendary Powerhouses extremely excited.
But also the Witch Race soldiers who had rushed from within the Witch Race territory, felt extremely excited.
They saw on the Ten Thousand Stars City, those terrifying presences were their clan’s powerhouses.
Although everyone carried injuries.
But compared to the group of Shadow Legends fleeing in all directions, chased by Han Xing, they were much better off.
Seeing this, if not for the three High-tier Demon Venerables still on the battlefield.
They might even suspect.
The Witch Race had already won this war.
At this time, the group of Witch Race Legends had gradually recovered their power.
The negative effects brought by the backlash had also dissipated.

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - 317: Massacre, the Monarch Arrives! (Part 2)
paragraphs: At this moment.
The brows of the remaining three high-tier Legends were furrowed tightly.
The Dark Shadow Demon Venerable holding a spear, after seeing Han Xing relentlessly pursue the Witch Race Legend.
The Shadow Boxing King beside him asked, "Sting, what do we do now?"
"It seems like we’ve really lost..."
Reluctant as they were to admit it.
But if the threat of that Sky Island isn’t resolved, no matter how many of these Shadow Legends go, they will die.
The Dark Shadow Demon Venerable took a deep breath, looking from afar at the terrifying main city.
Moments later, he shook his head and said, "There’s no way. We have to inform the Monarch that something happened here."
"We can’t kill all the Witch Race Legends, nor can we kill the Witch Race Saintess.
"The blood ritual has failed..."
Upon hearing they had to inform the Shadow Monarch, these high-tier Legends all had a change in their expressions.
But they also knew there was no other option.
The situation had already turned against them.
The two tasks given by the Shadow Monarch could no longer be completed.
If this delayed the Shadow Monarch’s plans, their fate would be even more dire.
At this time, the Dark Shadow Demon Venerable holding the spear suddenly had a black crystal stone in his hand.
He glanced at the distant Big Head Demon Venerable.
Then, he crushed the crystal stone.
Meanwhile.
Two terrifying figures were rapidly advancing within the Witch Race territory.
They looked slow, but in fact, their speed was incredibly fast, crossing hundreds of kilometers in an instant.
These two figures, one male and one female.
Were precisely the Shadow Monarch and the mysterious woman beside him.
The direction they were advancing in seemed to be an area of space turbulence.
That is, the place where the Path of the Giant Dragon was located.
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch glanced at the woman beside him,
"I must say, you’re really crazy to even think of targeting that group of Giant Dragons."
"You know, those guys inside aren’t easy to deal with."
Beside him.
The enchanting woman chuckled, "There’s no other way, it’s part of the plan..."
"If we can’t get that one thing inside the Path of the Giant Dragon, we can’t proceed to the next step~"
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch looked deeply at her.
"What exactly is your plan?"
"All these years, you’ve never told me."
The enchanting woman laughed and said, "You don’t need to know."
The Shadow Monarch stopped speaking.
Just then, they suddenly heard a cracking sound in their ears.
The Shadow Monarch looked down.
To find a piece of the black crystal armor on his body had shattered.
The Shadow Monarch halted his steps.
The enchanting woman tilted her head, "What happened?"
The Shadow Monarch shook his head, "It seems there’s a problem over at the border."
"Those guys are actually asking me for help."
Upon hearing this, even the enchanting woman was quite surprised.
She knew very well how much force the Shadow Legion had invested to conquer the Witch Race territory this time.
And now, the Shadow Monarch had actually received a plea for help.
This indicated a major unexpected change had occurred at the border.
The enchanting woman frowned and said, "Could it be that the Old Tree Spirit and the Beastman King have made a move?"
The Shadow Monarch shook his head, "I haven’t sensed the aura of Demigod-level beings within the Witch Race territory, it shouldn’t be these two old guys."
The two seemed somewhat confused.
Moments later, the enchanting woman’s bewitching expression gradually disappeared.
Replacing it was a cold demeanor as she said, "Go, quickly resolve the matter there."
"Inside the Path of the Giant Dragon, I still need your assistance."
The Shadow Monarch nodded.
Now, he was at least several million kilometers away from the Witch Race border.
Even at Demigod-level movement speed, it would still take several hours.
By the time he got there, the matter would have long been settled deliberately.
Then, the Shadow Monarch seemed to have a special method.
He reached out again with his withered right hand.
Slowly grasped.
In the next moment.
A phantom of a Shadow Legend appeared before him.
It was... a dark creature with an enormous head.
With a cracking sound.
The phantom in front shattered, and the Shadow Monarch also vanished from the original spot.
At the Witch Race border.
Han Xing was controlling Ten Thousand Stars City, hunting down those Shadow Legends everywhere.
And those Witch Race Legendary Powerhouses, after regaining their strength, quickly poured various precious Secret Elixirs into their mouths.
Their injuries began to recover at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Then, they joined the camp of hunting down the Shadow Legends together.
Among them, the Witch Race allocated three Legends to intercept the major main cities rapidly approaching from behind.
In this large-scale war.
The power exerted by a Legendary-level powerhouse is equivalent to a strategic weapon.
Three Legends charged towards the Shadow Army.
Those Shadow Monsters, upon encountering their Secret Pattern Domains, instantly turned to dust and scattered in midair.
Every moment, tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of Shadow Monsters died.
With the addition of these Legendary-level powerhouses.
The pressure on those Sky Islands greatly diminished.
Moments later.
Those main city Sky Islands, each one was as large as a country’s area.
Along with the scattered hundreds of secondary Sky Islands nearby.
At this moment connected together, they could be described as a vast land.
At first glance, it stretched beyond the horizon.
Its actual area even exceeded the total land area of Blue Star.
Han Xing also glanced at the scene behind and marveled at the deep heritage of the Witch Race.
He had actually realized his goal of rebuilding Blue Star!
However, considering it was the accumulation of a trillion Witch Race people over thousands of years, it was not unexpected.
Just as Han Xing activated the Tower of Death Light, killing a Witch Race Shadow Legend.
Unexplained palpitations surged in his heart.
However, since he had upgraded the Sun Crown Stele to full level, these Shadow Legends, including those High-tier Demon Venerables, posed no threat to him.
Moreover, this feeling was very familiar.
Previously, when Han Xing faced that group of Giant Dragons on the Path of the Giant Dragon, he had felt it once.
At the Abyssal Rift, when the Great Demon Monarch charged after them, he had also felt it once.
This was the power belonging to the Demigod-level!
Han Xing suddenly halted, continuously scanning the surroundings.
Then, he locked his gaze onto one of the remaining three High-tier Legends.
On that massively headed existence.
At this moment.
The elongated face on its oval head seemed extremely pained.
It extended its short arms, frantically clawing at its face.
On its deformed body, dense cracks began to appear.
Han Xing frowned.
This guy is suspicious!
No matter what it wanted to do, with Han Xing’s character, he had to eliminate the enemy at the first opportunity!
In the next moment.
The various Defense Towers on Ten Thousand Stars City were activated.
A total of one hundred Towers of Death Light simultaneously launched an attack, with combined attack power enough to kill a High-tier Legend!
Buzz!
Just as the black light beam struck the Big Head Demon Venerable.
The expected scene of the opponent being blasted to bits did not occur.
Instead.
Before the arrival of the black light beam.
The Big Head Demon Venerable’s body cracked like porcelain.
Crack!
Crack!
A series of unpleasant cracking sounds echoed.
Then.
A withered hand scrambled out from the Big Head Demon Venerable’s eye socket.
Boom!
The Big Head Demon Venerable shattered into fragments.
And in the place where it originally stood.
Appeared a figure clad in a black cloak, wielding a Great Sword.
At the moment that figure appeared.
In a radius of ten thousand miles, all movements came to a halt instantly.
As if they had encountered some kind of time-stopping skill.
Or perhaps, a group control skill.
At this time.
Besides those Witch Race powerhouses and Han Xing’s five group members.
All creatures below the Legendary level were frozen in place.
Billions of pairs of eyes focused on that black figure.
His appearance did not seem particularly terrifying.
Standing below two meters tall, he didn’t even exude the oppressive aura of those Shadow Demon Venerables.
However.
Upon seeing that figure, the pupils of Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest contracted instantaneously.
Their faces turned deathly pale, as if they had seen something horrifying.
Noticing their change in expression.
Han Xing sent over a puzzled look.
Wu Ling’Er took a deep breath and exclaimed!
"It’s the Shadow Monarch!"
"Run!"

sentences.text: At this moment.
The brows of the remaining three high-tier Legends were furrowed tightly.
The Dark Shadow Demon Venerable holding a spear, after seeing Han Xing relentlessly pursue the Witch Race Legend.
The Shadow Boxing King beside him asked, "Sting, what do we do now?"
"It seems like we’ve really lost..."
Reluctant as they were to admit it.
But if the threat of that Sky Island isn’t resolved, no matter how many of these Shadow Legends go, they will die.
The Dark Shadow Demon Venerable took a deep breath, looking from afar at the terrifying main city.
Moments later, he shook his head and said, "There’s no way.
We have to inform the Monarch that something happened here."
"We can’t kill all the Witch Race Legends, nor can we kill the Witch Race Saintess.
"The blood ritual has failed..."
Upon hearing they had to inform the Shadow Monarch, these high-tier Legends all had a change in their expressions.
But they also knew there was no other option.
The situation had already turned against them.
The two tasks given by the Shadow Monarch could no longer be completed.
If this delayed the Shadow Monarch’s plans, their fate would be even more dire.
At this time, the Dark Shadow Demon Venerable holding the spear suddenly had a black crystal stone in his hand.
He glanced at the distant Big Head Demon Venerable.
Then, he crushed the crystal stone.
Meanwhile.
Two terrifying figures were rapidly advancing within the Witch Race territory.
They looked slow, but in fact, their speed was incredibly fast, crossing hundreds of kilometers in an instant.
These two figures, one male and one female.
Were precisely the Shadow Monarch and the mysterious woman beside him.
The direction they were advancing in seemed to be an area of space turbulence.
That is, the place where the Path of the Giant Dragon was located.
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch glanced at the woman beside him,
"I must say, you’re really crazy to even think of targeting that group of Giant Dragons."
"You know, those guys inside aren’t easy to deal with."
Beside him.
The enchanting woman chuckled, "There’s no other way, it’s part of the plan..."
"If we can’t get that one thing inside the Path of the Giant Dragon, we can’t proceed to the next step~"
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch looked deeply at her.
"What exactly is your plan?"
"All these years, you’ve never told me."
The enchanting woman laughed and said, "You don’t need to know."
The Shadow Monarch stopped speaking.
Just then, they suddenly heard a cracking sound in their ears.
The Shadow Monarch looked down.
To find a piece of the black crystal armor on his body had shattered.
The Shadow Monarch halted his steps.
The enchanting woman tilted her head, "What happened?"
The Shadow Monarch shook his head, "It seems there’s a problem over at the border."
"Those guys are actually asking me for help."
Upon hearing this, even the enchanting woman was quite surprised.
She knew very well how much force the Shadow Legion had invested to conquer the Witch Race territory this time.
And now, the Shadow Monarch had actually received a plea for help.
This indicated a major unexpected change had occurred at the border.
The enchanting woman frowned and said, "Could it be that the Old Tree Spirit and the Beastman King have made a move?"
The Shadow Monarch shook his head, "I haven’t sensed the aura of Demigod-level beings within the Witch Race territory, it shouldn’t be these two old guys."
The two seemed somewhat confused.
Moments later, the enchanting woman’s bewitching expression gradually disappeared.
Replacing it was a cold demeanor as she said, "Go, quickly resolve the matter there."
"Inside the Path of the Giant Dragon, I still need your assistance."
The Shadow Monarch nodded.
Now, he was at least several million kilometers away from the Witch Race border.
Even at Demigod-level movement speed, it would still take several hours.
By the time he got there, the matter would have long been settled deliberately.
Then, the Shadow Monarch seemed to have a special method.
He reached out again with his withered right hand.
Slowly grasped.
In the next moment.
A phantom of a Shadow Legend appeared before him.
It was... a dark creature with an enormous head.
With a cracking sound.
The phantom in front shattered, and the Shadow Monarch also vanished from the original spot.
At the Witch Race border.
Han Xing was controlling Ten Thousand Stars City, hunting down those Shadow Legends everywhere.
And those Witch Race Legendary Powerhouses, after regaining their strength, quickly poured various precious Secret Elixirs into their mouths.
Their injuries began to recover at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Then, they joined the camp of hunting down the Shadow Legends together.
Among them, the Witch Race allocated three Legends to intercept the major main cities rapidly approaching from behind.
In this large-scale war.
The power exerted by a Legendary-level powerhouse is equivalent to a strategic weapon.
Three Legends charged towards the Shadow Army.
Those Shadow Monsters, upon encountering their Secret Pattern Domains, instantly turned to dust and scattered in midair.
Every moment, tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of Shadow Monsters died.
With the addition of these Legendary-level powerhouses.
The pressure on those Sky Islands greatly diminished.
Moments later.
Those main city Sky Islands, each one was as large as a country’s area.
Along with the scattered hundreds of secondary Sky Islands nearby.
At this moment connected together, they could be described as a vast land.
At first glance, it stretched beyond the horizon.
Its actual area even exceeded the total land area of Blue Star.
Han Xing also glanced at the scene behind and marveled at the deep heritage of the Witch Race.
He had actually realized his goal of rebuilding Blue Star!
However, considering it was the accumulation of a trillion Witch Race people over thousands of years, it was not unexpected.
Just as Han Xing activated the Tower of Death Light, killing a Witch Race Shadow Legend.
Unexplained palpitations surged in his heart.
However, since he had upgraded the Sun Crown Stele to full level, these Shadow Legends, including those High-tier Demon Venerables, posed no threat to him.
Moreover, this feeling was very familiar.
Previously, when Han Xing faced that group of Giant Dragons on the Path of the Giant Dragon, he had felt it once.
At the Abyssal Rift, when the Great Demon Monarch charged after them, he had also felt it once.
This was the power belonging to the Demigod-level!

Then, he locked his gaze onto one of the remaining three High-tier Legends.
On that massively headed existence.
At this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - 318: The Shocked Shadow Monarch!
paragraphs: Hearing Wu Ling’Er’s warning, Han Xing’s face changed dramatically.
Shadow Monarch!
The leader of the Shadow Legion!
He has stirred up many wars in the Holy Spirit Realm, always causing upheaval.
Even the great clans can’t handle his presence.
Moreover, a few hours ago.
He had slain the Witch Race Saint Master, Helas!
That was a recognized demigod-level powerhouse!
This means that the power the Shadow Monarch possesses can even pose a mortal threat to a demigod-level powerhouse!
And such a being.
Is now coming out of Big Head Demon Venerable’s body.
And it seems he is going to target them!
The moment the Shadow Demon Venerable emerged, he quickly scanned the battlefield.
And then his gaze fixed on Han Xing.
As if he understood something in an instant.
"Interesting... So, there’s an anomaly like you here?"
The Shadow Monarch stared at Han Xing as if recalling something.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er urgently shouted, "Brother Xing, run!"
Without needing Wu Ling’Er to say more, Han Xing, the moment he saw this guy, quickly fled backward.
He was very grateful that he did not, like those Witch Race people, become frozen in place.
Otherwise, he could only wait for death at this moment!
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch stretched out his withered right hand.
As if he was grabbing something across the air.
Han Xing was horrified to discover.
That his Ten Thousand Stars City was being swiftly dragged in front of this being!
At that moment.
Everyone on the Ten Thousand Stars City felt their scalp tingling!
What kind of bizarre technique is this!
It can even directly drag a Sky Island!
Before this, they had never encountered such a powerful and strange enemy!
If this were applied to a person, wouldn’t they now be in the hands of the Shadow Monarch?
A critical moment!
Wu Ling’Er suddenly shouted, "Go save Han Xing!"
Hearing Wu Ling’Er’s command.
These Witch Race Legends hesitated not a moment and burst forth with all their power, charging towards the Shadow Monarch!
Seeing these Witch Race Legends in action.
The Shadow Monarch seemed a bit surprised that these ants dared to make a move against him.
He released his grasp on Ten Thousand Stars City.
In the next moment.
More than ten secret pattern attacks fell on the Shadow Monarch’s head.
Including the attacks of Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest.
"Boom!"
That area was instantly shrouded in millions of secret patterns.
Terrifying energy rampaged.
Even a high-tier legend would fall under such concentrated fire.
However.
When the energy fluctuations dissipated.
A black figure emerged.
A faint energy shield appeared on him, seeming as if he hadn’t moved an inch the whole time.
And he himself was completely unharmed.
This scene.
Left everyone in utter despair.
At this point, the Shadow Monarch cast a casual glance at them.
"Forget it, let’s deal with you all first and complete the blood sacrifice."
With those words.
Before anyone could react.
The Shadow Monarch suddenly appeared behind a Witch Race Legend.
The Great Sword suddenly extended.
That Witch Race Legend could barely turn his head!
"Swish!"
The sound of wind swept through.
He was cleaved in half on the spot.
Blood splattered through the air!
Such a bloody scene jolted everyone’s nerves.
"Ninth Priest!!"
The Witch Race powerhouses were filled with rage and their eyes burned with fury towards the Shadow Monarch!
Wishing they could tear the Shadow Monarch limb from limb right then and there!
However, the Shadow Legends, seeing their Monarch unleash his might, were thrilled beyond words.
They raised their weapons and shouted in unison.
"Monarch, invincible!"
"Monarch, kill them all!"
Ignoring the cheers from these fellows.
At that moment, the Shadow Monarch once again appeared in front of a Shadow Legend.
The Great Sword gently fell.
At the critical moment, the Witch Race powerhouse uttered a few syllables.
"Forbidden Art — Witch Soul Transfer!"
Whoosh—
So narrowly, before the Shadow Monarch’s Great Sword could chop down, he vanished from the spot.
The Shadow Monarch swung his sword in vain, seemingly surprised.
He shook his head and said, "Dealing with you legends is a bit troublesome."
With that.
The Shadow Monarch slowly clenched his right hand.
Then clutched it tightly.
Accompanied by a scalp-numbing sound of flesh bursting.
In the next moment.
On a distant Sky Island, billions of Witch Race civilians suddenly exploded into a bloody mist!
This scene, directly left a kind of Witch Race powerhouse’s eyes bulging with rage!
"Damn it!"
"Shadow Monarch, I’ll kill you!"
But before they could finish their words.
All these Witch Race powerhouses were met with a powerful backlash!
Since the Ancestral God Altar fell into the Shadow Monarch’s hands, he had figured out its wondrous utility.
That is, by massively slaughtering Witch Race civilians, he could cause a backlash against these Witch Race powerhouses.
At that moment.
The Shadow Monarch lightly appeared behind a Witch Race powerhouse.
Once more, the sword fell.
In the backlash state, this Witch Race powerhouse had no strength to resist.
Puff!
Blood blossoms drifted in the air.
Yet another Legend died at his hands.
This was the fourteenth Legend of the Witch Race to die today.
Now on the field, the number of Legends, excluding Wu Ling’Er and the High Priest, was down to only twelve.
At this moment, all the Witch Race powerhouses felt an overwhelming anger.
Their gaze towards the Shadow Monarch was filled with hatred.
In unison, they launched their strongest attacks against the Shadow Monarch!
"Witch Clan Forbidden Technique — Secret Pattern Soul Lock!"
"Witch Clan Forbidden Technique — Eighteen Sword Array!"
"Witch Clan Forbidden Technique — Thunder Purgatory!"
More than a dozen Witch Clan Forbidden Techniques were unleashed.
Including Han Xing, who was the first to activate the hundreds of Towers of Death Light in his domain, instantly blasting forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - 318: The Shocked Shadow Monarch! (Part 2)
paragraphs: This was their strongest strike.
Such numerous Witch Clan Forbidden Techniques, combined with Han Xing’s Defense Tower Attack Power stacking.
Even a Demigod Level powerhouse, if they endure this strike, will be severely injured if not dead!
However, the Shadow Monarch did not evade or dodge.
He merely lifted his black Great Sword gently.
Then, sliced down lightly.
The next moment.
All Forbidden Technique attacks arrived.
"Buzz!"
In that area, various terrifying phenomena appeared.
There were Vengeful Spirits wailing, lightning rampaging, eighteen dazzling sword lights cutting through.
And all sorts of terrifying celestial phenomena.
However, facing that light slice of the sword, these phenomena seemed like bubbles, bursting at a touch.
When everything dissipated.
The figure still stood in place.
Aside from a faint smoke appearing on his body, there was no indication of any damage,
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch nodded.
"This move was good, it actually broke my defense."
"It almost injured me."
Yet this statement left everyone in utter despair.
This guy is simply a monster!
The Shadow Monarch is definitely not an ordinary Demigod Level powerhouse!
Otherwise, he wouldn’t endure such a bombardment!
At the instant when everyone’s attack ceased, the Shadow Monarch appeared beside a Witch Race Legend and sliced again.
Thud!
Another Witch Race Legend fell by the Shadow Monarch’s deadly hands.
From his appearance till now.
He has already slain three Witch Race Legends in succession.
And he, still seems like he hasn’t exerted any effort.
The power of the Shadow Monarch is overwhelmingly despairing!
At this time.
The Shadow Monarch suddenly took something out from his bosom.
It seemed to be a miniature Ancestral God Altar, with increasingly intense blood aura winding around it.
The Shadow Monarch glanced at the state of the Ancestral God Altar, then surveyed everyone on the scene.
"It seems that even if I kill you all, the blood sacrifice is a bit lacking."
"But, these matters can be considered afterward."
The Shadow Monarch was just about to continue speaking.
When he suddenly noticed a dozen strong presences appearing in the sky over the Witch Race Border.
Those presences haven’t even arrived yet but have already issued deafening sounds.
"People of the Witch Race! Reinforcements from the Beastman Kingdom have arrived!"
"Sky Island Forest Legendary Powerhouses to the rescue! Please hold on!"
Hearing these words, hope appeared in everyone’s eyes.
At the same time.
Under Han Xing and the others’ watchful eyes.
Figures suddenly appeared in the sky.
On one side were the green-skinned, imposing Beastmen.
On the other, looked like towering trees come to life.
With human facial features, with roots embedded in the Void.
Tree Spirits!
These twelve figures seemed to be showcasing their power, each unleashing their full momentum.
Unbelievably, they all reached the Legendary Level!
Twelve Legendary Powerhouses!
This was a truly terrifying force.
The group of Witch Race Legends instantly realized.
These were the reinforcements the Beastman Kingdom and Sky Island Forest had promised.
As soon as they appeared, just about to show off their power.
Then, they met the icy gaze of the Shadow Monarch.
The next moment, puzzlement appeared in the eyes of this group of Legendary Powerhouses.
"Doesn’t this guy look a bit familiar?"
Among them, a Beastman Legend towering at two and a half meters with exaggerated muscles wondered aloud.
"Doesn’t he look like the Shadow Monarch?"
Upon hearing that.
This group of Legendary Powerhouses were lost in thought.
However, when they conjured the figure of that presence in their minds.
They immediately turned pale with fright, souls almost leaving their bodies!
Holy crap! It really is him!
At this moment, the Beastman Legends exclaimed.
"Damn it! Wasn’t it said the Shadow Monarch wouldn’t intervene?
"What’s going on now?"
The Tree Spirit Legends on the other side were equally bewildered.
"We don’t know either, but the Clan Leader also said that in the Holy Spirit Realm, Demigod Level powerhouses shouldn’t attack beings below Demigod."
"This guy, it seems he doesn’t intend to adhere to this agreement!"
At this moment, these twelve Legendary Powerhouses suddenly thought to turn around and flee.
However, the Shadow Monarch looked at them and said.
"Since you’re here, why leave."
"Perfect timing, the blood sacrifice is a bit behind schedule, everyone stay!"
With those words, the Shadow Monarch suddenly disappeared from the original spot.
This group of Legendary Powerhouses was scared witless!
What a joke!
They only wanted to come over and lend a hand.
If the situation was untenable, they would flee without hesitation.
Who could’ve known, coming over and immediately encountering a monstrosity like the Shadow Monarch.
"Run!"
However.
Once targeted by the Shadow Monarch.
These Beastman Legends and Tree Spirit Legends had no chance of escaping!
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch held the Ancestral God Altar in his left hand, wielding the Great Sword with his right.
Thud!
When the first Beastman Legend was slain.
Blood splattered onto the Ancestral God Altar, intensifying the blood aura upon it.
The Shadow Monarch nodded slightly.
Then, like a lion eyeing prey, he pounced swiftly.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Just upon contact, before anyone could react, the Shadow Monarch had already slain three Legends consecutively.
These strong reinforcements, now scattered and fleeing.
At this moment, the Shadow Monarch’s slaughter seemed to have drawn the attention of certain existences.
In the extreme distance, two overwhelming presences appeared!
The intensity of these presences was far more terrifying and vast than high-tier Legends.
Even at such a distance, everyone could feel the rage emanating from them.
"Shadow! You’ve broken the pact!"

Tree Spirits!

These were the reinforcements the Beastman Kingdom and Sky Island Forest had promised.

Thud!

Thud!
